bayesDREAM.model

bayesDREAM: Bayesian Dosage Response Effects Across Modalities

Core implementation for bayesDREAM - a three-step Bayesian framework for modeling perturbation effects across multiple molecular modalities:

  1. fit_ntc() - Fit NTC cells to estimate gene-specific overdispersion and batch effects
  2. fit_cis() - Model direct effects on targeted genes
  3. fit_trans() - Model downstream effects as dose-response functions

The bayesDREAM class combines:

  • _BayesDREAMCore: Base fitting infrastructure
  • Modality mixins: Methods for adding different data types (transcripts, splicing, ATAC, custom)

   82. fit_cis() - Model direct effects on targeted genes

  37class bayesDREAM(
  38    PlottingMixin,
  39    TranscriptModalityMixin,
  40    SplicingModalityMixin,
  41    ATACModalityMixin,
  42    CustomModalityMixin,
  43    _BayesDREAMCore
  44):
  45    """
  46    bayesDREAM: Bayesian Dosage Response Effects Across Modalities
  47
  48    A three-step Bayesian framework for modeling perturbation effects across
  49    multiple molecular modalities including genes, transcripts, splicing, and
  50    custom measurements.
  51
  52    Supports:
  53    - Gene counts (negbinom) - the default/primary modality
  54    - Transcript counts (negbinom or multinomial for isoform usage)
  55    - Splice junction counts with donor/acceptor/exon skipping (multinomial/binomial)
  56    - ATAC-seq peaks (negbinom or binomial)
  57    - Custom modalities with user-specified distributions
  58
  59    Attributes
  60    ----------
  61    modalities : Dict[str, Modality]
  62        Dictionary of all modalities. 'gene' is the primary modality.
  63    primary_modality : str
  64        Name of primary modality used for cis/trans analysis (default: 'gene')
  65    """
  66
  67    def __init__(
  68        self,
  69        meta: pd.DataFrame,
  70        counts: pd.DataFrame = None,
  71        modality_name: str = 'gene',
  72        feature_meta: pd.DataFrame = None,
  73        cis_gene: str = None,
  74        cis_feature: str = None,
  75        guide_assignment: np.ndarray = None,
  76        guide_meta: pd.DataFrame = None,
  77        guide_target: pd.DataFrame = None,
  78        guide_covariates: list = None,
  79        guide_covariates_ntc: list = None,
  80        sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor',
  81        output_dir: str = "./model_out",
  82        label: str = None,
  83        device: str = None,
  84        random_seed: int = 2402,
  85        cores: int = 1,
  86        exclude_targets: list = None,
  87        exclude_guides: list = None,
  88        require_ntc: bool = True,
  89        min_count: int = 1,
  90        color_scheme: 'ColorScheme' = None,
  91    ):
  92        """
  93        Initialize bayesDREAM.
  94
  95        Parameters
  96        ----------
  97        meta : pd.DataFrame
  98            Cell-level metadata with columns: cell, guide, target, sum_factor, etc.
  99        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix, optional
 100            Count matrix for the primary modality (features × cells). This will be used
 101            for trans modeling and must represent negbinom count data.
 102
 103            Accepts:
 104            - pd.DataFrame: Features as index, cells as columns
 105            - np.ndarray or scipy.sparse matrix: Features as rows, cells as columns
 106              (requires feature_meta to map feature names)
 107
 108            The modality_name parameter determines how this data is interpreted:
 109            - 'gene': Gene expression counts (most common)
 110            - 'atac': ATAC-seq peak counts
 111            - Custom name: User-defined count modality
 112
 113            Additional modalities can be added after initialization using add_*_modality() methods.
 114        modality_name : str, default='gene'
 115            Name/type of the primary modality provided in counts parameter.
 116
 117            Pre-set types:
 118            - 'gene': Gene expression (default, use with feature_meta for gene annotations)
 119            - 'atac': ATAC-seq peaks
 120
 121            Custom types:
 122            - Any string: Creates a custom negbinom modality with that name
 123
 124            The primary modality MUST be negative binomial (count data) for cis/trans modeling.
 125        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
 126            Feature-level metadata for the primary modality.
 127
 128            For modality_name='gene':
 129            - Recommended columns: 'gene', 'gene_name', 'gene_id'
 130            - If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index
 131
 132            For other modalities:
 133            - Should contain relevant feature annotations
 134            - If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index
 135        cis_gene : str, optional
 136            Feature to extract as 'cis' modality. When modality_name='gene', this is
 137            a gene name (e.g., 'GFI1B'). For other modality types, use cis_feature instead.
 138
 139            The cis feature will be:
 140            1. Extracted as a separate 'cis' modality (1 feature)
 141            2. Removed from the primary modality (which becomes trans-only)
 142            3. Used for cis effect modeling in fit_cis()
 143        cis_feature : str, optional
 144            Alternative to cis_gene for non-gene modalities. Specifies which feature
 145            to extract as the 'cis' modality.
 146        guide_assignment : np.ndarray, optional
 147            Binary matrix (cells × guides) for high MOI mode. Each cell can have
 148            multiple guides. If provided, meta should NOT have 'guide' or 'target'
 149            columns. Must be provided together with guide_meta.
 150        guide_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
 151            Guide metadata for high MOI mode. Required columns: 'guide', 'target'.
 152            Must be provided together with guide_assignment. Index should match
 153            guide order in guide_assignment matrix.
 154        guide_covariates : list, optional
 155            Covariates for guide grouping (e.g., ['cell_line', 'batch'])
 156        guide_covariates_ntc : list, optional
 157            Covariates for NTC guide grouping (if different from guide_covariates)
 158        sum_factor_col : str, default='sum_factor'
 159            Column name in meta containing size factors
 160        output_dir : str, default="./model_out"
 161            Output directory for saving results
 162        label : str, optional
 163            Run label for organizing outputs
 164        device : str, optional
 165            'cpu' or 'cuda'. If None, auto-detects.
 166        random_seed : int, default=2402
 167            Random seed for reproducibility
 168        cores : int, default=1
 169            Number of CPU cores for parallel operations
 170        color_scheme : ColorScheme, optional
 171            Color scheme for visualizations. If None, auto-built from model
 172            metadata via ``ColorScheme.from_model(self)`` after initialization.
 173            Can also be set later via ``set_color_scheme()``.
 174
 175        Raises
 176        ------
 177        ValueError
 178            - If cis_feature is specified but counts is None
 179            - If cis_feature not found in counts
 180            - If cis_feature has zero variance
 181            - If primary modality would be empty after filtering
 182
 183        Examples
 184        --------
 185        Basic gene expression analysis:
 186        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 187        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 188        ...     counts=gene_counts,
 189        ...     cis_gene='GFI1B'
 190        ... )
 191
 192        With gene metadata:
 193        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 194        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 195        ...     counts=gene_counts,
 196        ...     feature_meta=gene_metadata,
 197        ...     cis_gene='GFI1B',
 198        ...     guide_covariates=['cell_line']
 199        ... )
 200
 201        ATAC-seq analysis:
 202        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 203        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 204        ...     counts=atac_counts,
 205        ...     modality_name='atac',
 206        ...     feature_meta=peak_metadata,
 207        ...     cis_feature='chr9:132283881-132284881'
 208        ... )
 209
 210        Custom modality:
 211        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 212        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 213        ...     counts=my_counts,
 214        ...     modality_name='my_custom_modality',
 215        ...     cis_feature='feature_123'
 216        ... )
 217
 218        Notes
 219        -----
 220        - The 'cis' modality is ONLY extracted during initialization from the primary modality
 221        - When you call add_*_modality() methods later, NO cis extraction occurs
 222        - The primary modality MUST be negbinom (count data) for cis/trans modeling
 223        - Additional modalities (transcripts, splicing, etc.) are added via add_*_modality() methods
 224        """
 225        # Initialize modalities dict (always start empty, build from counts)
 226        self.modalities = {}
 227
 228        # Resolve cis_feature: cis_gene is an alias for cis_feature when modality_name='gene'
 229        if cis_gene is not None and cis_feature is not None:
 230            raise ValueError("Provide either cis_gene or cis_feature, not both")
 231        if cis_gene is not None:
 232            if modality_name != 'gene':
 233                warnings.warn(
 234                    f"cis_gene parameter is intended for modality_name='gene'. "
 235                    f"You have modality_name='{modality_name}'. Use cis_feature instead.",
 236                    UserWarning
 237                )
 238            cis_feature = cis_gene
 239
 240        # Store min_count for use in modality creation
 241        self.min_count = min_count
 242
 243        # Store original counts for base class initialization
 244        counts_for_base = counts
 245
 246        # Validate that counts is provided if cis_feature is specified
 247        if cis_feature is not None and counts is None:
 248            raise ValueError("Cannot specify cis_feature without providing counts")
 249
 250        # Extract 'cis' modality from primary modality (if both counts and cis_feature provided)
 251        # Keep the original gene name and track numeric position
 252        cis_numeric_idx = None
 253        if counts is not None and cis_feature is not None:
 254            if modality_name == 'gene':
 255                cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx = self._extract_cis_from_gene(counts, cis_feature, feature_meta, meta)
 256            else:
 257                # Generic cis extraction for any negbinom modality
 258                cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx = self._extract_cis_generic(counts, cis_feature, modality_name, feature_meta, meta)
 259
 260        # Create primary modality
 261        if counts is not None:
 262            if modality_name == 'gene':
 263                # Use gene-specific creation (with gene_meta handling)
 264                # Pass both the name and numeric index for exclusion
 265                self._create_gene_modality(counts, cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx, gene_meta=feature_meta, meta=meta, min_count=min_count)
 266            else:
 267                # Generic negbinom modality creation
 268                self._create_negbinom_modality(counts, modality_name, cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx, feature_meta, meta, min_count=min_count)
 269
 270        # Store primary modality name
 271        self.primary_modality = modality_name
 272
 273        # ========================================================================
 274        # CRITICAL VALIDATION: Primary modality MUST be negative binomial
 275        # ========================================================================
 276        if modality_name in self.modalities:
 277            primary_distribution = self.modalities[modality_name].distribution
 278            if primary_distribution != 'negbinom':
 279                raise ValueError(
 280                    f"Primary modality '{modality_name}' has distribution '{primary_distribution}', "
 281                    f"but bayesDREAM requires primary modality to be 'negbinom' for cis/trans modeling. "
 282                    f"The primary modality must represent count data that follows a negative binomial distribution."
 283                )
 284        elif counts is None:
 285            # No counts provided - user will add modalities later
 286            warnings.warn(
 287                f"No counts provided during initialization. Primary modality '{modality_name}' must be added "
 288                f"via add_custom_modality() with distribution='negbinom' before fitting.",
 289                UserWarning
 290            )
 291
 292        # Get counts for base class initialization
 293        # IMPORTANT: Pass counts matrix as-is to avoid densification
 294        # core.py will handle matrix/array/DataFrame uniformly
 295        if counts_for_base is None:
 296            if modality_name in self.modalities:
 297                # Get from modality - prefer original counts over count_df
 298                mod = self.modalities[modality_name]
 299                primary_counts = mod.counts  # This is the matrix/array, not densified
 300            else:
 301                # No counts and no primary modality - create placeholder
 302                pass
 303                # Create minimal placeholder (will be replaced)
 304                primary_counts = np.ones((1, len(meta)))
 305        else:
 306            # Use original counts as-is (matrix, array, or DataFrame)
 307            primary_counts = counts_for_base
 308
 309        # Prepare gene_meta for base class
 310        # Only pass feature_meta as gene_meta if modality_name is 'gene', otherwise None
 311        gene_meta_for_base = feature_meta if modality_name == 'gene' else None
 312
 313        # Initialize base bayesDREAM with original counts (including cis feature)
 314        super().__init__(
 315            meta=meta,
 316            counts=primary_counts,
 317            gene_meta=gene_meta_for_base,
 318            cis_gene=cis_feature,  # Pass resolved cis_feature as cis_gene
 319            guide_assignment=guide_assignment,
 320            guide_meta=guide_meta,
 321            guide_target=guide_target,
 322            guide_covariates=guide_covariates,
 323            guide_covariates_ntc=guide_covariates_ntc,
 324            sum_factor_col=sum_factor_col,
 325            output_dir=output_dir,
 326            label=label,
 327            device=device,
 328            random_seed=random_seed,
 329            cores=cores,
 330            exclude_targets=exclude_targets,
 331            exclude_guides=exclude_guides,
 332            require_ntc=require_ntc
 333        )
 334
 335        # Subset all modalities to match filtered cells from base class
 336        # Base class (super().__init__) has filtered self.meta to valid cells
 337        valid_cells = self.meta['cell'].tolist()
 338        for mod_name in list(self.modalities.keys()):
 339            mod = self.modalities[mod_name]
 340            if mod.cell_names is not None:
 341                # Find indices of valid cells in this modality
 342                cell_indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(mod.cell_names)
 343                              if c in valid_cells]
 344                if len(cell_indices) < len(mod.cell_names):
 345                    self.modalities[mod_name] = mod.get_cell_subset(cell_indices)
 346
 347        print(f"bayesDREAM: label={self.label}, device={self.device}, {len(self.modalities)} modalities")
 348        for name, mod in self.modalities.items():
 349            print(f"  - {name}: {mod}")
 350
 351        # Store sum_factor_col so add_cis_gene() can re-init sum_factors after cell subsetting.
 352        self._sum_factor_col = sum_factor_col
 353
 354        # Initialise sum_factors on all negbinom modalities from meta.
 355        # Must run AFTER super().__init__() and cell subsetting so self.meta is final.
 356        self._init_sum_factors(sum_factor_col)
 357
 358        # Colour scheme — user-supplied or auto-built from model metadata.
 359        # Must run AFTER super().__init__() so self.meta / guide_meta are final.
 360        if color_scheme is not None:
 361            self.color_scheme = color_scheme
 362        else:
 363            self.color_scheme = ColorScheme.from_model(self)
 364

 367        Replace the model's color scheme.
 368
 369        Parameters
 370        ----------
 371        color_scheme : ColorScheme
 372            New color scheme to use for all visualizations.
 373        """
 374        self.color_scheme = color_scheme

 378    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

 380    def add_cis_gene(self, cis_gene: str) -> None:
 381        """
 382        Specify the cis gene after initialization and prepare the model for cis/trans fitting.
 383
 384        Intended for workflows where fit_ntc() (and optionally adjust_ntc_sum_factor())
 385        should be run once before the cis gene is committed, avoiding a separate technical-fit
 386        run per gene.
 387
 388        The method:
 389        1. Finds and extracts the cis gene from the primary modality, creating the 'cis' modality.
 390        2. Subsets cells to NTC + cis-targeting cells only.
 391        3. Re-filters features that become zero-count after cell subsetting; if fit_ntc() has
 392           already been run, trims matching feature axes in the stored posteriors.
 393        4. If fit_ntc() has already been run, extracts the cis gene's overdispersion parameters
 394           from the primary modality posteriors into the 'cis' modality (equivalent to having
 395           set cis_gene at init time).
 396        5. Recomputes guide_code for compact indexing over the retained cells.
 397        6. Reinitialises sum_factors on the (now-final) cell set.
 398
 399        Parameters
 400        ----------
 401        cis_gene : str
 402            Name of the cis gene (must exist in the primary modality's feature_meta).
 403
 404        Raises
 405        ------
 406        ValueError
 407            If cis_gene is already set, if called in high-MOI mode, if the gene is not
 408            found, or if the gene has zero counts across NTC + cis cells.
 409        """
 410        if self.cis_gene is not None:
 411            raise ValueError(
 412                f"cis_gene is already set to '{self.cis_gene}'. Cannot call add_cis_gene() again."
 413            )
 414        if self.is_high_moi:
 415            raise ValueError(
 416                "add_cis_gene() is not supported in high-MOI mode. "
 417                "Provide cis_gene at initialization time."
 418            )
 419        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 420            raise ValueError("'cis' modality already exists.")
 421
 422        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
 423        n_total_features = primary_mod.dims['n_features']
 424
 425        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 426        # Step 1: locate the cis gene in the primary modality feature_meta
 427        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 428        gene_col = None
 429        for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
 430            if col in primary_mod.feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in primary_mod.feature_meta[col].values:
 431                gene_col = col
 432                break
 433
 434        if gene_col is None:
 435            raise ValueError(
 436                f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in primary modality feature_meta. "
 437                f"Tried columns: gene_name, gene, gene_id, feature_id. "
 438                f"Available columns: {list(primary_mod.feature_meta.columns)}"
 439            )
 440
 441        match_mask = primary_mod.feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene
 442        cis_feat_iloc = int(np.where(match_mask.values)[0][0])
 443
 444        print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: found '{cis_gene}' at feature iloc {cis_feat_iloc} "
 445              f"in primary modality (of {n_total_features} features)")
 446
 447        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 448        # Step 2: extract cis gene counts from primary modality
 449        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 450        if primary_mod.cells_axis == 1:
 451            cis_counts = primary_mod.counts[[cis_feat_iloc], :]
 452        else:
 453            cis_counts = primary_mod.counts[:, [cis_feat_iloc]]
 454
 455        cis_feature_meta = primary_mod.feature_meta.iloc[[cis_feat_iloc]].copy()
 456        cis_feature_meta.index = [0]
 457        if 'gene' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
 458            cis_feature_meta['gene'] = cis_gene
 459        if 'gene_name' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
 460            cis_feature_meta['gene_name'] = cis_gene
 461
 462        self.modalities['cis'] = Modality(
 463            name='cis',
 464            counts=cis_counts,
 465            feature_meta=cis_feature_meta,
 466            cell_names=primary_mod.cell_names,
 467            distribution='negbinom',
 468            cells_axis=primary_mod.cells_axis,
 469            min_count=self.min_count,
 470        )
 471
 472        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 473        # Step 3: if fit_ntc already ran, extract cis posteriors from primary
 474        #         BEFORE we remove the cis feature row (while indices still align)
 475        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 476        ntc_ran = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
 477
 478        if ntc_ran:
 479            self._extract_cis_alpha_from_ntc_posteriors(cis_gene, cis_feat_iloc, n_total_features)
 480
 481        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 482        # Step 4: remove cis gene from primary modality
 483        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 484        trans_idx = list(range(cis_feat_iloc)) + list(range(cis_feat_iloc + 1, n_total_features))
 485
 486        if primary_mod.cells_axis == 1:
 487            trans_counts = primary_mod.counts[trans_idx, :]
 488        else:
 489            trans_counts = primary_mod.counts[:, trans_idx]
 490
 491        trans_feature_meta = primary_mod.feature_meta.iloc[trans_idx].copy()
 492        trans_feature_meta.index = range(len(trans_idx))
 493
 494        trans_feature_names = (
 495            [primary_mod.feature_names[i] for i in trans_idx]
 496            if primary_mod.feature_names is not None else None
 497        )
 498
 499        new_primary_mod = Modality(
 500            name=self.primary_modality,
 501            counts=trans_counts,
 502            feature_meta=trans_feature_meta,
 503            distribution=primary_mod.distribution,
 504            cells_axis=primary_mod.cells_axis,
 505            feature_names=trans_feature_names,
 506            cell_names=primary_mod.cell_names,
 507            min_count=primary_mod.min_count,
 508        )
 509
 510        # Transfer already-trimmed fitting results to the new primary modality object
 511        if ntc_ran:
 512            new_primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 513            new_primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
 514            new_primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
 515            if hasattr(primary_mod, 'loss_ntc'):
 516                new_primary_mod.loss_ntc = primary_mod.loss_ntc
 517
 518        self.modalities[self.primary_modality] = new_primary_mod
 519        self.cis_gene = cis_gene
 520
 521        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 522        # Step 5: subset cells to NTC + cis
 523        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 524        valid_cells = set(self.meta[self.meta['target'].isin(['ntc', cis_gene])]['cell'].unique())
 525        n_before = len(self.meta)
 526        self.meta = self.meta[self.meta['cell'].isin(valid_cells)].copy()
 527        n_after = len(self.meta)
 528        if n_after < n_before:
 529            print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: cells {n_before} → {n_after} (kept NTC + {cis_gene} only)")
 530
 531        for mod_name in list(self.modalities.keys()):
 532            mod = self.modalities[mod_name]
 533            if mod.cell_names is not None:
 534                cell_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(mod.cell_names) if c in valid_cells]
 535                if len(cell_idx) < len(mod.cell_names):
 536                    new_mod = mod.get_cell_subset(cell_idx)
 537                    # Forward fitting results to cell-subsetted copy
 538                    new_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 539                    new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult    = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
 540                    new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add     = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
 541                    if hasattr(mod, 'loss_ntc'):
 542                        new_mod.loss_ntc = mod.loss_ntc
 543                    self.modalities[mod_name] = new_mod
 544
 545        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 546        # Step 6: re-filter zero-count features after cell subsetting
 547        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 548        self._refilter_zero_count_features(ntc_ran)
 549
 550        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 551        # Step 7: recompute guide_code for compact indices over retained cells
 552        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 553        self.meta['guide_code'] = pd.Categorical(self.meta['guide_used']).codes
 554
 555        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 556        # Step 8: reinitialise sum_factors on the final cell set
 557        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 558        self._init_sum_factors(self._sum_factor_col)
 559
 560        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 561        # Step 9: rebuild color scheme
 562        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 563        self.color_scheme = ColorScheme.from_model(self)
 564
 565        print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene('{cis_gene}') complete: {n_after} cells, "
 566              f"{self.modalities[self.primary_modality].dims['n_features']} trans features, "
 567              f"{'NTC posteriors transferred' if ntc_ran else 'fit_ntc() not yet run'}.")
 568
 569    def _extract_cis_alpha_from_ntc_posteriors(
 570        self, cis_gene: str, cis_feat_iloc: int, n_total_features: int
 571    ) -> None:
 572        """
 573        Extract cis gene overdispersion from primary modality NTC posteriors,
 574        populate the 'cis' modality's posterior_samples_ntc, and trim the cis
 575        gene's entry from the primary modality posteriors in-place.
 576
 577        Called by add_cis_gene() when fit_ntc() has already been run.
 578        """
 579        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
 580        ps = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc  # mutated in-place
 581
 582        T = n_total_features
 583        trans_idx = list(range(cis_feat_iloc)) + list(range(cis_feat_iloc + 1, T))
 584
 585        full_alpha_y_mult = ps.get('alpha_y_mult')
 586        full_alpha_y_add  = ps.get('alpha_y_add')
 587
 588        # alpha_x_prefit: median of the cis gene's alpha_y_mult samples → [C]
 589        if full_alpha_y_mult is not None and full_alpha_y_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 590            self.alpha_x_prefit = full_alpha_y_mult[..., cis_feat_iloc].median(dim=0).values
 591
 592        # alpha_y_prefit for primary modality (trans genes only)
 593        if primary_mod.distribution == 'negbinom':
 594            if full_alpha_y_mult is not None and full_alpha_y_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 595                primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = full_alpha_y_mult[..., trans_idx].median(dim=0).values
 596        else:
 597            if full_alpha_y_add is not None and full_alpha_y_add.shape[-1] == T:
 598                primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = full_alpha_y_add[..., trans_idx].median(dim=0).values
 599
 600        # Build cis modality's posterior_samples_ntc (matching what ntc.py produces)
 601        cis_modality = self.modalities['cis']
 602        cis_posterior = {}
 603        for src_key, dst_key in [
 604            ('log2_alpha_y', 'log2_alpha_x'), ('alpha_y_mul', 'alpha_x_mul'),
 605            ('delta_y_add', 'delta_x_add'),   ('o_y',         'o_x'),
 606            ('mu_ntc',      'mu_ntc'),
 607        ]:
 608            if src_key in ps and isinstance(ps[src_key], torch.Tensor):
 609                v = ps[src_key]
 610                if v.shape[-1] == T:
 611                    cis_posterior[dst_key] = v[..., cis_feat_iloc:cis_feat_iloc + 1]
 612
 613        if 'alpha_x_mul' in cis_posterior:
 614            raw = cis_posterior['alpha_x_mul']
 615            if raw.dim() == 3:
 616                S, Cminus1, _ = raw.shape
 617                cis_posterior['alpha_x_mult'] = torch.cat(
 618                    [torch.ones(S, 1, 1, device=raw.device), raw], dim=1)
 619                cis_posterior['alpha_x'] = cis_posterior['alpha_x_mult']
 620
 621        if 'delta_x_add' in cis_posterior:
 622            raw = cis_posterior['delta_x_add']
 623            if raw.dim() == 3:
 624                S, Cminus1, _ = raw.shape
 625                cis_posterior['alpha_x_add'] = torch.cat(
 626                    [torch.zeros(S, 1, 1, device=raw.device), raw], dim=1)
 627
 628        cis_modality.posterior_samples_ntc = cis_posterior
 629        print(f"[INFO] Extracted '{cis_gene}' posteriors from primary modality NTC fit")
 630
 631        # Trim cis gene row from primary modality posteriors in-place
 632        if full_alpha_y_mult is not None and full_alpha_y_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 633            ps['alpha_y_mult'] = full_alpha_y_mult[..., trans_idx]
 634            ps['alpha_y']      = ps['alpha_y_mult']
 635        if full_alpha_y_add is not None and full_alpha_y_add.shape[-1] == T:
 636            ps['alpha_y_add'] = full_alpha_y_add[..., trans_idx]
 637            if full_alpha_y_mult is None:
 638                ps['alpha_y'] = ps['alpha_y_add']
 639
 640        for key in ['log2_alpha_y', 'alpha_y_mul', 'delta_y_add', 'o_y', 'mu_ntc']:
 641            if key in ps and isinstance(ps[key], torch.Tensor):
 642                v = ps[key]
 643                if v.shape[-1] == T:
 644                    ps[key] = v[..., trans_idx]
 645
 646        print(f"[INFO] Trimmed '{cis_gene}' from primary modality posteriors "
 647              f"(T {T} → {len(trans_idx)})")
 648
 649    def _refilter_zero_count_features(self, ntc_ran: bool) -> None:
 650        """
 651        After cell subsetting in add_cis_gene(), drop features that have become
 652        zero-count across the retained NTC + cis cells.  If fit_ntc() has already
 653        been run, trim the corresponding axes in the stored NTC posteriors so they
 654        stay aligned with the surviving feature set.
 655
 656        Operates on every modality except 'cis' (which is a single feature and
 657        cannot usefully be dropped here).
 658        """
 659        for mod_name, mod in list(self.modalities.items()):
 660            if mod_name == 'cis':
 661                continue
 662
 663            n_features = mod.dims['n_features']
 664
 665            # Compute per-feature total counts (works for dense, sparse, multinomial)
 666            if mod.distribution == 'multinomial':
 667                raw = mod.counts  # [F, N, K]
 668                feature_sums = np.array(raw.sum(axis=(1, 2))).flatten()
 669            elif mod.cells_axis == 1:
 670                feature_sums = np.array(mod.counts.sum(axis=1)).flatten()
 671            else:
 672                feature_sums = np.array(mod.counts.sum(axis=0)).flatten()
 673
 674            keep_idx = np.where(feature_sums > 0)[0]
 675            n_dropped = n_features - len(keep_idx)
 676
 677            if n_dropped == 0:
 678                continue
 679
 680            print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: dropping {n_dropped} zero-count features "
 681                  f"from modality '{mod_name}' after cell subsetting")
 682
 683            # Trim posteriors on the existing modality object BEFORE creating subset
 684            if mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
 685                self._trim_feature_axis_in_posteriors(mod, keep_idx, n_features)
 686
 687            # Create feature-subsetted copy and re-attach fitting results
 688            new_mod = mod.get_feature_subset(keep_idx.tolist())
 689            new_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = mod.posterior_samples_ntc  # already trimmed
 690            new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult   = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
 691            new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add    = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
 692            if hasattr(mod, 'loss_ntc'):
 693                new_mod.loss_ntc = mod.loss_ntc
 694
 695            self.modalities[mod_name] = new_mod
 696
 697    @staticmethod
 698    def _trim_feature_axis_in_posteriors(
 699        mod: 'Modality', keep_idx: np.ndarray, T: int
 700    ) -> None:
 701        """
 702        Trim the feature (last) axis of every tensor in mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 703        and the alpha_y_prefit arrays to the surviving feature indices.
 704
 705        Mutates mod in-place; called before get_feature_subset() so the counts
 706        array still has T columns.
 707        """
 708        ps = mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 709        if ps is None:
 710            return
 711
 712        for key in list(ps.keys()):
 713            v = ps[key]
 714            if not isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
 715                continue
 716            if v.shape[-1] == T:
 717                ps[key] = v[..., keep_idx]
 718
 719        if mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None and mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 720            mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult[..., keep_idx]
 721
 722        if mod.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None and mod.alpha_y_prefit_add.shape[-1] == T:
 723            mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add[..., keep_idx]
 724
 725    def _init_sum_factors(self, sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor'):
 726        """
 727        Initialise sum_factors DataFrame on negbinom modalities from self.meta.
 728
 729        Copies every column whose name contains 'sum_factor' into a cell-indexed
 730        DataFrame stored on each negbinom modality.  The 'cis' modality (when
 731        present) receives a reference to the *same* DataFrame as the primary
 732        modality — not a copy — so that writes made via adjust_ntc_sum_factor()
 733        or refit_sumfactor() are immediately visible to both.
 734
 735        Called once at the end of __init__, after super().__init__() and cell
 736        subsetting so self.meta is in its final, filtered state.
 737        """
 738        if self.primary_modality not in self.modalities:
 739            return
 740
 741        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
 742        if primary_mod.distribution != 'negbinom':
 743            return
 744
 745        # Collect all sum-factor columns present in meta
 746        sf_cols = [c for c in self.meta.columns if 'sum_factor' in c.lower()]
 747        if sum_factor_col not in sf_cols and sum_factor_col in self.meta.columns:
 748            sf_cols.append(sum_factor_col)
 749
 750        if not sf_cols:
 751            primary_mod.sum_factors = pd.DataFrame(index=self.meta['cell'].values)
 752        else:
 753            sf_df = self.meta.set_index('cell')[sf_cols].copy()
 754            primary_mod.sum_factors = sf_df
 755
 756        # The 'cis' modality is a view of the primary — share the same DataFrame.
 757        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 758            self.modalities['cis'].sum_factors = primary_mod.sum_factors
 759
 760        print(f"[INIT] sum_factors initialised on '{self.primary_modality}' "
 761              f"with columns: {list(primary_mod.sum_factors.columns)}")
 762
 763    def _compute_ntc_log2_exprs_from_fit(self):
 764        """
 765        Per-gene log2 NTC expression using fit_ntc() posteriors.
 766
 767        fit_ntc() appends the cis gene as the last row of the counts matrix,
 768        fits it together with all trans genes, and stores the result in
 769        cis_modality.posterior_samples_ntc.  Both trans and cis mu_ntc
 770        values are therefore available here — no raw-count computation needed.
 771
 772        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run (populates posterior_samples_ntc
 773        on both the primary and cis modalities).
 774
 775        Returns
 776        -------
 777        dict with keys: all_log2_expr, cis_log2_expr, trans_log2_expr,
 778        cis_ntc_counts (raw counts for plot annotation only), n_ntc_cells.
 779        Or None on failure (warnings emitted).
 780        """
 781        import torch as _torch
 782
 783        primary_mod = self.modalities.get(self.primary_modality)
 784        cis_mod     = self.modalities.get('cis')
 785
 786        if primary_mod is None:
 787            warnings.warn(f"Primary modality '{self.primary_modality}' not found.", UserWarning)
 788            return None
 789
 790        ps_primary = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 791        if ps_primary is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps_primary:
 792            raise ValueError(
 793                "fit_ntc() must be run before checking cis expression. "
 794                "Call model.fit_ntc() first."
 795            )
 796
 797        if cis_mod is None:
 798            warnings.warn("No 'cis' modality found.", UserWarning)
 799            return None
 800
 801        ps_cis = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 802        if ps_cis is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps_cis:
 803            raise ValueError(
 804                "fit_ntc() did not produce mu_ntc for the cis modality. "
 805                "Ensure fit_ntc() completed successfully."
 806            )
 807
 808        def _to_numpy(t):
 809            if isinstance(t, _torch.Tensor):
 810                return t.mean(dim=0).detach().cpu().numpy().flatten()
 811            return np.asarray(t).mean(axis=0).flatten()
 812
 813        # Trans genes — NaN where features were excluded from fitting (zero NTC counts, etc.)
 814        log2_trans = np.log2(_to_numpy(ps_primary['mu_ntc']))
 815
 816        # Cis gene (shape [S, 1] → scalar after mean+flatten)
 817        cis_mu_ntc = float(_to_numpy(ps_cis['mu_ntc'])[0])
 818        cis_log2_expr = float(np.log2(cis_mu_ntc))
 819
 820        if not np.isfinite(cis_log2_expr):
 821            warnings.warn(
 822                f"Cis gene '{self.cis_gene}' has non-finite log2 NTC expression "
 823                f"(mu_ntc={cis_mu_ntc:.4g}). GMM check skipped.",
 824                UserWarning,
 825            )
 826            return None
 827
 828        # Drop non-finite trans values (NaN-filled excluded features, any -inf from mu=0)
 829        n_raw = len(log2_trans)
 830        log2_trans = log2_trans[np.isfinite(log2_trans)]
 831        n_dropped = n_raw - len(log2_trans)
 832        if n_dropped > 0:
 833            warnings.warn(
 834                f"{n_dropped} trans gene(s) excluded from GMM (non-finite log2 NTC expression, "
 835                f"likely zero-count features skipped during fit_ntc).",
 836                UserWarning,
 837            )
 838
 839        all_log2_expr = np.concatenate([log2_trans, [cis_log2_expr]])
 840
 841        # Raw NTC counts — used only for the plot title annotation, not for the GMM
 842        ntc_meta  = self.meta[self.meta.get('target', pd.Series()).eq('ntc')] \
 843                    if 'target' in self.meta.columns else self.meta.iloc[:0]
 844        ntc_cells = ntc_meta['cell'].values
 845        cell_to_col_cis = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(cis_mod.cell_names or [])}
 846        ntc_idx_cis = np.array([cell_to_col_cis[c] for c in ntc_cells if c in cell_to_col_cis], dtype=int)
 847        if len(ntc_idx_cis) > 0:
 848            cis_raw = cis_mod.counts
 849            if hasattr(cis_raw, 'toarray'):
 850                cis_ntc = np.asarray(cis_raw[0, ntc_idx_cis].toarray()).flatten().astype(float)
 851            elif isinstance(cis_raw, pd.DataFrame):
 852                cis_ntc = cis_raw.iloc[0, ntc_idx_cis].values.astype(float)
 853            else:
 854                cis_ntc = np.asarray(cis_raw)[0, ntc_idx_cis].astype(float)
 855        else:
 856            cis_ntc = np.array([])
 857
 858        return {
 859            'all_log2_expr':   all_log2_expr,
 860            'cis_log2_expr':   cis_log2_expr,
 861            'trans_log2_expr': log2_trans,
 862            'cis_ntc_counts':  cis_ntc,
 863            'n_ntc_cells':     len(ntc_idx_cis),
 864        }
 865
 866    def plot_ntc_expression(
 867        self,
 868        figsize: tuple = (7, 4),
 869        n_bins: int = 80,
 870        threshold: float = -1.0,
 871    ):
 872        """
 873        Histogram of per-gene log2 NTC expression with the cis gene marked.
 874
 875        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run first.  Useful for judging whether
 876        the cis gene is sufficiently expressed in NTC cells before running
 877        fit_cis().  fit_cis() raises a ValueError if the cis gene's log2 NTC
 878        expression is below ``threshold`` (default -1); this plot shows exactly
 879        where the gene falls relative to that cutoff.
 880
 881        Parameters
 882        ----------
 883        figsize : tuple, default (7, 4)
 884        n_bins : int, default 80
 885        threshold : float, default -1.0
 886            The log2 expression cutoff used by fit_cis() to flag unexpressed
 887            genes.  Drawn as a vertical dotted line for reference.
 888
 889        Returns
 890        -------
 891        matplotlib.figure.Figure
 892        """
 893        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 894
 895        data = self._compute_ntc_log2_exprs_from_fit()
 896        if data is None:
 897            raise ValueError("Ensure fit_ntc() has been run before plotting.")
 898
 899        all_expr  = data['all_log2_expr']
 900        cis_val   = data['cis_log2_expr']
 901        n_genes   = len(all_expr)
 902
 903        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
 904        ax.hist(all_expr, bins=n_bins, color='steelblue', alpha=0.6, edgecolor='none')
 905        ax.axvline(cis_val, color='red', lw=2, ls='--',
 906                   label=f'{self.cis_gene}  (log$_2$ = {cis_val:.2f})')
 907        ax.axvline(threshold, color='grey', lw=1.5, ls=':',
 908                   label=f'fit_cis threshold ({threshold})')
 909        ax.set_xlabel('log$_2$(NTC mean expression) from technical fit', fontsize=10)
 910        ax.set_ylabel('Number of genes', fontsize=10)
 911        ax.set_title(
 912            f'NTC expression — {self.cis_gene}  '
 913            f'({"BELOW" if cis_val < threshold else "above"} threshold)\n'
 914            f'{n_genes} genes, {data["n_ntc_cells"]} NTC cells',
 915            fontsize=9
 916        )
 917        ax.legend(fontsize=9)
 918        fig.tight_layout()
 919        return fig
 920
 921    def plot_ntc_overdispersion(
 922        self,
 923        modality_name: str = None,
 924        ax=None,
 925        figsize: tuple = (6, 5),
 926    ):
 927        """
 928        Scatter plot of log2(mu_ntc) vs log2(o_y) from the technical fit.
 929
 930        Highlights the cis gene in red.  Useful for diagnosing whether the
 931        cis gene falls in an unusual region of the mu_ntc–o_y relationship.
 932
 933        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run first.
 934
 935        Parameters
 936        ----------
 937        modality_name : str, optional
 938            Modality to plot (default: primary modality).
 939        ax : matplotlib.axes.Axes, optional
 940            Axes to draw on.  Creates a new figure if None.
 941        figsize : tuple, default=(6, 5)
 942            Figure size (width, height) in inches.
 943
 944        Returns
 945        -------
 946        matplotlib.figure.Figure
 947        """
 948        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 949
 950        if modality_name is None:
 951            modality_name = self.primary_modality
 952
 953        modality = self.get_modality(modality_name)
 954        ps = modality.posterior_samples_ntc
 955        if ps is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps or 'o_y' not in ps:
 956            raise ValueError(
 957                f"No technical fit found for modality '{modality_name}'. "
 958                "Run fit_ntc() first."
 959            )
 960
 961        # Extract posterior means — tensors may be [S, T] or [S, C, T]
 962        mu_ntc_raw = ps['mu_ntc'].mean(dim=0).detach().numpy()
 963        o_y_raw    = ps['o_y'].mean(dim=0).detach().numpy()
 964
 965        # Flatten multi-group tensors to 1D (take first group = NTC reference)
 966        mu_ntc = mu_ntc_raw.reshape(-1) if mu_ntc_raw.ndim == 1 else mu_ntc_raw[0]
 967        o_y    = o_y_raw.reshape(-1)    if o_y_raw.ndim == 1    else o_y_raw[0]
 968
 969        log2_mu = np.log2(np.clip(mu_ntc, 1e-8, None))
 970        log2_oy = np.log2(np.clip(o_y,    1e-8, None))
 971
 972        new_fig = ax is None
 973        if new_fig:
 974            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
 975        else:
 976            fig = ax.get_figure()
 977
 978        ax.scatter(log2_mu, log2_oy, alpha=0.25, s=4, c='steelblue', rasterized=True,
 979                   label='trans genes')
 980
 981        # Highlight cis gene if available
 982        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 983            cis_ps = self.modalities['cis'].posterior_samples_ntc
 984            if cis_ps is not None and 'mu_ntc' in cis_ps and 'o_x' in cis_ps:
 985                cis_mu = float(cis_ps['mu_ntc'].mean().item())
 986                cis_ox = float(cis_ps['o_x'].mean().item())
 987                ax.scatter(
 988                    np.log2(max(cis_mu, 1e-8)),
 989                    np.log2(max(cis_ox, 1e-8)),
 990                    s=120, c='red', zorder=10, marker='*',
 991                    label=f'{self.cis_gene}'
 992                )
 993
 994        ax.set_xlabel('log$_2$(mu_ntc)', fontsize=11)
 995        ax.set_ylabel('log$_2$(o_y)', fontsize=11)
 996        ax.set_title('Technical fit: NTC mean expression vs overdispersion', fontsize=11)
 997        ax.axhline(0, color='gray', lw=0.5, ls='--')
 998        ax.legend(fontsize=9, markerscale=1.5)
 999
1000        if new_fig:
1001            fig.tight_layout()
1002
1003        return fig
1004
1005    def _filter_features(self, counts, feature_meta, features_to_keep):
1006        """
1007        Filter features (rows) from counts matrix and feature_meta.
1008
1009        Works uniformly with DataFrame, numpy array, sparse matrix.
1010        Returns filtered counts and feature_meta with reset numeric indices.
1011
1012        Parameters
1013        ----------
1014        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1015            Count matrix (features × cells)
1016        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame
1017            Feature metadata (must have same number of rows as counts)
1018        features_to_keep : array-like of int
1019            Integer positions (iloc) of features to keep
1020
1021        Returns
1022        -------
1023        counts_filtered : same type as input
1024            Filtered counts matrix
1025        feature_meta_filtered : pd.DataFrame
1026            Filtered feature_meta with index reset to range(n_kept_features)
1027        """
1028        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1029            # DataFrame: use iloc
1030            counts_filtered = counts.iloc[features_to_keep].copy()
1031            # Reset index to numeric
1032            counts_filtered.index = range(len(features_to_keep))
1033        else:
1034            # Array or sparse matrix: use numpy indexing
1035            if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1036                # Sparse matrix
1037                counts_filtered = counts[features_to_keep, :]
1038            else:
1039                # Dense array
1040                counts_filtered = counts[features_to_keep, :]
1041
1042        # Filter and reset feature_meta index
1043        feature_meta_filtered = feature_meta.iloc[features_to_keep].copy()
1044        feature_meta_filtered.index = range(len(features_to_keep))
1045
1046        return counts_filtered, feature_meta_filtered
1047
1048    def _counts_to_dataframe(self, counts, feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, cell_names=None, keep_sparse=False):
1049        """
1050        Convert counts (DataFrame, array, or sparse matrix) to DataFrame.
1051
1052        WARNING: This method densifies sparse matrices by default. Use keep_sparse=True to
1053        return a dict with sparse matrix + metadata instead.
1054
1055        Parameters
1056        ----------
1057        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1058            Count matrix (features × cells)
1059        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1060            Feature metadata to use as index. If None, uses integer indices.
1061        cell_names : list, optional
1062            Cell names to use as columns. If None, uses integer indices.
1063        keep_sparse : bool, default=False
1064            If True and counts is sparse, returns dict with keys:
1065            {'counts': sparse_matrix, 'gene_names': list, 'cell_names': list}
1066            instead of densifying to DataFrame.
1067
1068        Returns
1069        -------
1070        pd.DataFrame or dict
1071            If keep_sparse=False: Counts as DataFrame
1072            If keep_sparse=True and input is sparse: dict with sparse data + metadata
1073        """
1074        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1075            if keep_sparse:
1076                # Already dense DataFrame, return as-is (no conversion to dict)
1077                return counts
1078            else:
1079                return counts
1080
1081        # Check if sparse
1082        from scipy import sparse
1083        is_sparse = sparse.issparse(counts)
1084
1085        if is_sparse and keep_sparse:
1086            # Return sparse matrix with metadata (do NOT densify)
1087            # Get feature names from feature_meta
1088            if feature_meta is not None:
1089                feature_names = feature_meta.index.tolist()
1090            else:
1091                feature_names = list(range(counts.shape[0]))
1092
1093            # Get cell names
1094            if cell_names is None:
1095                cell_names = list(range(counts.shape[1]))
1096
1097            return {
1098                'counts': counts,  # Keep sparse!
1099                'gene_names': feature_names,
1100                'cell_names': cell_names,
1101                'is_sparse': True
1102            }
1103
1104        # Convert to dense array if sparse (legacy behavior)
1105        if is_sparse:
1106            print(f"[WARNING] Densifying sparse matrix of shape {counts.shape} - this may use significant memory!")
1107            counts_array = counts.toarray()
1108        else:
1109            counts_array = counts
1110
1111        # Get cell names
1112        if cell_names is None:
1113            cell_names = list(range(counts_array.shape[1]))
1114
1115        # Use numeric index for features (not feature_meta.index)
1116        # This enables compatibility when Ensembl IDs or gene names have duplicates
1117        # Row i in DataFrame corresponds to row i in feature_meta
1118        feature_index = list(range(counts_array.shape[0]))
1119
1120        return pd.DataFrame(counts_array, index=feature_index, columns=cell_names)
1121
1122    def _extract_cis_from_gene(self, counts, cis_gene: str, feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None) -> tuple:
1123        """
1124        Extract 'cis' modality from gene counts.
1125
1126        Parameters
1127        ----------
1128        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1129            Gene counts (genes × cells)
1130        cis_gene : str
1131            Gene name to extract as cis modality
1132        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1133            Feature metadata with gene names. Required if counts is not a DataFrame.
1134        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1135            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Required if counts is not a DataFrame
1136            (used to get cell names for proper subsetting later).
1137
1138        Returns
1139        -------
1140        tuple (str, int)
1141            (original_gene_name, numeric_row_index)
1142            Returns the original gene name and the numeric row position
1143        """
1144        # Handle different count formats
1145        numeric_idx = None
1146
1147        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1148            # DataFrame: check if index is numeric or string-based
1149            if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1150                # Numeric index: use feature_meta to find gene
1151                if feature_meta is None:
1152                    raise ValueError(
1153                        f"counts has numeric index but no feature_meta provided to locate '{cis_gene}'"
1154                    )
1155                # Find gene in feature_meta columns (same order as core.py)
1156                gene_col = None
1157                for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
1158                    if col in feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in feature_meta[col].values:
1159                        gene_col = col
1160                        break
1161
1162                if gene_col is None:
1163                    raise ValueError(
1164                        f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in feature_meta columns: {list(feature_meta.columns)}"
1165                    )
1166
1167                # Get numeric position (iloc)
1168                numeric_idx = feature_meta[feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene].index[0]
1169                cis_counts = counts.iloc[[numeric_idx]].values
1170            else:
1171                # String-based index: use index directly
1172                if cis_gene not in counts.index:
1173                    raise ValueError(
1174                        f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in counts.index.\n"
1175                        f"Available genes: {counts.index[:10].tolist()}..."
1176                    )
1177                numeric_idx = counts.index.get_loc(cis_gene)
1178                cis_counts = counts.loc[[cis_gene]].values
1179        else:
1180            # Array or sparse matrix: use feature_meta
1181            if feature_meta is None:
1182                raise ValueError(
1183                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, feature_meta must be provided to locate cis_gene"
1184                )
1185
1186            # Find gene in feature_meta columns (same order as core.py)
1187            gene_col = None
1188            for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
1189                if col in feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in feature_meta[col].values:
1190                    gene_col = col
1191                    break
1192
1193            if gene_col is None:
1194                available_cols = list(feature_meta.columns)
1195                raise ValueError(
1196                    f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in feature_meta.\n"
1197                    f"Tried columns: gene_name, gene, gene_id, feature_id.\n"
1198                    f"Available columns: {available_cols}"
1199                )
1200
1201            # Get numeric position (iloc, which is the row number)
1202            numeric_idx = feature_meta[feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene].index[0]
1203
1204            # Extract row from counts (works for numpy arrays and sparse matrices)
1205            if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1206                # Sparse matrix
1207                cis_counts = counts[numeric_idx, :].toarray()
1208            else:
1209                # Dense matrix or numpy array
1210                cis_counts = counts[numeric_idx:numeric_idx+1, :]
1211
1212        # Check if cis gene has zero variance (critical for cis modeling)
1213        cis_gene_std = np.std(cis_counts)
1214        if cis_gene_std == 0:
1215            raise ValueError(
1216                f"Cis gene '{cis_gene}' has zero standard deviation across all cells. "
1217                f"Cannot model cis effects for a gene with constant expression."
1218            )
1219
1220        print(f"[INFO] Extracting 'cis' modality: {cis_gene}")
1221
1222        # Build cis_feature_meta: copy all columns from feature_meta row if available
1223        if feature_meta is not None:
1224            cis_feature_meta = feature_meta.iloc[[numeric_idx]].copy()
1225            cis_feature_meta.index = [numeric_idx]
1226            if 'gene' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
1227                cis_feature_meta['gene'] = cis_gene
1228            if 'gene_name' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
1229                cis_feature_meta['gene_name'] = cis_gene
1230        else:
1231            cis_feature_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1232                'gene': [cis_gene],
1233                'gene_name': [cis_gene],
1234            }, index=[numeric_idx])
1235
1236        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1237        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1238            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1239        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1240            # Array or sparse matrix - get cell names from meta
1241            # Ensure correct number of cells
1242            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1243                raise ValueError(
1244                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1245                )
1246            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1247        else:
1248            # No meta provided - will be None and subsetting will be skipped
1249            # This should not happen in normal usage
1250            warnings.warn(
1251                "Creating cis modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1252                UserWarning
1253            )
1254            cell_names = None
1255
1256        self.modalities['cis'] = Modality(
1257            name='cis',
1258            counts=cis_counts,
1259            feature_meta=cis_feature_meta,
1260            cell_names=cell_names,
1261            distribution='negbinom',
1262            cells_axis=1,
1263            min_count=self.min_count,
1264        )
1265
1266        return cis_gene, numeric_idx
1267

1347                )
1348
1349            # Get numeric position (iloc, which is the row number)

1351
1352            # Extract row from counts (works for numpy arrays and sparse matrices)
1353            if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):

1356            else:

1379        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1380            # Array or sparse matrix - get cell names from meta
