1405    def _create_negbinom_modality(
1406        self,
1407        counts,
1408        modality_name: str,
1409        cis_feature: Optional[str] = None,
1410        cis_feature_idx: Optional[int] = None,
1411        feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1412        meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1413        min_count: int = 1,
1414    ):
1415        """
1416        Create a generic negbinom modality (excluding cis feature if specified).
1417
1418        Parameters
1419        ----------
1420        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1421            Feature counts (features × cells)
1422        modality_name : str
1423            Name for this modality
1424        cis_feature : str, optional
1425            If provided, this feature will be excluded from the modality
1426        cis_feature_idx : int, optional
1427            Numeric row index of cis feature (for exclusion when counts has numeric index)
1428        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1429            Feature metadata. If None, creates minimal metadata from counts.index
1430        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1431            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Used to get cell names if counts is not a DataFrame.
1432        """
1433        if modality_name in self.modalities:
1434            warnings.warn(f"Modality '{modality_name}' already exists. Overwriting.")
1435
1436        # Prepare feature metadata
1437        if feature_meta is None:
1438            # Auto-create from DataFrame index if available, else require it for arrays
1439            if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1440                # Check if DataFrame has meaningful feature names as index
1441                if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1442                    # Numeric index - no feature names available
1443                    raise ValueError(
1444                        "counts has numeric index but no feature_meta provided. "
1445                        "Either:\n"
1446                        "  1. Provide feature_meta with feature names/IDs, OR\n"
1447                        "  2. Set feature names as counts.index before initialization"
1448                    )
1449                else:
1450                    # String-based index - extract feature names
1451                    print(f"[INFO] No feature_meta provided - creating from counts.index")
1452                    feature_names = counts.index.tolist()
1453                    feature_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1454                        'feature': feature_names,
1455                        'feature_name': feature_names  # Also store in 'feature_name' column
1456                    }, index=range(len(feature_names)))
1457            else:
1458                # Array or sparse matrix - feature_meta is REQUIRED
1459                raise ValueError(
1460                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, feature_meta must be provided. "
1461                    "feature_meta should contain feature names/IDs to enable plotting and analysis."
1462                )
1463        else:
1464            # feature_meta provided - ensure it has numeric index and required columns
1465            if len(feature_meta) != counts.shape[0]:
1466                raise ValueError(
1467                    f"feature_meta has {len(feature_meta)} rows but counts has {counts.shape[0]} rows. "
1468                    f"They must match (row i in counts = row i in feature_meta)."
1469                )
1470            feature_meta = feature_meta.copy()
1471
1472            # Ensure at least one feature identifier column exists
1473            feature_id_cols = ['feature_name', 'feature', 'gene_name', 'gene', 'feature_id']
1474            has_feature_col = any(col in feature_meta.columns for col in feature_id_cols)
1475
1476            if not has_feature_col:
1477                # If DataFrame with string index, try to extract from there
1478                if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame) and not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1479                    print(f"[INFO] feature_meta has no feature identifier columns - adding 'feature_name' from counts.index")
1480                    feature_meta['feature_name'] = counts.index.tolist()
1481                    feature_meta['feature'] = counts.index.tolist()
1482                else:
1483                    warnings.warn(
1484                        "feature_meta has no feature identifier columns (feature_name, feature, gene_name, gene, feature_id). "
1485                        "Plotting by feature name will not work.",
1486                        UserWarning
1487                    )
1488
1489            feature_meta.index = range(len(feature_meta))  # Reset to numeric
1490
1491        # Build list of features to keep
1492        features_to_keep = []
1493
1494        for i in range(len(feature_meta)):
1495            # Skip cis feature
1496            if i == cis_feature_idx:
1497                continue
1498
1499            # Check for zero std
1500            if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1501                feature_std = counts.iloc[i].std()
1502            else:
1503                # Array or sparse matrix
1504                if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1505                    feature_std = np.std(counts[i, :].toarray())
1506                else:
1507                    feature_std = np.std(counts[i, :])
1508
1509            if feature_std == 0:
1510                continue  # Skip zero-std features
1511
1512            features_to_keep.append(i)
1513
1514        if len(features_to_keep) == 0:
1515            raise ValueError(f"No features left in '{modality_name}' after filtering!")
1516
1517        # Filter counts and metadata
1518        counts_trans, mod_feature_meta = self._filter_features(counts, feature_meta, features_to_keep)
1519
1520        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1521        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1522            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1523        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1524            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1525                raise ValueError(
1526                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1527                )
1528            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1529        else:
1530            warnings.warn(
1531                f"Creating '{modality_name}' modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1532                UserWarning
1533            )
1534            cell_names = None
1535
1536        # Extract feature names for feature_names (prefer feature_name, then feature, then gene_name, then gene)
1537        feature_names_for_modality = None
1538        for col in ['feature_name', 'feature', 'gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
1539            if col in mod_feature_meta.columns:
1540                feature_names_for_modality = mod_feature_meta[col].tolist()
1541                break
1542
1543        self.modalities[modality_name] = Modality(
1544            name=modality_name,
1545            counts=counts_trans,
1546            feature_meta=mod_feature_meta,
1547            cell_names=cell_names,
1548            distribution='negbinom',
1549            cells_axis=1,
1550            feature_names=feature_names_for_modality,
1551            min_count=min_count,
1552        )
1553
1554    def _create_gene_modality(
1555        self,
1556        counts,
1557        cis_gene: Optional[str] = None,
1558        cis_gene_idx: Optional[int] = None,
1559        gene_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1560        meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1561        min_count: int = 1,
1562    ):
1563        """
1564        Create 'gene' modality from gene counts (excluding cis gene if specified).
1565
1566        Parameters
1567        ----------
1568        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1569            Gene counts (genes × cells)
1570        cis_gene : str, optional
1571            If provided, this gene will be excluded from the gene modality
1572        cis_gene_idx : int, optional
1573            Numeric row index of cis gene (for exclusion when counts has numeric index)
1574        gene_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1575            Gene metadata. If None, creates minimal metadata from counts.index
1576        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1577            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Used to get cell names if counts is not a DataFrame.
1578        """
1579        if 'gene' in self.modalities:
1580            warnings.warn("Gene modality already exists. Overwriting.")
1581
1582        # Prepare gene metadata
1583        if gene_meta is None:
1584            # Auto-create from DataFrame index if available, else require it for arrays
1585            if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1586                # Check if DataFrame has meaningful gene names as index
1587                if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1588                    # Numeric index - no gene names available
1589                    raise ValueError(
1590                        "counts has numeric index but no gene_meta provided. "
1591                        "Either:\n"
1592                        "  1. Provide gene_meta with gene names/IDs, OR\n"
1593                        "  2. Set gene names as counts.index before initialization"
1594                    )
1595                else:
1596                    # String-based index - extract gene names
1597                    print(f"[INFO] No gene_meta provided - creating from counts.index")
1598                    gene_names = counts.index.tolist()
1599                    gene_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1600                        'gene_name': gene_names,
1601                        'gene': gene_names  # Also store in 'gene' column for compatibility
1602                    }, index=range(len(gene_names)))
1603            else:
1604                # Array or sparse matrix - gene_meta is REQUIRED
1605                raise ValueError(
1606                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, gene_meta must be provided. "
1607                    "gene_meta should contain gene names/IDs to enable plotting and analysis."
1608                )
1609        else:
1610            # gene_meta provided - ensure it has numeric index and required columns
1611            if len(gene_meta) != counts.shape[0]:
1612                raise ValueError(
1613                    f"gene_meta has {len(gene_meta)} rows but counts has {counts.shape[0]} rows. "
1614                    f"They must match (row i in counts = row i in gene_meta)."
1615                )
1616            gene_meta = gene_meta.copy()
1617
1618            # Ensure at least one gene identifier column exists
1619            gene_id_cols = ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'ens_id']
1620            has_gene_col = any(col in gene_meta.columns for col in gene_id_cols)
1621
1622            if not has_gene_col:
1623                # If DataFrame with string index, try to extract from there
1624                if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame) and not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1625                    print(f"[INFO] gene_meta has no gene identifier columns - adding 'gene_name' from counts.index")
1626                    gene_meta['gene_name'] = counts.index.tolist()
1627                    gene_meta['gene'] = counts.index.tolist()
1628                else:
1629                    warnings.warn(
1630                        "gene_meta has no gene identifier columns (gene_name, gene, gene_id, ens_id). "
1631                        "Plotting by gene name will not work.",
1632                        UserWarning
1633                    )
1634
1635            gene_meta.index = range(len(gene_meta))  # Reset to numeric
1636
1637        # Pre-compute row standard deviations for all formats (dense, scipy sparse, pandas sparse).
1638        # Vectorised: avoids 31K per-row conversions in the loop below.
1639        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1640            if isinstance(counts.dtypes.iloc[0], pd.SparseDtype):
1641                # Pandas sparse DataFrame — convert to scipy sparse for vectorised std
1642                _sp = counts.sparse.to_coo().tocsr().astype(float)
1643                _mean = np.array(_sp.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1644                _sp2 = _sp.copy()
1645                _sp2.data **= 2
1646                _sq_mean = np.array(_sp2.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1647                row_stds = np.sqrt(np.maximum(_sq_mean - _mean ** 2, 0))
1648            else:
1649                # Regular dense DataFrame
1650                row_stds = counts.std(axis=1).values
1651        elif hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1652            # Scipy sparse matrix
1653            _sp = counts.astype(float)
1654            _mean = np.array(_sp.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1655            _sp2 = _sp.copy()
1656            _sp2.data **= 2
1657            _sq_mean = np.array(_sp2.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1658            row_stds = np.sqrt(np.maximum(_sq_mean - _mean ** 2, 0))
1659        else:
1660            # Dense numpy array
1661            row_stds = counts.std(axis=1)
1662
1663        # Build list of features to keep
1664        features_to_keep = []
1665
1666        for i in range(len(gene_meta)):
1667            # Skip cis gene
1668            if i == cis_gene_idx:
1669                continue
1670
1671            # Skip zero-std genes
1672            if row_stds[i] == 0:
1673                continue
1674
1675            features_to_keep.append(i)
1676
1677        if len(features_to_keep) == 0:
1678            raise ValueError("No genes left after filtering!")
1679
1680        # Filter counts and metadata
1681        counts_trans, gene_feature_meta = self._filter_features(counts, gene_meta, features_to_keep)
1682
1683        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1684        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1685            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1686        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1687            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1688                raise ValueError(
1689                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1690                )
1691            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1692        else:
1693            warnings.warn(
1694                "Creating 'gene' modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1695                UserWarning
1696            )
1697            cell_names = None
1698
1699        # Extract gene names for feature_names (prefer gene_name, then gene column)
1700        gene_names_for_modality = None
1701        for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id']:
1702            if col in gene_feature_meta.columns:
1703                gene_names_for_modality = gene_feature_meta[col].tolist()
1704                break
1705
1706        self.modalities['gene'] = Modality(
1707            name='gene',
1708            counts=counts_trans,
1709            feature_meta=gene_feature_meta,
1710            cell_names=cell_names,
1711            distribution='negbinom',
1712            cells_axis=1,
1713            feature_names=gene_names_for_modality,
1714            min_count=min_count,
1715        )
1716
1717    def add_modality(
1718        self,
1719        name: str,
1720        modality: Modality,
1721        overwrite: bool = False
1722    ):
1723        """
1724        Add a new modality.
1725
1726        Parameters
1727        ----------
1728        name : str
1729            Modality name
1730        modality : Modality
1731            Modality object
1732        overwrite : bool
1733            Whether to overwrite existing modality with same name
1734        """
1735        if name in self.modalities and not overwrite:
1736            raise ValueError(f"Modality '{name}' already exists. Use overwrite=True to replace it.")
1737
1738        # Negbinom modalities require their own sum_factors for normalisation.
1739        # Primary and cis share the same DataFrame (handled by _init_sum_factors),
1740        # but all other negbinom modalities must have sum_factors set explicitly
1741        # by the caller before fit_trans() is called on them.
1742        if (modality.distribution == 'negbinom'
1743                and modality.sum_factors is None
1744                and name not in (self.primary_modality, 'cis')):
1745            import warnings
1746            warnings.warn(
1747                f"Negbinom modality '{name}' has no sum_factors set. "
1748                f"You must assign modality.sum_factors (a cell-indexed DataFrame) "
1749                f"before calling fit_trans() on this modality.",
1750                UserWarning,
1751                stacklevel=2,
1752            )
1753
1754        self.modalities[name] = modality
1755        print(f"[INFO] Added modality '{name}': {modality}")
1756
1757    def get_modality(self, name: str) -> Modality:
1758        """Get a modality by name."""
1759        if name not in self.modalities:
1760            raise KeyError(f"Modality '{name}' not found. Available: {list(self.modalities.keys())}")
1761        return self.modalities[name]
1762
1763    def list_modalities(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
1764        """
1765        List all modalities with fitting status.
1766
1767        Returns
1768        -------
1769        pd.DataFrame
1770            Summary of modalities with columns:
1771            - name: Modality name
1772            - distribution: Distribution type
1773            - n_features: Number of features
1774            - n_cells: Number of cells
1775            - fit_ntc: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted, - if not configured
1776            - fit_cis: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted, - if not applicable
1777            - fit_trans: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted
1778
1779        Notes
1780        -----
1781        fit_ntc shows:
1782        - '-' if technical_group_code not set (no technical covariates configured)
1783        - '✗' if technical_group_code set but fit_ntc() not run
1784        - '✓' if fit_ntc() completed
1785        """
1786        if not self.modalities:
1787            return pd.DataFrame(columns=['name', 'distribution', 'n_features', 'n_cells',
1788                                        'fit_ntc', 'fit_cis', 'fit_trans'])
1789
1790        # Check if technical groups are configured
1791        has_technical_groups = 'technical_group_code' in self.meta.columns
1792
1793        rows = []
1794        for name, mod in self.modalities.items():
1795            # Check fitting status for technical fit
1796            # Only show as needed (✓/✗) if technical groups are configured
1797            if not has_technical_groups:
1798                has_technical = '-'  # Not configured/not needed
1799            else:
1800                # For 'cis' modality: check primary modality's technical fit status
1801                # (cis gene was included in primary modality's technical fit)
1802                if name == 'cis' and self.primary_modality in self.modalities:
1803                    primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
1804                    has_technical = '✓' if primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None else '✗'
1805                else:
1806                    has_technical = '✓' if mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None else '✗'
1807
1808            # fit_cis only applies to 'cis' modality
1809            if name == 'cis':
1810                # x_true is stored on the main model, not on the modality
1811                has_cis = '✓' if getattr(self, 'x_true', None) is not None else '✗'
1812            else:
1813                has_cis = '-'  # Not applicable
1814
1815            # fit_trans only applies to trans modalities, not to 'cis'
1816            if name == 'cis':
1817                has_trans = '-'  # Not applicable - cis is the predictor, not a trans response
1818            else:
1819                has_trans = '✓' if mod.posterior_samples_trans is not None else '✗'
1820
1821            rows.append({
1822                'name': name,
1823                'distribution': mod.distribution,
1824                'n_features': mod.dims['n_features'],
1825                'n_cells': mod.dims['n_cells'],
1826                'fit_ntc': has_technical,
1827                'fit_cis': has_cis,
1828                'fit_trans': has_trans
1829            })
1830        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
1831

1835    # _BayesDREAMCore; no documentation lives in this block.
