1922    def __repr__(self) -> str:
1923        """String representation."""
1924        n_cells = len(self.meta)
1925        n_modalities = len(self.modalities)
1926        modality_names = ', '.join(self.modalities.keys())
1927
1928        return (
1929            f"bayesDREAM(\n"
1930            f"  cis_gene='{self.cis_gene}',\n"
1931            f"  n_cells={n_cells},\n"
1932            f"  n_modalities={n_modalities},\n"
1933            f"  modalities=[{modality_names}],\n"
1934            f"  primary_modality='{self.primary_modality}',\n"
1935            f"  device={self.device}\n"
1936            f")"
1937        )
class bayesDREAM(bayesDREAM.modalities.plotting_mixin.PlottingMixin, bayesDREAM.modalities.transcript.TranscriptModalityMixin, bayesDREAM.modalities.splicing_modality.SplicingModalityMixin, bayesDREAM.modalities.atac.ATACModalityMixin, bayesDREAM.modalities.custom.CustomModalityMixin, bayesDREAM.core._BayesDREAMCore): 
  38class bayesDREAM(
  39    PlottingMixin,
  40    TranscriptModalityMixin,
  41    SplicingModalityMixin,
  42    ATACModalityMixin,
  43    CustomModalityMixin,
  44    _BayesDREAMCore
  45):
  46    """
  47    bayesDREAM: Bayesian Dosage Response Effects Across Modalities
  48
  49    A three-step Bayesian framework for modeling perturbation effects across
  50    multiple molecular modalities including genes, transcripts, splicing, and
  51    custom measurements.
  52
  53    Supports:
  54    - Gene counts (negbinom) - the default/primary modality
  55    - Transcript counts (negbinom or multinomial for isoform usage)
  56    - Splice junction counts with donor/acceptor/exon skipping (multinomial/binomial)
  57    - ATAC-seq peaks (negbinom or binomial)
  58    - Custom modalities with user-specified distributions
  59
  60    Attributes
  61    ----------
  62    modalities : Dict[str, Modality]
  63        Dictionary of all modalities. 'gene' is the primary modality.
  64    primary_modality : str
  65        Name of primary modality used for cis/trans analysis (default: 'gene')
  66    """
  67
  68    def __init__(
  69        self,
  70        meta: pd.DataFrame,
  71        counts: pd.DataFrame = None,
  72        modality_name: str = 'gene',
  73        feature_meta: pd.DataFrame = None,
  74        cis_gene: str = None,
  75        cis_feature: str = None,
  76        guide_assignment: np.ndarray = None,
  77        guide_meta: pd.DataFrame = None,
  78        guide_target: pd.DataFrame = None,
  79        guide_covariates: list = None,
  80        guide_covariates_ntc: list = None,
  81        sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor',
  82        output_dir: str = "./model_out",
  83        label: str = None,
  84        device: str = None,
  85        random_seed: int = 2402,
  86        cores: int = 1,
  87        exclude_targets: list = None,
  88        exclude_guides: list = None,
  89        require_ntc: bool = True,
  90        min_count: int = 1,
  91        color_scheme: 'ColorScheme' = None,
  92    ):
  93        """
  94        Initialize bayesDREAM.
  95
  96        Parameters
  97        ----------
  98        meta : pd.DataFrame
  99            Cell-level metadata with columns: cell, guide, target, sum_factor, etc.
 100        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix, optional
 101            Count matrix for the primary modality (features × cells). This will be used
 102            for trans modeling and must represent negbinom count data.
 103
 104            Accepts:
 105            - pd.DataFrame: Features as index, cells as columns
 106            - np.ndarray or scipy.sparse matrix: Features as rows, cells as columns
 107              (requires feature_meta to map feature names)
 108
 109            The modality_name parameter determines how this data is interpreted:
 110            - 'gene': Gene expression counts (most common)
 111            - 'atac': ATAC-seq peak counts
 112            - Custom name: User-defined count modality
 113
 114            Additional modalities can be added after initialization using add_*_modality() methods.
 115        modality_name : str, default='gene'
 116            Name/type of the primary modality provided in counts parameter.
 117
 118            Pre-set types:
 119            - 'gene': Gene expression (default, use with feature_meta for gene annotations)
 120            - 'atac': ATAC-seq peaks
 121
 122            Custom types:
 123            - Any string: Creates a custom negbinom modality with that name
 124
 125            The primary modality MUST be negative binomial (count data) for cis/trans modeling.
 126        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
 127            Feature-level metadata for the primary modality.
 128
 129            For modality_name='gene':
 130            - Recommended columns: 'gene', 'gene_name', 'gene_id'
 131            - If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index
 132
 133            For other modalities:
 134            - Should contain relevant feature annotations
 135            - If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index
 136        cis_gene : str, optional
 137            Feature to extract as 'cis' modality. When modality_name='gene', this is
 138            a gene name (e.g., 'GFI1B'). For other modality types, use cis_feature instead.
 139
 140            The cis feature will be:
 141            1. Extracted as a separate 'cis' modality (1 feature)
 142            2. Removed from the primary modality (which becomes trans-only)
 143            3. Used for cis effect modeling in fit_cis()
 144        cis_feature : str, optional
 145            Alternative to cis_gene for non-gene modalities. Specifies which feature
 146            to extract as the 'cis' modality.
 147        guide_assignment : np.ndarray, optional
 148            Binary matrix (cells × guides) for high MOI mode. Each cell can have
 149            multiple guides. If provided, meta should NOT have 'guide' or 'target'
 150            columns. Must be provided together with guide_meta.
 151        guide_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
 152            Guide metadata for high MOI mode. Required columns: 'guide', 'target'.
 153            Must be provided together with guide_assignment. Index should match
 154            guide order in guide_assignment matrix.
 155        guide_covariates : list, optional
 156            Covariates for guide grouping (e.g., ['cell_line', 'batch'])
 157        guide_covariates_ntc : list, optional
 158            Covariates for NTC guide grouping (if different from guide_covariates)
 159        sum_factor_col : str, default='sum_factor'
 160            Column name in meta containing size factors
 161        output_dir : str, default="./model_out"
 162            Output directory for saving results
 163        label : str, optional
 164            Run label for organizing outputs
 165        device : str, optional
 166            'cpu' or 'cuda'. If None, auto-detects.
 167        random_seed : int, default=2402
 168            Random seed for reproducibility
 169        cores : int, default=1
 170            Number of CPU cores for parallel operations
 171        color_scheme : ColorScheme, optional
 172            Color scheme for visualizations. If None, auto-built from model
 173            metadata via ``ColorScheme.from_model(self)`` after initialization.
 174            Can also be set later via ``set_color_scheme()``.
 175
 176        Raises
 177        ------
 178        ValueError
 179            - If cis_feature is specified but counts is None
 180            - If cis_feature not found in counts
 181            - If cis_feature has zero variance
 182            - If primary modality would be empty after filtering
 183
 184        Examples
 185        --------
 186        Basic gene expression analysis:
 187        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 188        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 189        ...     counts=gene_counts,
 190        ...     cis_gene='GFI1B'
 191        ... )
 192
 193        With gene metadata:
 194        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 195        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 196        ...     counts=gene_counts,
 197        ...     feature_meta=gene_metadata,
 198        ...     cis_gene='GFI1B',
 199        ...     guide_covariates=['cell_line']
 200        ... )
 201
 202        ATAC-seq analysis:
 203        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 204        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 205        ...     counts=atac_counts,
 206        ...     modality_name='atac',
 207        ...     feature_meta=peak_metadata,
 208        ...     cis_feature='chr9:132283881-132284881'
 209        ... )
 210
 211        Custom modality:
 212        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
 213        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
 214        ...     counts=my_counts,
 215        ...     modality_name='my_custom_modality',
 216        ...     cis_feature='feature_123'
 217        ... )
 218
 219        Notes
 220        -----
 221        - The 'cis' modality is ONLY extracted during initialization from the primary modality
 222        - When you call add_*_modality() methods later, NO cis extraction occurs
 223        - The primary modality MUST be negbinom (count data) for cis/trans modeling
 224        - Additional modalities (transcripts, splicing, etc.) are added via add_*_modality() methods
 225        """
 226        # Initialize modalities dict (always start empty, build from counts)
 227        self.modalities = {}
 228
 229        # Resolve cis_feature: cis_gene is an alias for cis_feature when modality_name='gene'
 230        if cis_gene is not None and cis_feature is not None:
 231            raise ValueError("Provide either cis_gene or cis_feature, not both")
 232        if cis_gene is not None:
 233            if modality_name != 'gene':
 234                warnings.warn(
 235                    f"cis_gene parameter is intended for modality_name='gene'. "
 236                    f"You have modality_name='{modality_name}'. Use cis_feature instead.",
 237                    UserWarning
 238                )
 239            cis_feature = cis_gene
 240
 241        # Store min_count for use in modality creation
 242        self.min_count = min_count
 243
 244        # Store original counts for base class initialization
 245        counts_for_base = counts
 246
 247        # Validate that counts is provided if cis_feature is specified
 248        if cis_feature is not None and counts is None:
 249            raise ValueError("Cannot specify cis_feature without providing counts")
 250
 251        # Extract 'cis' modality from primary modality (if both counts and cis_feature provided)
 252        # Keep the original gene name and track numeric position
 253        cis_numeric_idx = None
 254        if counts is not None and cis_feature is not None:
 255            if modality_name == 'gene':
 256                cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx = self._extract_cis_from_gene(counts, cis_feature, feature_meta, meta)
 257            else:
 258                # Generic cis extraction for any negbinom modality
 259                cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx = self._extract_cis_generic(counts, cis_feature, modality_name, feature_meta, meta)
 260
 261        # Create primary modality
 262        if counts is not None:
 263            if modality_name == 'gene':
 264                # Use gene-specific creation (with gene_meta handling)
 265                # Pass both the name and numeric index for exclusion
 266                self._create_gene_modality(counts, cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx, gene_meta=feature_meta, meta=meta, min_count=min_count)
 267            else:
 268                # Generic negbinom modality creation
 269                self._create_negbinom_modality(counts, modality_name, cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx, feature_meta, meta, min_count=min_count)
 270
 271        # Store primary modality name
 272        self.primary_modality = modality_name
 273
 274        # ========================================================================
 275        # CRITICAL VALIDATION: Primary modality MUST be negative binomial
 276        # ========================================================================
 277        if modality_name in self.modalities:
 278            primary_distribution = self.modalities[modality_name].distribution
 279            if primary_distribution != 'negbinom':
 280                raise ValueError(
 281                    f"Primary modality '{modality_name}' has distribution '{primary_distribution}', "
 282                    f"but bayesDREAM requires primary modality to be 'negbinom' for cis/trans modeling. "
 283                    f"The primary modality must represent count data that follows a negative binomial distribution."
 284                )
 285        elif counts is None:
 286            # No counts provided - user will add modalities later
 287            warnings.warn(
 288                f"No counts provided during initialization. Primary modality '{modality_name}' must be added "
 289                f"via add_custom_modality() with distribution='negbinom' before fitting.",
 290                UserWarning
 291            )
 292
 293        # Get counts for base class initialization
 294        # IMPORTANT: Pass counts matrix as-is to avoid densification
 295        # core.py will handle matrix/array/DataFrame uniformly
 296        if counts_for_base is None:
 297            if modality_name in self.modalities:
 298                # Get from modality - prefer original counts over count_df
 299                mod = self.modalities[modality_name]
 300                primary_counts = mod.counts  # This is the matrix/array, not densified
 301            else:
 302                # No counts and no primary modality - create placeholder
 303                pass
 304                # Create minimal placeholder (will be replaced)
 305                primary_counts = np.ones((1, len(meta)))
 306        else:
 307            # Use original counts as-is (matrix, array, or DataFrame)
 308            primary_counts = counts_for_base
 309
 310        # Prepare gene_meta for base class
 311        # Only pass feature_meta as gene_meta if modality_name is 'gene', otherwise None
 312        gene_meta_for_base = feature_meta if modality_name == 'gene' else None
 313
 314        # Initialize base bayesDREAM with original counts (including cis feature)
 315        super().__init__(
 316            meta=meta,
 317            counts=primary_counts,
 318            gene_meta=gene_meta_for_base,
 319            cis_gene=cis_feature,  # Pass resolved cis_feature as cis_gene
 320            guide_assignment=guide_assignment,
 321            guide_meta=guide_meta,
 322            guide_target=guide_target,
 323            guide_covariates=guide_covariates,
 324            guide_covariates_ntc=guide_covariates_ntc,
 325            sum_factor_col=sum_factor_col,
 326            output_dir=output_dir,
 327            label=label,
 328            device=device,
 329            random_seed=random_seed,
 330            cores=cores,
 331            exclude_targets=exclude_targets,
 332            exclude_guides=exclude_guides,
 333            require_ntc=require_ntc
 334        )
 335
 336        # Subset all modalities to match filtered cells from base class
 337        # Base class (super().__init__) has filtered self.meta to valid cells
 338        valid_cells = self.meta['cell'].tolist()
 339        for mod_name in list(self.modalities.keys()):
 340            mod = self.modalities[mod_name]
 341            if mod.cell_names is not None:
 342                # Find indices of valid cells in this modality
 343                cell_indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(mod.cell_names)
 344                              if c in valid_cells]
 345                if len(cell_indices) < len(mod.cell_names):
 346                    self.modalities[mod_name] = mod.get_cell_subset(cell_indices)
 347
 348        print(f"bayesDREAM: label={self.label}, device={self.device}, {len(self.modalities)} modalities")
 349        for name, mod in self.modalities.items():
 350            print(f"  - {name}: {mod}")
 351
 352        # Store sum_factor_col so add_cis_gene() can re-init sum_factors after cell subsetting.
 353        self._sum_factor_col = sum_factor_col
 354
 355        # Initialise sum_factors on all negbinom modalities from meta.
 356        # Must run AFTER super().__init__() and cell subsetting so self.meta is final.
 357        self._init_sum_factors(sum_factor_col)
 358
 359        # Colour scheme — user-supplied or auto-built from model metadata.
 360        # Must run AFTER super().__init__() so self.meta / guide_meta are final.
 361        if color_scheme is not None:
 362            self.color_scheme = color_scheme
 363        else:
 364            self.color_scheme = ColorScheme.from_model(self)
 365
 366    def set_color_scheme(self, color_scheme: 'ColorScheme'):
 367        """
 368        Replace the model's color scheme.
 369
 370        Parameters
 371        ----------
 372        color_scheme : ColorScheme
 373            New color scheme to use for all visualizations.
 374        """
 375        self.color_scheme = color_scheme
 376
 377    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 378    # Deferred cis-gene specification
 379    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
 380
 381    def add_cis_gene(self, cis_gene: str) -> None:
 382        """
 383        Specify the cis gene after initialization and prepare the model for cis/trans fitting.
 384
 385        Intended for workflows where fit_ntc() (and optionally adjust_ntc_sum_factor())
 386        should be run once before the cis gene is committed, avoiding a separate technical-fit
 387        run per gene.
 388
 389        The method:
 390        1. Finds and extracts the cis gene from the primary modality, creating the 'cis' modality.
 391        2. Subsets cells to NTC + cis-targeting cells only.
 392        3. Re-filters features that become zero-count after cell subsetting; if fit_ntc() has
 393           already been run, trims matching feature axes in the stored posteriors.
 394        4. If fit_ntc() has already been run, extracts the cis gene's overdispersion parameters
 395           from the primary modality posteriors into the 'cis' modality (equivalent to having
 396           set cis_gene at init time).
 397        5. Recomputes guide_code for compact indexing over the retained cells.
 398        6. Reinitialises sum_factors on the (now-final) cell set.
 399
 400        Parameters
 401        ----------
 402        cis_gene : str
 403            Name of the cis gene (must exist in the primary modality's feature_meta).
 404
 405        Raises
 406        ------
 407        ValueError
 408            If cis_gene is already set, if called in high-MOI mode, if the gene is not
 409            found, or if the gene has zero counts across NTC + cis cells.
 410        """
 411        if self.cis_gene is not None:
 412            raise ValueError(
 413                f"cis_gene is already set to '{self.cis_gene}'. Cannot call add_cis_gene() again."
 414            )
 415        if self.is_high_moi:
 416            raise ValueError(
 417                "add_cis_gene() is not supported in high-MOI mode. "
 418                "Provide cis_gene at initialization time."
 419            )
 420        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 421            raise ValueError("'cis' modality already exists.")
 422
 423        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
 424        n_total_features = primary_mod.dims['n_features']
 425
 426        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 427        # Step 1: locate the cis gene in the primary modality feature_meta
 428        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 429        gene_col = None
 430        for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
 431            if col in primary_mod.feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in primary_mod.feature_meta[col].values:
 432                gene_col = col
 433                break
 434
 435        if gene_col is None:
 436            raise ValueError(
 437                f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in primary modality feature_meta. "
 438                f"Tried columns: gene_name, gene, gene_id, feature_id. "
 439                f"Available columns: {list(primary_mod.feature_meta.columns)}"
 440            )
 441
 442        match_mask = primary_mod.feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene
 443        cis_feat_iloc = int(np.where(match_mask.values)[0][0])
 444
 445        print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: found '{cis_gene}' at feature iloc {cis_feat_iloc} "
 446              f"in primary modality (of {n_total_features} features)")
 447
 448        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 449        # Step 2: extract cis gene counts from primary modality
 450        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 451        if primary_mod.cells_axis == 1:
 452            cis_counts = primary_mod.counts[[cis_feat_iloc], :]
 453        else:
 454            cis_counts = primary_mod.counts[:, [cis_feat_iloc]]
 455
 456        cis_feature_meta = primary_mod.feature_meta.iloc[[cis_feat_iloc]].copy()
 457        cis_feature_meta.index = [0]
 458        if 'gene' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
 459            cis_feature_meta['gene'] = cis_gene
 460        if 'gene_name' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
 461            cis_feature_meta['gene_name'] = cis_gene
 462
 463        self.modalities['cis'] = Modality(
 464            name='cis',
 465            counts=cis_counts,
 466            feature_meta=cis_feature_meta,
 467            cell_names=primary_mod.cell_names,
 468            distribution='negbinom',
 469            cells_axis=primary_mod.cells_axis,
 470            min_count=self.min_count,
 471        )
 472
 473        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 474        # Step 3: if fit_ntc already ran, extract cis posteriors from primary
 475        #         BEFORE we remove the cis feature row (while indices still align)
 476        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 477        ntc_ran = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
 478
 479        if ntc_ran:
 480            self._extract_cis_alpha_from_ntc_posteriors(cis_gene, cis_feat_iloc, n_total_features)
 481
 482        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 483        # Step 4: remove cis gene from primary modality
 484        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 485        trans_idx = list(range(cis_feat_iloc)) + list(range(cis_feat_iloc + 1, n_total_features))
 486
 487        if primary_mod.cells_axis == 1:
 488            trans_counts = primary_mod.counts[trans_idx, :]
 489        else:
 490            trans_counts = primary_mod.counts[:, trans_idx]
 491
 492        trans_feature_meta = primary_mod.feature_meta.iloc[trans_idx].copy()
 493        trans_feature_meta.index = range(len(trans_idx))
 494
 495        trans_feature_names = (
 496            [primary_mod.feature_names[i] for i in trans_idx]
 497            if primary_mod.feature_names is not None else None
 498        )
 499
 500        new_primary_mod = Modality(
 501            name=self.primary_modality,
 502            counts=trans_counts,
 503            feature_meta=trans_feature_meta,
 504            distribution=primary_mod.distribution,
 505            cells_axis=primary_mod.cells_axis,
 506            feature_names=trans_feature_names,
 507            cell_names=primary_mod.cell_names,
 508            min_count=primary_mod.min_count,
 509        )
 510
 511        # Transfer already-trimmed fitting results to the new primary modality object
 512        if ntc_ran:
 513            new_primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 514            new_primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
 515            new_primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
 516            if hasattr(primary_mod, 'loss_ntc'):
 517                new_primary_mod.loss_ntc = primary_mod.loss_ntc
 518
 519        self.modalities[self.primary_modality] = new_primary_mod
 520        self.cis_gene = cis_gene
 521
 522        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 523        # Step 5: subset cells to NTC + cis
 524        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 525        valid_cells = set(self.meta[self.meta['target'].isin(['ntc', cis_gene])]['cell'].unique())
 526        n_before = len(self.meta)
 527        self.meta = self.meta[self.meta['cell'].isin(valid_cells)].copy()
 528        n_after = len(self.meta)
 529        if n_after < n_before:
 530            print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: cells {n_before} → {n_after} (kept NTC + {cis_gene} only)")
 531
 532        for mod_name in list(self.modalities.keys()):
 533            mod = self.modalities[mod_name]
 534            if mod.cell_names is not None:
 535                cell_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(mod.cell_names) if c in valid_cells]
 536                if len(cell_idx) < len(mod.cell_names):
 537                    new_mod = mod.get_cell_subset(cell_idx)
 538                    # Forward fitting results to cell-subsetted copy
 539                    new_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 540                    new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult    = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
 541                    new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add     = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
 542                    if hasattr(mod, 'loss_ntc'):
 543                        new_mod.loss_ntc = mod.loss_ntc
 544                    self.modalities[mod_name] = new_mod
 545
 546        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 547        # Step 6: re-filter zero-count features after cell subsetting
 548        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 549        self._refilter_zero_count_features(ntc_ran)
 550
 551        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 552        # Step 7: recompute guide_code for compact indices over retained cells
 553        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 554        self.meta['guide_code'] = pd.Categorical(self.meta['guide_used']).codes
 555
 556        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 557        # Step 8: reinitialise sum_factors on the final cell set
 558        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 559        self._init_sum_factors(self._sum_factor_col)
 560
 561        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 562        # Step 9: rebuild color scheme
 563        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
 564        self.color_scheme = ColorScheme.from_model(self)
 565
 566        print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene('{cis_gene}') complete: {n_after} cells, "
 567              f"{self.modalities[self.primary_modality].dims['n_features']} trans features, "
 568              f"{'NTC posteriors transferred' if ntc_ran else 'fit_ntc() not yet run'}.")
 569
 570    def _extract_cis_alpha_from_ntc_posteriors(
 571        self, cis_gene: str, cis_feat_iloc: int, n_total_features: int
 572    ) -> None:
 573        """
 574        Extract cis gene overdispersion from primary modality NTC posteriors,
 575        populate the 'cis' modality's posterior_samples_ntc, and trim the cis
 576        gene's entry from the primary modality posteriors in-place.
 577
 578        Called by add_cis_gene() when fit_ntc() has already been run.
 579        """
 580        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
 581        ps = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc  # mutated in-place
 582
 583        T = n_total_features
 584        trans_idx = list(range(cis_feat_iloc)) + list(range(cis_feat_iloc + 1, T))
 585
 586        full_alpha_y_mult = ps.get('alpha_y_mult')
 587        full_alpha_y_add  = ps.get('alpha_y_add')
 588
 589        # alpha_x_prefit: median of the cis gene's alpha_y_mult samples → [C]
 590        if full_alpha_y_mult is not None and full_alpha_y_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 591            self.alpha_x_prefit = full_alpha_y_mult[..., cis_feat_iloc].median(dim=0).values
 592
 593        # alpha_y_prefit for primary modality (trans genes only)
 594        if primary_mod.distribution == 'negbinom':
 595            if full_alpha_y_mult is not None and full_alpha_y_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 596                primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = full_alpha_y_mult[..., trans_idx].median(dim=0).values
 597        else:
 598            if full_alpha_y_add is not None and full_alpha_y_add.shape[-1] == T:
 599                primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = full_alpha_y_add[..., trans_idx].median(dim=0).values
 600
 601        # Build cis modality's posterior_samples_ntc (matching what ntc.py produces)
 602        cis_modality = self.modalities['cis']
 603        cis_posterior = {}
 604        for src_key, dst_key in [
 605            ('log2_alpha_y', 'log2_alpha_x'), ('alpha_y_mul', 'alpha_x_mul'),
 606            ('delta_y_add', 'delta_x_add'),   ('o_y',         'o_x'),
 607            ('mu_ntc',      'mu_ntc'),
 608        ]:
 609            if src_key in ps and isinstance(ps[src_key], torch.Tensor):
 610                v = ps[src_key]
 611                if v.shape[-1] == T:
 612                    cis_posterior[dst_key] = v[..., cis_feat_iloc:cis_feat_iloc + 1]
 613
 614        if 'alpha_x_mul' in cis_posterior:
 615            raw = cis_posterior['alpha_x_mul']
 616            if raw.dim() == 3:
 617                S, Cminus1, _ = raw.shape
 618                cis_posterior['alpha_x_mult'] = torch.cat(
 619                    [torch.ones(S, 1, 1, device=raw.device), raw], dim=1)
 620                cis_posterior['alpha_x'] = cis_posterior['alpha_x_mult']
 621
 622        if 'delta_x_add' in cis_posterior:
 623            raw = cis_posterior['delta_x_add']
 624            if raw.dim() == 3:
 625                S, Cminus1, _ = raw.shape
 626                cis_posterior['alpha_x_add'] = torch.cat(
 627                    [torch.zeros(S, 1, 1, device=raw.device), raw], dim=1)
 628
 629        cis_modality.posterior_samples_ntc = cis_posterior
 630        print(f"[INFO] Extracted '{cis_gene}' posteriors from primary modality NTC fit")
 631
 632        # Trim cis gene row from primary modality posteriors in-place
 633        if full_alpha_y_mult is not None and full_alpha_y_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 634            ps['alpha_y_mult'] = full_alpha_y_mult[..., trans_idx]
 635            ps['alpha_y']      = ps['alpha_y_mult']
 636        if full_alpha_y_add is not None and full_alpha_y_add.shape[-1] == T:
 637            ps['alpha_y_add'] = full_alpha_y_add[..., trans_idx]
 638            if full_alpha_y_mult is None:
 639                ps['alpha_y'] = ps['alpha_y_add']
 640
 641        for key in ['log2_alpha_y', 'alpha_y_mul', 'delta_y_add', 'o_y', 'mu_ntc']:
 642            if key in ps and isinstance(ps[key], torch.Tensor):
 643                v = ps[key]
 644                if v.shape[-1] == T:
 645                    ps[key] = v[..., trans_idx]
 646
 647        print(f"[INFO] Trimmed '{cis_gene}' from primary modality posteriors "
 648              f"(T {T} → {len(trans_idx)})")
 649
 650    def _refilter_zero_count_features(self, ntc_ran: bool) -> None:
 651        """
 652        After cell subsetting in add_cis_gene(), drop features that have become
 653        zero-count across the retained NTC + cis cells.  If fit_ntc() has already
 654        been run, trim the corresponding axes in the stored NTC posteriors so they
 655        stay aligned with the surviving feature set.
 656
 657        Operates on every modality except 'cis' (which is a single feature and
 658        cannot usefully be dropped here).
 659        """
 660        for mod_name, mod in list(self.modalities.items()):
 661            if mod_name == 'cis':
 662                continue
 663
 664            n_features = mod.dims['n_features']
 665
 666            # Compute per-feature total counts (works for dense, sparse, multinomial)
 667            if mod.distribution == 'multinomial':
 668                raw = mod.counts  # [F, N, K]
 669                feature_sums = np.array(raw.sum(axis=(1, 2))).flatten()
 670            elif mod.cells_axis == 1:
 671                feature_sums = np.array(mod.counts.sum(axis=1)).flatten()
 672            else:
 673                feature_sums = np.array(mod.counts.sum(axis=0)).flatten()
 674
 675            keep_idx = np.where(feature_sums > 0)[0]
 676            n_dropped = n_features - len(keep_idx)
 677
 678            if n_dropped == 0:
 679                continue
 680
 681            print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: dropping {n_dropped} zero-count features "
 682                  f"from modality '{mod_name}' after cell subsetting")
 683
 684            # Trim posteriors on the existing modality object BEFORE creating subset
 685            if mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
 686                self._trim_feature_axis_in_posteriors(mod, keep_idx, n_features)
 687
 688            # Create feature-subsetted copy and re-attach fitting results
 689            new_mod = mod.get_feature_subset(keep_idx.tolist())
 690            new_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = mod.posterior_samples_ntc  # already trimmed
 691            new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult   = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
 692            new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add    = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
 693            if hasattr(mod, 'loss_ntc'):
 694                new_mod.loss_ntc = mod.loss_ntc
 695
 696            self.modalities[mod_name] = new_mod
 697
 698    @staticmethod
 699    def _trim_feature_axis_in_posteriors(
 700        mod: 'Modality', keep_idx: np.ndarray, T: int
 701    ) -> None:
 702        """
 703        Trim the feature (last) axis of every tensor in mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 704        and the alpha_y_prefit arrays to the surviving feature indices.
 705
 706        Mutates mod in-place; called before get_feature_subset() so the counts
 707        array still has T columns.
 708        """
 709        ps = mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 710        if ps is None:
 711            return
 712
 713        for key in list(ps.keys()):
 714            v = ps[key]
 715            if not isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
 716                continue
 717            if v.shape[-1] == T:
 718                ps[key] = v[..., keep_idx]
 719
 720        if mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None and mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult.shape[-1] == T:
 721            mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult[..., keep_idx]
 722
 723        if mod.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None and mod.alpha_y_prefit_add.shape[-1] == T:
 724            mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add[..., keep_idx]
 725
 726    def _init_sum_factors(self, sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor'):
 727        """
 728        Initialise sum_factors DataFrame on negbinom modalities from self.meta.
 729
 730        Copies every column whose name contains 'sum_factor' into a cell-indexed
 731        DataFrame stored on each negbinom modality.  The 'cis' modality (when
 732        present) receives a reference to the *same* DataFrame as the primary
 733        modality — not a copy — so that writes made via adjust_ntc_sum_factor()
 734        or refit_sumfactor() are immediately visible to both.
 735
 736        Called once at the end of __init__, after super().__init__() and cell
 737        subsetting so self.meta is in its final, filtered state.
 738        """
 739        if self.primary_modality not in self.modalities:
 740            return
 741
 742        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
 743        if primary_mod.distribution != 'negbinom':
 744            return
 745
 746        # Collect all sum-factor columns present in meta
 747        sf_cols = [c for c in self.meta.columns if 'sum_factor' in c.lower()]
 748        if sum_factor_col not in sf_cols and sum_factor_col in self.meta.columns:
 749            sf_cols.append(sum_factor_col)
 750
 751        if not sf_cols:
 752            primary_mod.sum_factors = pd.DataFrame(index=self.meta['cell'].values)
 753        else:
 754            sf_df = self.meta.set_index('cell')[sf_cols].copy()
 755            primary_mod.sum_factors = sf_df
 756
 757        # The 'cis' modality is a view of the primary — share the same DataFrame.
 758        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 759            self.modalities['cis'].sum_factors = primary_mod.sum_factors
 760
 761        print(f"[INIT] sum_factors initialised on '{self.primary_modality}' "
 762              f"with columns: {list(primary_mod.sum_factors.columns)}")
 763
 764    def _compute_ntc_log2_exprs_from_fit(self):
 765        """
 766        Per-gene log2 NTC expression using fit_ntc() posteriors.
 767
 768        fit_ntc() appends the cis gene as the last row of the counts matrix,
 769        fits it together with all trans genes, and stores the result in
 770        cis_modality.posterior_samples_ntc.  Both trans and cis mu_ntc
 771        values are therefore available here — no raw-count computation needed.
 772
 773        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run (populates posterior_samples_ntc
 774        on both the primary and cis modalities).
 775
 776        Returns
 777        -------
 778        dict with keys: all_log2_expr, cis_log2_expr, trans_log2_expr,
 779        cis_ntc_counts (raw counts for plot annotation only), n_ntc_cells.
 780        Or None on failure (warnings emitted).
 781        """
 782        import torch as _torch
 783
 784        primary_mod = self.modalities.get(self.primary_modality)
 785        cis_mod     = self.modalities.get('cis')
 786
 787        if primary_mod is None:
 788            warnings.warn(f"Primary modality '{self.primary_modality}' not found.", UserWarning)
 789            return None
 790
 791        ps_primary = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 792        if ps_primary is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps_primary:
 793            raise ValueError(
 794                "fit_ntc() must be run before checking cis expression. "
 795                "Call model.fit_ntc() first."
 796            )
 797
 798        if cis_mod is None:
 799            warnings.warn("No 'cis' modality found.", UserWarning)
 800            return None
 801
 802        ps_cis = cis_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
 803        if ps_cis is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps_cis:
 804            raise ValueError(
 805                "fit_ntc() did not produce mu_ntc for the cis modality. "
 806                "Ensure fit_ntc() completed successfully."
 807            )
 808
 809        def _to_numpy(t):
 810            if isinstance(t, _torch.Tensor):
 811                return t.mean(dim=0).detach().cpu().numpy().flatten()
 812            return np.asarray(t).mean(axis=0).flatten()
 813
 814        # Trans genes — NaN where features were excluded from fitting (zero NTC counts, etc.)
 815        log2_trans = np.log2(_to_numpy(ps_primary['mu_ntc']))
 816
 817        # Cis gene (shape [S, 1] → scalar after mean+flatten)
 818        cis_mu_ntc = float(_to_numpy(ps_cis['mu_ntc'])[0])
 819        cis_log2_expr = float(np.log2(cis_mu_ntc))
 820
 821        if not np.isfinite(cis_log2_expr):
 822            warnings.warn(
 823                f"Cis gene '{self.cis_gene}' has non-finite log2 NTC expression "
 824                f"(mu_ntc={cis_mu_ntc:.4g}). GMM check skipped.",
 825                UserWarning,
 826            )
 827            return None
 828
 829        # Drop non-finite trans values (NaN-filled excluded features, any -inf from mu=0)
 830        n_raw = len(log2_trans)
 831        log2_trans = log2_trans[np.isfinite(log2_trans)]
 832        n_dropped = n_raw - len(log2_trans)
 833        if n_dropped > 0:
 834            warnings.warn(
 835                f"{n_dropped} trans gene(s) excluded from GMM (non-finite log2 NTC expression, "
 836                f"likely zero-count features skipped during fit_ntc).",
 837                UserWarning,
 838            )
 839
 840        all_log2_expr = np.concatenate([log2_trans, [cis_log2_expr]])
 841
 842        # Raw NTC counts — used only for the plot title annotation, not for the GMM
 843        ntc_meta  = self.meta[self.meta.get('target', pd.Series()).eq('ntc')] \
 844                    if 'target' in self.meta.columns else self.meta.iloc[:0]
 845        ntc_cells = ntc_meta['cell'].values
 846        cell_to_col_cis = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(cis_mod.cell_names or [])}
 847        ntc_idx_cis = np.array([cell_to_col_cis[c] for c in ntc_cells if c in cell_to_col_cis], dtype=int)
 848        if len(ntc_idx_cis) > 0:
 849            cis_raw = cis_mod.counts
 850            if hasattr(cis_raw, 'toarray'):
 851                cis_ntc = np.asarray(cis_raw[0, ntc_idx_cis].toarray()).flatten().astype(float)
 852            elif isinstance(cis_raw, pd.DataFrame):
 853                cis_ntc = cis_raw.iloc[0, ntc_idx_cis].values.astype(float)
 854            else:
 855                cis_ntc = np.asarray(cis_raw)[0, ntc_idx_cis].astype(float)
 856        else:
 857            cis_ntc = np.array([])
 858
 859        return {
 860            'all_log2_expr':   all_log2_expr,
 861            'cis_log2_expr':   cis_log2_expr,
 862            'trans_log2_expr': log2_trans,
 863            'cis_ntc_counts':  cis_ntc,
 864            'n_ntc_cells':     len(ntc_idx_cis),
 865        }
 866
 867    def plot_ntc_expression(
 868        self,
 869        figsize: tuple = (7, 4),
 870        n_bins: int = 80,
 871        threshold: float = -1.0,
 872    ):
 873        """
 874        Histogram of per-gene log2 NTC expression with the cis gene marked.
 875
 876        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run first.  Useful for judging whether
 877        the cis gene is sufficiently expressed in NTC cells before running
 878        fit_cis().  fit_cis() raises a ValueError if the cis gene's log2 NTC
 879        expression is below ``threshold`` (default -1); this plot shows exactly
 880        where the gene falls relative to that cutoff.
 881
 882        Parameters
 883        ----------
 884        figsize : tuple, default (7, 4)
 885        n_bins : int, default 80
 886        threshold : float, default -1.0
 887            The log2 expression cutoff used by fit_cis() to flag unexpressed
 888            genes.  Drawn as a vertical dotted line for reference.
 889
 890        Returns
 891        -------
 892        matplotlib.figure.Figure
 893        """
 894        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 895
 896        data = self._compute_ntc_log2_exprs_from_fit()
 897        if data is None:
 898            raise ValueError("Ensure fit_ntc() has been run before plotting.")
 899
 900        all_expr  = data['all_log2_expr']
 901        cis_val   = data['cis_log2_expr']
 902        n_genes   = len(all_expr)
 903
 904        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
 905        ax.hist(all_expr, bins=n_bins, color='steelblue', alpha=0.6, edgecolor='none')
 906        ax.axvline(cis_val, color='red', lw=2, ls='--',
 907                   label=f'{self.cis_gene}  (log$_2$ = {cis_val:.2f})')
 908        ax.axvline(threshold, color='grey', lw=1.5, ls=':',
 909                   label=f'fit_cis threshold ({threshold})')
 910        ax.set_xlabel('log$_2$(NTC mean expression) from technical fit', fontsize=10)
 911        ax.set_ylabel('Number of genes', fontsize=10)
 912        ax.set_title(
 913            f'NTC expression — {self.cis_gene}  '
 914            f'({"BELOW" if cis_val < threshold else "above"} threshold)\n'
 915            f'{n_genes} genes, {data["n_ntc_cells"]} NTC cells',
 916            fontsize=9
 917        )
 918        ax.legend(fontsize=9)
 919        fig.tight_layout()
 920        return fig
 921
 922    def plot_ntc_overdispersion(
 923        self,
 924        modality_name: str = None,
 925        ax=None,
 926        figsize: tuple = (6, 5),
 927    ):
 928        """
 929        Scatter plot of log2(mu_ntc) vs log2(o_y) from the technical fit.
 930
 931        Highlights the cis gene in red.  Useful for diagnosing whether the
 932        cis gene falls in an unusual region of the mu_ntc–o_y relationship.
 933
 934        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run first.
 935
 936        Parameters
 937        ----------
 938        modality_name : str, optional
 939            Modality to plot (default: primary modality).
 940        ax : matplotlib.axes.Axes, optional
 941            Axes to draw on.  Creates a new figure if None.
 942        figsize : tuple, default=(6, 5)
 943            Figure size (width, height) in inches.
 944
 945        Returns
 946        -------
 947        matplotlib.figure.Figure
 948        """
 949        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 950
 951        if modality_name is None:
 952            modality_name = self.primary_modality
 953
 954        modality = self.get_modality(modality_name)
 955        ps = modality.posterior_samples_ntc
 956        if ps is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps or 'o_y' not in ps:
 957            raise ValueError(
 958                f"No technical fit found for modality '{modality_name}'. "
 959                "Run fit_ntc() first."
 960            )
 961
 962        # Extract posterior means — tensors may be [S, T] or [S, C, T]
 963        mu_ntc_raw = ps['mu_ntc'].mean(dim=0).detach().numpy()
 964        o_y_raw    = ps['o_y'].mean(dim=0).detach().numpy()
 965
 966        # Flatten multi-group tensors to 1D (take first group = NTC reference)
 967        mu_ntc = mu_ntc_raw.reshape(-1) if mu_ntc_raw.ndim == 1 else mu_ntc_raw[0]
 968        o_y    = o_y_raw.reshape(-1)    if o_y_raw.ndim == 1    else o_y_raw[0]
 969
 970        log2_mu = np.log2(np.clip(mu_ntc, 1e-8, None))
 971        log2_oy = np.log2(np.clip(o_y,    1e-8, None))
 972
 973        new_fig = ax is None
 974        if new_fig:
 975            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
 976        else:
 977            fig = ax.get_figure()
 978
 979        ax.scatter(log2_mu, log2_oy, alpha=0.25, s=4, c='steelblue', rasterized=True,
 980                   label='trans genes')
 981
 982        # Highlight cis gene if available
 983        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 984            cis_ps = self.modalities['cis'].posterior_samples_ntc
 985            if cis_ps is not None and 'mu_ntc' in cis_ps and 'o_x' in cis_ps:
 986                cis_mu = float(cis_ps['mu_ntc'].mean().item())
 987                cis_ox = float(cis_ps['o_x'].mean().item())
 988                ax.scatter(
 989                    np.log2(max(cis_mu, 1e-8)),
 990                    np.log2(max(cis_ox, 1e-8)),
 991                    s=120, c='red', zorder=10, marker='*',
 992                    label=f'{self.cis_gene}'
 993                )
 994
 995        ax.set_xlabel('log$_2$(mu_ntc)', fontsize=11)
 996        ax.set_ylabel('log$_2$(o_y)', fontsize=11)
 997        ax.set_title('Technical fit: NTC mean expression vs overdispersion', fontsize=11)
 998        ax.axhline(0, color='gray', lw=0.5, ls='--')
 999        ax.legend(fontsize=9, markerscale=1.5)
1000
1001        if new_fig:
1002            fig.tight_layout()
1003
1004        return fig
1005
1006    def _filter_features(self, counts, feature_meta, features_to_keep):
1007        """
1008        Filter features (rows) from counts matrix and feature_meta.
1009
1010        Works uniformly with DataFrame, numpy array, sparse matrix.
1011        Returns filtered counts and feature_meta with reset numeric indices.
1012
1013        Parameters
1014        ----------
1015        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1016            Count matrix (features × cells)
1017        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame
1018            Feature metadata (must have same number of rows as counts)
1019        features_to_keep : array-like of int
1020            Integer positions (iloc) of features to keep
1021
1022        Returns
1023        -------
1024        counts_filtered : same type as input
1025            Filtered counts matrix
1026        feature_meta_filtered : pd.DataFrame
1027            Filtered feature_meta with index reset to range(n_kept_features)
1028        """
1029        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1030            # DataFrame: use iloc
1031            counts_filtered = counts.iloc[features_to_keep].copy()
1032            # Reset index to numeric
1033            counts_filtered.index = range(len(features_to_keep))
1034        else:
1035            # Array or sparse matrix: use numpy indexing
1036            if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1037                # Sparse matrix
1038                counts_filtered = counts[features_to_keep, :]
1039            else:
1040                # Dense array
1041                counts_filtered = counts[features_to_keep, :]
1042
1043        # Filter and reset feature_meta index
1044        feature_meta_filtered = feature_meta.iloc[features_to_keep].copy()
1045        feature_meta_filtered.index = range(len(features_to_keep))
1046
1047        return counts_filtered, feature_meta_filtered
1048
1049    def _counts_to_dataframe(self, counts, feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, cell_names=None, keep_sparse=False):
1050        """
1051        Convert counts (DataFrame, array, or sparse matrix) to DataFrame.
1052
1053        WARNING: This method densifies sparse matrices by default. Use keep_sparse=True to
1054        return a dict with sparse matrix + metadata instead.
1055
1056        Parameters
1057        ----------
1058        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1059            Count matrix (features × cells)
1060        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1061            Feature metadata to use as index. If None, uses integer indices.
1062        cell_names : list, optional
1063            Cell names to use as columns. If None, uses integer indices.
1064        keep_sparse : bool, default=False
1065            If True and counts is sparse, returns dict with keys:
1066            {'counts': sparse_matrix, 'gene_names': list, 'cell_names': list}
1067            instead of densifying to DataFrame.
1068
1069        Returns
1070        -------
1071        pd.DataFrame or dict
1072            If keep_sparse=False: Counts as DataFrame
1073            If keep_sparse=True and input is sparse: dict with sparse data + metadata
1074        """
1075        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1076            if keep_sparse:
1077                # Already dense DataFrame, return as-is (no conversion to dict)
1078                return counts
1079            else:
1080                return counts
1081
1082        # Check if sparse
1083        from scipy import sparse
1084        is_sparse = sparse.issparse(counts)
1085
1086        if is_sparse and keep_sparse:
1087            # Return sparse matrix with metadata (do NOT densify)
1088            # Get feature names from feature_meta
1089            if feature_meta is not None:
1090                feature_names = feature_meta.index.tolist()
1091            else:
1092                feature_names = list(range(counts.shape[0]))
1093
1094            # Get cell names
1095            if cell_names is None:
1096                cell_names = list(range(counts.shape[1]))
1097
1098            return {
1099                'counts': counts,  # Keep sparse!
1100                'gene_names': feature_names,
1101                'cell_names': cell_names,
1102                'is_sparse': True
1103            }
1104
1105        # Convert to dense array if sparse (legacy behavior)
1106        if is_sparse:
1107            print(f"[WARNING] Densifying sparse matrix of shape {counts.shape} - this may use significant memory!")
1108            counts_array = counts.toarray()
1109        else:
1110            counts_array = counts
1111
1112        # Get cell names
1113        if cell_names is None:
1114            cell_names = list(range(counts_array.shape[1]))
1115
1116        # Use numeric index for features (not feature_meta.index)
1117        # This enables compatibility when Ensembl IDs or gene names have duplicates
1118        # Row i in DataFrame corresponds to row i in feature_meta
1119        feature_index = list(range(counts_array.shape[0]))
1120
1121        return pd.DataFrame(counts_array, index=feature_index, columns=cell_names)
1122
1123    def _extract_cis_from_gene(self, counts, cis_gene: str, feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None) -> tuple:
1124        """
1125        Extract 'cis' modality from gene counts.
1126
1127        Parameters
1128        ----------
1129        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1130            Gene counts (genes × cells)
1131        cis_gene : str
1132            Gene name to extract as cis modality
1133        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1134            Feature metadata with gene names. Required if counts is not a DataFrame.
1135        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1136            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Required if counts is not a DataFrame
1137            (used to get cell names for proper subsetting later).
1138
1139        Returns
1140        -------
1141        tuple (str, int)
1142            (original_gene_name, numeric_row_index)
1143            Returns the original gene name and the numeric row position
1144        """
1145        # Handle different count formats
1146        numeric_idx = None
1147
1148        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1149            # DataFrame: check if index is numeric or string-based
1150            if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1151                # Numeric index: use feature_meta to find gene
1152                if feature_meta is None:
1153                    raise ValueError(
1154                        f"counts has numeric index but no feature_meta provided to locate '{cis_gene}'"
1155                    )
1156                # Find gene in feature_meta columns (same order as core.py)
1157                gene_col = None
1158                for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
1159                    if col in feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in feature_meta[col].values:
1160                        gene_col = col
1161                        break
1162
1163                if gene_col is None:
1164                    raise ValueError(
1165                        f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in feature_meta columns: {list(feature_meta.columns)}"
1166                    )
1167
1168                # Get numeric position (iloc)
1169                numeric_idx = feature_meta[feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene].index[0]
1170                cis_counts = counts.iloc[[numeric_idx]].values
1171            else:
1172                # String-based index: use index directly
1173                if cis_gene not in counts.index:
1174                    raise ValueError(
1175                        f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in counts.index.\n"
1176                        f"Available genes: {counts.index[:10].tolist()}..."
1177                    )
1178                numeric_idx = counts.index.get_loc(cis_gene)
1179                cis_counts = counts.loc[[cis_gene]].values
1180        else:
1181            # Array or sparse matrix: use feature_meta
1182            if feature_meta is None:
1183                raise ValueError(
1184                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, feature_meta must be provided to locate cis_gene"
1185                )
1186
1187            # Find gene in feature_meta columns (same order as core.py)
1188            gene_col = None
1189            for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
1190                if col in feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in feature_meta[col].values:
1191                    gene_col = col
1192                    break
1193
1194            if gene_col is None:
1195                available_cols = list(feature_meta.columns)
1196                raise ValueError(
1197                    f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in feature_meta.\n"
1198                    f"Tried columns: gene_name, gene, gene_id, feature_id.\n"
1199                    f"Available columns: {available_cols}"
1200                )
1201
1202            # Get numeric position (iloc, which is the row number)
1203            numeric_idx = feature_meta[feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene].index[0]
1204
1205            # Extract row from counts (works for numpy arrays and sparse matrices)
1206            if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1207                # Sparse matrix
1208                cis_counts = counts[numeric_idx, :].toarray()
1209            else:
1210                # Dense matrix or numpy array
1211                cis_counts = counts[numeric_idx:numeric_idx+1, :]
1212
1213        # Check if cis gene has zero variance (critical for cis modeling)
1214        cis_gene_std = np.std(cis_counts)
1215        if cis_gene_std == 0:
1216            raise ValueError(
1217                f"Cis gene '{cis_gene}' has zero standard deviation across all cells. "
1218                f"Cannot model cis effects for a gene with constant expression."
1219            )
1220
1221        print(f"[INFO] Extracting 'cis' modality: {cis_gene}")
1222
1223        # Build cis_feature_meta: copy all columns from feature_meta row if available
1224        if feature_meta is not None:
1225            cis_feature_meta = feature_meta.iloc[[numeric_idx]].copy()
1226            cis_feature_meta.index = [numeric_idx]
1227            if 'gene' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
1228                cis_feature_meta['gene'] = cis_gene
1229            if 'gene_name' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
1230                cis_feature_meta['gene_name'] = cis_gene
1231        else:
1232            cis_feature_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1233                'gene': [cis_gene],
1234                'gene_name': [cis_gene],
1235            }, index=[numeric_idx])
1236
1237        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1238        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1239            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1240        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1241            # Array or sparse matrix - get cell names from meta
1242            # Ensure correct number of cells
1243            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1244                raise ValueError(
1245                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1246                )
1247            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1248        else:
1249            # No meta provided - will be None and subsetting will be skipped
1250            # This should not happen in normal usage
1251            warnings.warn(
1252                "Creating cis modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1253                UserWarning
1254            )
1255            cell_names = None
1256
1257        self.modalities['cis'] = Modality(
1258            name='cis',
1259            counts=cis_counts,
1260            feature_meta=cis_feature_meta,
1261            cell_names=cell_names,
1262            distribution='negbinom',
1263            cells_axis=1,
1264            min_count=self.min_count,
1265        )
1266
1267        return cis_gene, numeric_idx
1268
1269    def _extract_cis_generic(self, counts, cis_feature: str, modality_name: str, feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None, meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None) -> tuple:
1270        """
1271        Extract 'cis' modality from a generic negbinom modality.
1272
1273        Parameters
1274        ----------
1275        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1276            Feature counts (features × cells)
1277        cis_feature : str
1278            Feature name to extract as cis modality
1279        modality_name : str
1280            Name of the modality type (for error messages)
1281        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1282            Feature metadata. Required if counts is not a DataFrame.
1283        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1284            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Required if counts is not a DataFrame
1285            (used to get cell names for proper subsetting later).
1286
1287        Returns
1288        -------
1289        tuple (str, int)
1290            (original_feature_name, numeric_row_index)
1291            Returns the original feature name and the numeric row position
1292        """
1293        # Handle different count formats
1294        numeric_idx = None
1295
1296        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1297            # DataFrame: check if index is numeric or string-based
1298            if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1299                # Numeric index: use feature_meta to find feature
1300                if feature_meta is None:
1301                    raise ValueError(
1302                        f"counts has numeric index but no feature_meta provided to locate '{cis_feature}'"
1303                    )
1304                # Find feature in feature_meta columns (consistent with core.py)
1305                feature_col = None
1306                for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id', 'feature', 'feature_name']:
1307                    if col in feature_meta.columns and cis_feature in feature_meta[col].values:
1308                        feature_col = col
1309                        break
1310
1311                if feature_col is None:
1312                    raise ValueError(
1313                        f"cis_feature '{cis_feature}' not found in feature_meta columns: {list(feature_meta.columns)}"
1314                    )
1315
1316                # Get numeric position (iloc)
1317                numeric_idx = feature_meta[feature_meta[feature_col] == cis_feature].index[0]
1318                cis_counts = counts.iloc[[numeric_idx]].values
1319            else:
1320                # String-based index: use index directly
1321                if cis_feature not in counts.index:
1322                    raise ValueError(
1323                        f"cis_feature '{cis_feature}' not found in counts.index.\n"
1324                        f"Available features: {counts.index[:10].tolist()}..."
1325                    )
1326                numeric_idx = counts.index.get_loc(cis_feature)
1327                cis_counts = counts.loc[[cis_feature]].values
1328        else:
1329            # Array or sparse matrix: use feature_meta
1330            if feature_meta is None:
1331                raise ValueError(
1332                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, feature_meta must be provided to locate cis_feature"
1333                )
1334
1335            # Find feature in feature_meta columns (consistent with core.py)
1336            feature_col = None
1337            for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id', 'feature', 'feature_name']:
1338                if col in feature_meta.columns and cis_feature in feature_meta[col].values:
1339                    feature_col = col
1340                    break
1341
1342            if feature_col is None:
1343                available_cols = list(feature_meta.columns)
1344                raise ValueError(
1345                    f"cis_feature '{cis_feature}' not found in feature_meta.\n"
1346                    f"Tried columns: gene_name, gene, gene_id, feature_id, feature, feature_name.\n"
1347                    f"Available columns: {available_cols}"
1348                )
1349
1350            # Get numeric position (iloc, which is the row number)
1351            numeric_idx = feature_meta[feature_meta[feature_col] == cis_feature].index[0]
1352
1353            # Extract row from counts (works for numpy arrays and sparse matrices)
1354            if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1355                # Sparse matrix
1356                cis_counts = counts[numeric_idx, :].toarray()
1357            else:
1358                # Dense matrix or numpy array
1359                cis_counts = counts[numeric_idx:numeric_idx+1, :]
1360
1361        # Check if cis feature has zero variance (critical for cis modeling)
1362        cis_feature_std = np.std(cis_counts)
1363        if cis_feature_std == 0:
1364            raise ValueError(
1365                f"Cis feature '{cis_feature}' has zero standard deviation across all cells. "
1366                f"Cannot model cis effects for a feature with constant values."
1367            )
1368
1369        print(f"[INFO] Extracting 'cis' modality: {cis_feature} (from '{modality_name}')")
1370
1371        # Use numeric index and keep original feature name
1372        cis_feature_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1373            'feature': [cis_feature],
1374            'modality_type': [modality_name]
1375        }, index=[numeric_idx])
1376
1377        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1378        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1379            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1380        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1381            # Array or sparse matrix - get cell names from meta
1382            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1383                raise ValueError(
1384                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1385                )
1386            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1387        else:
1388            warnings.warn(
1389                "Creating cis modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1390                UserWarning
1391            )
1392            cell_names = None
1393
1394        self.modalities['cis'] = Modality(
1395            name='cis',
1396            counts=cis_counts,
1397            feature_meta=cis_feature_meta,
1398            cell_names=cell_names,
1399            distribution='negbinom',
1400            cells_axis=1,
1401            min_count=self.min_count,
1402        )
1403
1404        return cis_feature, numeric_idx
