1406    def _create_negbinom_modality(
1407        self,
1408        counts,
1409        modality_name: str,
1410        cis_feature: Optional[str] = None,
1411        cis_feature_idx: Optional[int] = None,
1412        feature_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1413        meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1414        min_count: int = 1,
1415    ):
1416        """
1417        Create a generic negbinom modality (excluding cis feature if specified).
1418
1419        Parameters
1420        ----------
1421        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1422            Feature counts (features × cells)
1423        modality_name : str
1424            Name for this modality
1425        cis_feature : str, optional
1426            If provided, this feature will be excluded from the modality
1427        cis_feature_idx : int, optional
1428            Numeric row index of cis feature (for exclusion when counts has numeric index)
1429        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1430            Feature metadata. If None, creates minimal metadata from counts.index
1431        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1432            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Used to get cell names if counts is not a DataFrame.
1433        """
1434        if modality_name in self.modalities:
1435            warnings.warn(f"Modality '{modality_name}' already exists. Overwriting.")
1436
1437        # Prepare feature metadata
1438        if feature_meta is None:
1439            # Auto-create from DataFrame index if available, else require it for arrays
1440            if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1441                # Check if DataFrame has meaningful feature names as index
1442                if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1443                    # Numeric index - no feature names available
1444                    raise ValueError(
1445                        "counts has numeric index but no feature_meta provided. "
1446                        "Either:\n"
1447                        "  1. Provide feature_meta with feature names/IDs, OR\n"
1448                        "  2. Set feature names as counts.index before initialization"
1449                    )
1450                else:
1451                    # String-based index - extract feature names
1452                    print(f"[INFO] No feature_meta provided - creating from counts.index")
1453                    feature_names = counts.index.tolist()
1454                    feature_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1455                        'feature': feature_names,
1456                        'feature_name': feature_names  # Also store in 'feature_name' column
1457                    }, index=range(len(feature_names)))
1458            else:
1459                # Array or sparse matrix - feature_meta is REQUIRED
1460                raise ValueError(
1461                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, feature_meta must be provided. "
1462                    "feature_meta should contain feature names/IDs to enable plotting and analysis."
1463                )
1464        else:
1465            # feature_meta provided - ensure it has numeric index and required columns
1466            if len(feature_meta) != counts.shape[0]:
1467                raise ValueError(
1468                    f"feature_meta has {len(feature_meta)} rows but counts has {counts.shape[0]} rows. "
1469                    f"They must match (row i in counts = row i in feature_meta)."
1470                )
1471            feature_meta = feature_meta.copy()
1472
1473            # Ensure at least one feature identifier column exists
1474            feature_id_cols = ['feature_name', 'feature', 'gene_name', 'gene', 'feature_id']
1475            has_feature_col = any(col in feature_meta.columns for col in feature_id_cols)
1476
1477            if not has_feature_col:
1478                # If DataFrame with string index, try to extract from there
1479                if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame) and not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1480                    print(f"[INFO] feature_meta has no feature identifier columns - adding 'feature_name' from counts.index")
1481                    feature_meta['feature_name'] = counts.index.tolist()
1482                    feature_meta['feature'] = counts.index.tolist()
1483                else:
1484                    warnings.warn(
1485                        "feature_meta has no feature identifier columns (feature_name, feature, gene_name, gene, feature_id). "
1486                        "Plotting by feature name will not work.",
1487                        UserWarning
1488                    )
1489
1490            feature_meta.index = range(len(feature_meta))  # Reset to numeric
1491
1492        # Build list of features to keep
1493        features_to_keep = []
1494
1495        for i in range(len(feature_meta)):
1496            # Skip cis feature
1497            if i == cis_feature_idx:
1498                continue
1499
1500            # Check for zero std
1501            if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1502                feature_std = counts.iloc[i].std()
1503            else:
1504                # Array or sparse matrix
1505                if hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1506                    feature_std = np.std(counts[i, :].toarray())
1507                else:
1508                    feature_std = np.std(counts[i, :])
1509
1510            if feature_std == 0:
1511                continue  # Skip zero-std features
1512
1513            features_to_keep.append(i)
1514
1515        if len(features_to_keep) == 0:
1516            raise ValueError(f"No features left in '{modality_name}' after filtering!")
1517
1518        # Filter counts and metadata
1519        counts_trans, mod_feature_meta = self._filter_features(counts, feature_meta, features_to_keep)
1520
1521        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1522        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1523            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1524        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1525            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1526                raise ValueError(
1527                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1528                )
1529            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1530        else:
1531            warnings.warn(
1532                f"Creating '{modality_name}' modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1533                UserWarning
1534            )
1535            cell_names = None
1536
1537        # Extract feature names for feature_names (prefer feature_name, then feature, then gene_name, then gene)
1538        feature_names_for_modality = None
1539        for col in ['feature_name', 'feature', 'gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
1540            if col in mod_feature_meta.columns:
1541                feature_names_for_modality = mod_feature_meta[col].tolist()
1542                break
1543
1544        self.modalities[modality_name] = Modality(
1545            name=modality_name,
1546            counts=counts_trans,
1547            feature_meta=mod_feature_meta,
1548            cell_names=cell_names,
1549            distribution='negbinom',
1550            cells_axis=1,
1551            feature_names=feature_names_for_modality,
1552            min_count=min_count,
1553        )
1554
1555    def _create_gene_modality(
1556        self,
1557        counts,
1558        cis_gene: Optional[str] = None,
1559        cis_gene_idx: Optional[int] = None,
1560        gene_meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1561        meta: Optional[pd.DataFrame] = None,
1562        min_count: int = 1,
1563    ):
1564        """
1565        Create 'gene' modality from gene counts (excluding cis gene if specified).
1566
1567        Parameters
1568        ----------
1569        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix
1570            Gene counts (genes × cells)
1571        cis_gene : str, optional
1572            If provided, this gene will be excluded from the gene modality
1573        cis_gene_idx : int, optional
1574            Numeric row index of cis gene (for exclusion when counts has numeric index)
1575        gene_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1576            Gene metadata. If None, creates minimal metadata from counts.index
1577        meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
1578            Cell metadata with 'cell' column. Used to get cell names if counts is not a DataFrame.
1579        """
1580        if 'gene' in self.modalities:
1581            warnings.warn("Gene modality already exists. Overwriting.")
1582
1583        # Prepare gene metadata
1584        if gene_meta is None:
1585            # Auto-create from DataFrame index if available, else require it for arrays
1586            if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1587                # Check if DataFrame has meaningful gene names as index
1588                if pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1589                    # Numeric index - no gene names available
1590                    raise ValueError(
1591                        "counts has numeric index but no gene_meta provided. "
1592                        "Either:\n"
1593                        "  1. Provide gene_meta with gene names/IDs, OR\n"
1594                        "  2. Set gene names as counts.index before initialization"
1595                    )
1596                else:
1597                    # String-based index - extract gene names
1598                    print(f"[INFO] No gene_meta provided - creating from counts.index")
1599                    gene_names = counts.index.tolist()
1600                    gene_meta = pd.DataFrame({
1601                        'gene_name': gene_names,
1602                        'gene': gene_names  # Also store in 'gene' column for compatibility
1603                    }, index=range(len(gene_names)))
1604            else:
1605                # Array or sparse matrix - gene_meta is REQUIRED
1606                raise ValueError(
1607                    "When counts is not a DataFrame, gene_meta must be provided. "
1608                    "gene_meta should contain gene names/IDs to enable plotting and analysis."
1609                )
1610        else:
1611            # gene_meta provided - ensure it has numeric index and required columns
1612            if len(gene_meta) != counts.shape[0]:
1613                raise ValueError(
1614                    f"gene_meta has {len(gene_meta)} rows but counts has {counts.shape[0]} rows. "
1615                    f"They must match (row i in counts = row i in gene_meta)."
1616                )
1617            gene_meta = gene_meta.copy()
1618
1619            # Ensure at least one gene identifier column exists
1620            gene_id_cols = ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'ens_id']
1621            has_gene_col = any(col in gene_meta.columns for col in gene_id_cols)
1622
1623            if not has_gene_col:
1624                # If DataFrame with string index, try to extract from there
1625                if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame) and not pd.api.types.is_integer_dtype(counts.index):
1626                    print(f"[INFO] gene_meta has no gene identifier columns - adding 'gene_name' from counts.index")
1627                    gene_meta['gene_name'] = counts.index.tolist()
1628                    gene_meta['gene'] = counts.index.tolist()
1629                else:
1630                    warnings.warn(
1631                        "gene_meta has no gene identifier columns (gene_name, gene, gene_id, ens_id). "
1632                        "Plotting by gene name will not work.",
1633                        UserWarning
1634                    )
1635
1636            gene_meta.index = range(len(gene_meta))  # Reset to numeric
1637
1638        # Pre-compute row standard deviations for all formats (dense, scipy sparse, pandas sparse).
1639        # Vectorised: avoids 31K per-row conversions in the loop below.
1640        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1641            if isinstance(counts.dtypes.iloc[0], pd.SparseDtype):
1642                # Pandas sparse DataFrame — convert to scipy sparse for vectorised std
1643                _sp = counts.sparse.to_coo().tocsr().astype(float)
1644                _mean = np.array(_sp.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1645                _sp2 = _sp.copy()
1646                _sp2.data **= 2
1647                _sq_mean = np.array(_sp2.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1648                row_stds = np.sqrt(np.maximum(_sq_mean - _mean ** 2, 0))
1649            else:
1650                # Regular dense DataFrame
1651                row_stds = counts.std(axis=1).values
1652        elif hasattr(counts, 'toarray'):
1653            # Scipy sparse matrix
1654            _sp = counts.astype(float)
1655            _mean = np.array(_sp.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1656            _sp2 = _sp.copy()
1657            _sp2.data **= 2
1658            _sq_mean = np.array(_sp2.mean(axis=1)).flatten()
1659            row_stds = np.sqrt(np.maximum(_sq_mean - _mean ** 2, 0))
1660        else:
1661            # Dense numpy array
1662            row_stds = counts.std(axis=1)
1663
1664        # Build list of features to keep
1665        features_to_keep = []
1666
1667        for i in range(len(gene_meta)):
1668            # Skip cis gene
1669            if i == cis_gene_idx:
1670                continue
1671
1672            # Skip zero-std genes
1673            if row_stds[i] == 0:
1674                continue
1675
1676            features_to_keep.append(i)
1677
1678        if len(features_to_keep) == 0:
1679            raise ValueError("No genes left after filtering!")
1680
1681        # Filter counts and metadata
1682        counts_trans, gene_feature_meta = self._filter_features(counts, gene_meta, features_to_keep)
1683
1684        # Extract cell names from counts or meta
1685        if isinstance(counts, pd.DataFrame):
1686            cell_names = counts.columns.tolist()
1687        elif meta is not None and 'cell' in meta.columns:
1688            if len(meta) != counts.shape[1]:
1689                raise ValueError(
1690                    f"Cell count mismatch: meta has {len(meta)} cells but counts has {counts.shape[1]} cells"
1691                )
1692            cell_names = meta['cell'].tolist()
1693        else:
1694            warnings.warn(
1695                "Creating 'gene' modality without cell_names. Modality will not be subsetted to match filtered cells.",
1696                UserWarning
1697            )
1698            cell_names = None
1699
1700        # Extract gene names for feature_names (prefer gene_name, then gene column)
1701        gene_names_for_modality = None
1702        for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id']:
1703            if col in gene_feature_meta.columns:
1704                gene_names_for_modality = gene_feature_meta[col].tolist()
1705                break
1706
1707        self.modalities['gene'] = Modality(
1708            name='gene',
1709            counts=counts_trans,
1710            feature_meta=gene_feature_meta,
1711            cell_names=cell_names,
1712            distribution='negbinom',
1713            cells_axis=1,
1714            feature_names=gene_names_for_modality,
1715            min_count=min_count,
1716        )
1717
1718    def add_modality(
1719        self,
1720        name: str,
1721        modality: Modality,
1722        overwrite: bool = False
1723    ):
1724        """
1725        Add a new modality.
1726
1727        Parameters
1728        ----------
1729        name : str
1730            Modality name
1731        modality : Modality
1732            Modality object
1733        overwrite : bool
1734            Whether to overwrite existing modality with same name
1735        """
1736        if name in self.modalities and not overwrite:
1737            raise ValueError(f"Modality '{name}' already exists. Use overwrite=True to replace it.")
1738
1739        # Negbinom modalities require their own sum_factors for normalisation.
1740        # Primary and cis share the same DataFrame (handled by _init_sum_factors),
1741        # but all other negbinom modalities must have sum_factors set explicitly
1742        # by the caller before fit_trans() is called on them.
1743        if (modality.distribution == 'negbinom'
1744                and modality.sum_factors is None
1745                and name not in (self.primary_modality, 'cis')):
1746            import warnings
1747            warnings.warn(
1748                f"Negbinom modality '{name}' has no sum_factors set. "
1749                f"You must assign modality.sum_factors (a cell-indexed DataFrame) "
1750                f"before calling fit_trans() on this modality.",
1751                UserWarning,
1752                stacklevel=2,
1753            )
1754
1755        self.modalities[name] = modality
1756        print(f"[INFO] Added modality '{name}': {modality}")
1757
1758    def get_modality(self, name: str) -> Modality:
1759        """Get a modality by name."""
1760        if name not in self.modalities:
1761            raise KeyError(f"Modality '{name}' not found. Available: {list(self.modalities.keys())}")
1762        return self.modalities[name]
1763
1764    def list_modalities(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
1765        """
1766        List all modalities with fitting status.
1767
1768        Returns
1769        -------
1770        pd.DataFrame
1771            Summary of modalities with columns:
1772            - name: Modality name
1773            - distribution: Distribution type
1774            - n_features: Number of features
1775            - n_cells: Number of cells
1776            - fit_ntc: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted, - if not configured
1777            - fit_cis: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted, - if not applicable
1778            - fit_trans: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted
1779
1780        Notes
1781        -----
1782        fit_ntc shows:
1783        - '-' if technical_group_code not set (no technical covariates configured)
1784        - '✗' if technical_group_code set but fit_ntc() not run
1785        - '✓' if fit_ntc() completed
1786        """
1787        if not self.modalities:
1788            return pd.DataFrame(columns=['name', 'distribution', 'n_features', 'n_cells',
1789                                        'fit_ntc', 'fit_cis', 'fit_trans'])
1790
1791        # Check if technical groups are configured
1792        has_technical_groups = 'technical_group_code' in self.meta.columns
1793
1794        rows = []
1795        for name, mod in self.modalities.items():
1796            # Check fitting status for technical fit
1797            # Only show as needed (✓/✗) if technical groups are configured
1798            if not has_technical_groups:
1799                has_technical = '-'  # Not configured/not needed
1800            else:
1801                # For 'cis' modality: check primary modality's technical fit status
1802                # (cis gene was included in primary modality's technical fit)
1803                if name == 'cis' and self.primary_modality in self.modalities:
1804                    primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
1805                    has_technical = '✓' if primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None else '✗'
1806                else:
1807                    has_technical = '✓' if mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None else '✗'
1808
1809            # fit_cis only applies to 'cis' modality
1810            if name == 'cis':
1811                # x_true is stored on the main model, not on the modality
1812                has_cis = '✓' if getattr(self, 'x_true', None) is not None else '✗'
1813            else:
1814                has_cis = '-'  # Not applicable
1815
1816            # fit_trans only applies to trans modalities, not to 'cis'
1817            if name == 'cis':
1818                has_trans = '-'  # Not applicable - cis is the predictor, not a trans response
1819            else:
1820                has_trans = '✓' if mod.posterior_samples_trans is not None else '✗'
1821
1822            rows.append({
1823                'name': name,
1824                'distribution': mod.distribution,
1825                'n_features': mod.dims['n_features'],
1826                'n_cells': mod.dims['n_cells'],
1827                'fit_ntc': has_technical,
1828                'fit_cis': has_cis,
1829                'fit_trans': has_trans
1830            })
1831        return pd.DataFrame(rows)
1832

1926        n_modalities = len(self.modalities)
1927        modality_names = ', '.join(self.modalities.keys())
1928
1929        return (
1930            f"bayesDREAM(\n"
1931            f"  cis_gene='{self.cis_gene}',\n"
1932            f"  n_cells={n_cells},\n"
1933            f"  n_modalities={n_modalities},\n"
1934            f"  modalities=[{modality_names}],\n"
1935            f"  primary_modality='{self.primary_modality}',\n"
1936            f"  device={self.device}\n"
1937            f")"
1938        )

bayesDREAM: Bayesian Dosage Response Effects Across Modalities

A three-step Bayesian framework for modeling perturbation effects across multiple molecular modalities including genes, transcripts, splicing, and custom measurements.

Supports:

  • Gene counts (negbinom) - the default/primary modality
  • Transcript counts (negbinom or multinomial for isoform usage)
  • Splice junction counts with donor/acceptor/exon skipping (multinomial/binomial)
  • ATAC-seq peaks (negbinom or binomial)
  • Custom modalities with user-specified distributions

Attributes

modalities : Dict[str, Modality] Dictionary of all modalities. 'gene' is the primary modality. primary_modality : str Name of primary modality used for cis/trans analysis (default: 'gene')

bayesDREAM( meta: pandas.core.frame.DataFrame, counts: pandas.core.frame.DataFrame = None, modality_name: str = 'gene', feature_meta: pandas.core.frame.DataFrame = None, cis_gene: str = None, cis_feature: str = None, guide_assignment: numpy.ndarray = None, guide_meta: pandas.core.frame.DataFrame = None, guide_target: pandas.core.frame.DataFrame = None, guide_covariates: list = None, guide_covariates_ntc: list = None, sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor', output_dir: str = './model_out', label: str = None, device: str = None, random_seed: int = 2402, cores: int = 1, exclude_targets: list = None, exclude_guides: list = None, require_ntc: bool = True, min_count: int = 1, color_scheme: bayesDREAM.ColorScheme = None) 
 68    def __init__(
 69        self,
 70        meta: pd.DataFrame,
 71        counts: pd.DataFrame = None,
 72        modality_name: str = 'gene',
 73        feature_meta: pd.DataFrame = None,
 74        cis_gene: str = None,
 75        cis_feature: str = None,
 76        guide_assignment: np.ndarray = None,
 77        guide_meta: pd.DataFrame = None,
 78        guide_target: pd.DataFrame = None,
 79        guide_covariates: list = None,
 80        guide_covariates_ntc: list = None,
 81        sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor',
 82        output_dir: str = "./model_out",
 83        label: str = None,
 84        device: str = None,
 85        random_seed: int = 2402,
 86        cores: int = 1,
 87        exclude_targets: list = None,
 88        exclude_guides: list = None,
 89        require_ntc: bool = True,
 90        min_count: int = 1,
 91        color_scheme: 'ColorScheme' = None,
 92    ):
 93        """
 94        Initialize bayesDREAM.
 95
 96        Parameters
 97        ----------
 98        meta : pd.DataFrame
 99            Cell-level metadata with columns: cell, guide, target, sum_factor, etc.
100        counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix, optional
101            Count matrix for the primary modality (features × cells). This will be used
102            for trans modeling and must represent negbinom count data.
103
104            Accepts:
105            - pd.DataFrame: Features as index, cells as columns
106            - np.ndarray or scipy.sparse matrix: Features as rows, cells as columns
107              (requires feature_meta to map feature names)
108
109            The modality_name parameter determines how this data is interpreted:
110            - 'gene': Gene expression counts (most common)
111            - 'atac': ATAC-seq peak counts
112            - Custom name: User-defined count modality
113
114            Additional modalities can be added after initialization using add_*_modality() methods.
115        modality_name : str, default='gene'
116            Name/type of the primary modality provided in counts parameter.
117
118            Pre-set types:
119            - 'gene': Gene expression (default, use with feature_meta for gene annotations)
120            - 'atac': ATAC-seq peaks
121
122            Custom types:
123            - Any string: Creates a custom negbinom modality with that name
124
125            The primary modality MUST be negative binomial (count data) for cis/trans modeling.
126        feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
127            Feature-level metadata for the primary modality.
128
129            For modality_name='gene':
130            - Recommended columns: 'gene', 'gene_name', 'gene_id'
131            - If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index
132
133            For other modalities:
134            - Should contain relevant feature annotations
135            - If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index
136        cis_gene : str, optional
137            Feature to extract as 'cis' modality. When modality_name='gene', this is
138            a gene name (e.g., 'GFI1B'). For other modality types, use cis_feature instead.
139
140            The cis feature will be:
141            1. Extracted as a separate 'cis' modality (1 feature)
142            2. Removed from the primary modality (which becomes trans-only)
143            3. Used for cis effect modeling in fit_cis()
144        cis_feature : str, optional
145            Alternative to cis_gene for non-gene modalities. Specifies which feature
146            to extract as the 'cis' modality.
147        guide_assignment : np.ndarray, optional
148            Binary matrix (cells × guides) for high MOI mode. Each cell can have
149            multiple guides. If provided, meta should NOT have 'guide' or 'target'
150            columns. Must be provided together with guide_meta.
151        guide_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional
152            Guide metadata for high MOI mode. Required columns: 'guide', 'target'.
153            Must be provided together with guide_assignment. Index should match
154            guide order in guide_assignment matrix.
155        guide_covariates : list, optional
156            Covariates for guide grouping (e.g., ['cell_line', 'batch'])
157        guide_covariates_ntc : list, optional
158            Covariates for NTC guide grouping (if different from guide_covariates)
159        sum_factor_col : str, default='sum_factor'
160            Column name in meta containing size factors
161        output_dir : str, default="./model_out"
162            Output directory for saving results
163        label : str, optional
164            Run label for organizing outputs
165        device : str, optional
166            'cpu' or 'cuda'. If None, auto-detects.
167        random_seed : int, default=2402
168            Random seed for reproducibility
169        cores : int, default=1
170            Number of CPU cores for parallel operations
171        color_scheme : ColorScheme, optional
172            Color scheme for visualizations. If None, auto-built from model
173            metadata via ``ColorScheme.from_model(self)`` after initialization.
174            Can also be set later via ``set_color_scheme()``.
175
176        Raises
177        ------
178        ValueError
179            - If cis_feature is specified but counts is None
180            - If cis_feature not found in counts
181            - If cis_feature has zero variance
182            - If primary modality would be empty after filtering
183
184        Examples
185        --------
186        Basic gene expression analysis:
187        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
188        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
189        ...     counts=gene_counts,
190        ...     cis_gene='GFI1B'
191        ... )
192
193        With gene metadata:
194        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
195        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
196        ...     counts=gene_counts,
197        ...     feature_meta=gene_metadata,
198        ...     cis_gene='GFI1B',
199        ...     guide_covariates=['cell_line']
200        ... )
201
202        ATAC-seq analysis:
203        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
204        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
205        ...     counts=atac_counts,
206        ...     modality_name='atac',
207        ...     feature_meta=peak_metadata,
208        ...     cis_feature='chr9:132283881-132284881'
209        ... )
210
211        Custom modality:
212        >>> model = bayesDREAM(
213        ...     meta=cell_metadata,
214        ...     counts=my_counts,
215        ...     modality_name='my_custom_modality',
216        ...     cis_feature='feature_123'
217        ... )
218
219        Notes
220        -----
221        - The 'cis' modality is ONLY extracted during initialization from the primary modality
222        - When you call add_*_modality() methods later, NO cis extraction occurs
223        - The primary modality MUST be negbinom (count data) for cis/trans modeling
224        - Additional modalities (transcripts, splicing, etc.) are added via add_*_modality() methods
225        """
226        # Initialize modalities dict (always start empty, build from counts)
227        self.modalities = {}
228
229        # Resolve cis_feature: cis_gene is an alias for cis_feature when modality_name='gene'
230        if cis_gene is not None and cis_feature is not None:
231            raise ValueError("Provide either cis_gene or cis_feature, not both")
232        if cis_gene is not None:
233            if modality_name != 'gene':
234                warnings.warn(
235                    f"cis_gene parameter is intended for modality_name='gene'. "
236                    f"You have modality_name='{modality_name}'. Use cis_feature instead.",
237                    UserWarning
238                )
239            cis_feature = cis_gene
240
241        # Store min_count for use in modality creation
242        self.min_count = min_count
243
244        # Store original counts for base class initialization
245        counts_for_base = counts
246
247        # Validate that counts is provided if cis_feature is specified
248        if cis_feature is not None and counts is None:
249            raise ValueError("Cannot specify cis_feature without providing counts")
250
251        # Extract 'cis' modality from primary modality (if both counts and cis_feature provided)
252        # Keep the original gene name and track numeric position
253        cis_numeric_idx = None
254        if counts is not None and cis_feature is not None:
255            if modality_name == 'gene':
256                cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx = self._extract_cis_from_gene(counts, cis_feature, feature_meta, meta)
257            else:
258                # Generic cis extraction for any negbinom modality
259                cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx = self._extract_cis_generic(counts, cis_feature, modality_name, feature_meta, meta)
260
261        # Create primary modality
262        if counts is not None:
263            if modality_name == 'gene':
264                # Use gene-specific creation (with gene_meta handling)
265                # Pass both the name and numeric index for exclusion
266                self._create_gene_modality(counts, cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx, gene_meta=feature_meta, meta=meta, min_count=min_count)
267            else:
268                # Generic negbinom modality creation
269                self._create_negbinom_modality(counts, modality_name, cis_feature, cis_numeric_idx, feature_meta, meta, min_count=min_count)
270
271        # Store primary modality name
272        self.primary_modality = modality_name
273
274        # ========================================================================
275        # CRITICAL VALIDATION: Primary modality MUST be negative binomial
276        # ========================================================================
277        if modality_name in self.modalities:
278            primary_distribution = self.modalities[modality_name].distribution
279            if primary_distribution != 'negbinom':
280                raise ValueError(
281                    f"Primary modality '{modality_name}' has distribution '{primary_distribution}', "
282                    f"but bayesDREAM requires primary modality to be 'negbinom' for cis/trans modeling. "
283                    f"The primary modality must represent count data that follows a negative binomial distribution."
284                )
285        elif counts is None:
286            # No counts provided - user will add modalities later
287            warnings.warn(
288                f"No counts provided during initialization. Primary modality '{modality_name}' must be added "
289                f"via add_custom_modality() with distribution='negbinom' before fitting.",
290                UserWarning
291            )
292
293        # Get counts for base class initialization
294        # IMPORTANT: Pass counts matrix as-is to avoid densification
295        # core.py will handle matrix/array/DataFrame uniformly
296        if counts_for_base is None:
297            if modality_name in self.modalities:
298                # Get from modality - prefer original counts over count_df
299                mod = self.modalities[modality_name]
300                primary_counts = mod.counts  # This is the matrix/array, not densified
301            else:
302                # No counts and no primary modality - create placeholder
303                pass
304                # Create minimal placeholder (will be replaced)
305                primary_counts = np.ones((1, len(meta)))
306        else:
307            # Use original counts as-is (matrix, array, or DataFrame)
308            primary_counts = counts_for_base
309
310        # Prepare gene_meta for base class
311        # Only pass feature_meta as gene_meta if modality_name is 'gene', otherwise None
312        gene_meta_for_base = feature_meta if modality_name == 'gene' else None
313
314        # Initialize base bayesDREAM with original counts (including cis feature)
315        super().__init__(
316            meta=meta,
317            counts=primary_counts,
318            gene_meta=gene_meta_for_base,
319            cis_gene=cis_feature,  # Pass resolved cis_feature as cis_gene
320            guide_assignment=guide_assignment,
321            guide_meta=guide_meta,
322            guide_target=guide_target,
323            guide_covariates=guide_covariates,
324            guide_covariates_ntc=guide_covariates_ntc,
325            sum_factor_col=sum_factor_col,
326            output_dir=output_dir,
327            label=label,
328            device=device,
329            random_seed=random_seed,
330            cores=cores,
331            exclude_targets=exclude_targets,
332            exclude_guides=exclude_guides,
333            require_ntc=require_ntc
334        )
335
336        # Subset all modalities to match filtered cells from base class
337        # Base class (super().__init__) has filtered self.meta to valid cells
338        valid_cells = self.meta['cell'].tolist()
339        for mod_name in list(self.modalities.keys()):
340            mod = self.modalities[mod_name]
341            if mod.cell_names is not None:
342                # Find indices of valid cells in this modality
343                cell_indices = [i for i, c in enumerate(mod.cell_names)
344                              if c in valid_cells]
345                if len(cell_indices) < len(mod.cell_names):
346                    self.modalities[mod_name] = mod.get_cell_subset(cell_indices)
347
348        print(f"bayesDREAM: label={self.label}, device={self.device}, {len(self.modalities)} modalities")
349        for name, mod in self.modalities.items():
350            print(f"  - {name}: {mod}")
351
352        # Store sum_factor_col so add_cis_gene() can re-init sum_factors after cell subsetting.
353        self._sum_factor_col = sum_factor_col
354
355        # Initialise sum_factors on all negbinom modalities from meta.
356        # Must run AFTER super().__init__() and cell subsetting so self.meta is final.
357        self._init_sum_factors(sum_factor_col)
358
359        # Colour scheme — user-supplied or auto-built from model metadata.
360        # Must run AFTER super().__init__() so self.meta / guide_meta are final.
361        if color_scheme is not None:
362            self.color_scheme = color_scheme
363        else:
364            self.color_scheme = ColorScheme.from_model(self)

Initialize bayesDREAM.

Parameters

meta : pd.DataFrame Cell-level metadata with columns: cell, guide, target, sum_factor, etc. counts : pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, or scipy.sparse matrix, optional Count matrix for the primary modality (features × cells). This will be used for trans modeling and must represent negbinom count data.

Accepts:
- pd.DataFrame: Features as index, cells as columns
- np.ndarray or scipy.sparse matrix: Features as rows, cells as columns
  (requires feature_meta to map feature names)

The modality_name parameter determines how this data is interpreted:
- 'gene': Gene expression counts (most common)
- 'atac': ATAC-seq peak counts
- Custom name: User-defined count modality

Additional modalities can be added after initialization using add_*_modality() methods.

modality_name : str, default='gene' Name/type of the primary modality provided in counts parameter.

Pre-set types:
- 'gene': Gene expression (default, use with feature_meta for gene annotations)
- 'atac': ATAC-seq peaks

Custom types:
- Any string: Creates a custom negbinom modality with that name

The primary modality MUST be negative binomial (count data) for cis/trans modeling.

feature_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional Feature-level metadata for the primary modality.

For modality_name='gene':
- Recommended columns: 'gene', 'gene_name', 'gene_id'
- If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index

For other modalities:
- Should contain relevant feature annotations
- If not provided, minimal metadata created from counts.index

cis_gene : str, optional Feature to extract as 'cis' modality. When modality_name='gene', this is a gene name (e.g., 'GFI1B'). For other modality types, use cis_feature instead.

The cis feature will be:
1. Extracted as a separate 'cis' modality (1 feature)
2. Removed from the primary modality (which becomes trans-only)
3. Used for cis effect modeling in fit_cis()

cis_feature : str, optional Alternative to cis_gene for non-gene modalities. Specifies which feature to extract as the 'cis' modality. guide_assignment : np.ndarray, optional Binary matrix (cells × guides) for high MOI mode. Each cell can have multiple guides. If provided, meta should NOT have 'guide' or 'target' columns. Must be provided together with guide_meta. guide_meta : pd.DataFrame, optional Guide metadata for high MOI mode. Required columns: 'guide', 'target'. Must be provided together with guide_assignment. Index should match guide order in guide_assignment matrix. guide_covariates : list, optional Covariates for guide grouping (e.g., ['cell_line', 'batch']) guide_covariates_ntc : list, optional Covariates for NTC guide grouping (if different from guide_covariates) sum_factor_col : str, default='sum_factor' Column name in meta containing size factors output_dir : str, default="./model_out" Output directory for saving results label : str, optional Run label for organizing outputs device : str, optional 'cpu' or 'cuda'. If None, auto-detects. random_seed : int, default=2402 Random seed for reproducibility cores : int, default=1 Number of CPU cores for parallel operations color_scheme : ColorScheme, optional Color scheme for visualizations. If None, auto-built from model metadata via ColorScheme.from_model(self) after initialization. Can also be set later via set_color_scheme().

Raises

ValueError - If cis_feature is specified but counts is None - If cis_feature not found in counts - If cis_feature has zero variance - If primary modality would be empty after filtering

Examples

Basic gene expression analysis:

>>> model = bayesDREAM(
...     meta=cell_metadata,
...     counts=gene_counts,
...     cis_gene='GFI1B'
... )

With gene metadata:

>>> model = bayesDREAM(
...     meta=cell_metadata,
...     counts=gene_counts,
...     feature_meta=gene_metadata,
...     cis_gene='GFI1B',
...     guide_covariates=['cell_line']
... )

ATAC-seq analysis:

>>> model = bayesDREAM(
...     meta=cell_metadata,
...     counts=atac_counts,
...     modality_name='atac',
...     feature_meta=peak_metadata,
...     cis_feature='chr9:132283881-132284881'
... )

Custom modality:

>>> model = bayesDREAM(
...     meta=cell_metadata,
...     counts=my_counts,
...     modality_name='my_custom_modality',
...     cis_feature='feature_123'
... )

Notes

  • The 'cis' modality is ONLY extracted during initialization from the primary modality
  • When you call add_*_modality() methods later, NO cis extraction occurs
  • The primary modality MUST be negbinom (count data) for cis/trans modeling
  • Additional modalities (transcripts, splicing, etc.) are added via add_*_modality() methods

def add_cis_gene(self, cis_gene: str) -> None: 
381    def add_cis_gene(self, cis_gene: str) -> None:
382        """
383        Specify the cis gene after initialization and prepare the model for cis/trans fitting.
384
385        Intended for workflows where fit_ntc() (and optionally adjust_ntc_sum_factor())
386        should be run once before the cis gene is committed, avoiding a separate technical-fit
387        run per gene.
388
389        The method:
390        1. Finds and extracts the cis gene from the primary modality, creating the 'cis' modality.
391        2. Subsets cells to NTC + cis-targeting cells only.
392        3. Re-filters features that become zero-count after cell subsetting; if fit_ntc() has
393           already been run, trims matching feature axes in the stored posteriors.
394        4. If fit_ntc() has already been run, extracts the cis gene's overdispersion parameters
395           from the primary modality posteriors into the 'cis' modality (equivalent to having
396           set cis_gene at init time).
397        5. Recomputes guide_code for compact indexing over the retained cells.
398        6. Reinitialises sum_factors on the (now-final) cell set.
399
400        Parameters
401        ----------
402        cis_gene : str
403            Name of the cis gene (must exist in the primary modality's feature_meta).
404
405        Raises
406        ------
407        ValueError
408            If cis_gene is already set, if called in high-MOI mode, if the gene is not
409            found, or if the gene has zero counts across NTC + cis cells.
410        """
411        if self.cis_gene is not None:
412            raise ValueError(
413                f"cis_gene is already set to '{self.cis_gene}'. Cannot call add_cis_gene() again."
414            )
415        if self.is_high_moi:
416            raise ValueError(
417                "add_cis_gene() is not supported in high-MOI mode. "
418                "Provide cis_gene at initialization time."
419            )
420        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
421            raise ValueError("'cis' modality already exists.")
422
423        primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
424        n_total_features = primary_mod.dims['n_features']
425
426        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
427        # Step 1: locate the cis gene in the primary modality feature_meta
428        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
429        gene_col = None
430        for col in ['gene_name', 'gene', 'gene_id', 'feature_id']:
431            if col in primary_mod.feature_meta.columns and cis_gene in primary_mod.feature_meta[col].values:
432                gene_col = col
433                break
434
435        if gene_col is None:
436            raise ValueError(
437                f"cis_gene '{cis_gene}' not found in primary modality feature_meta. "
438                f"Tried columns: gene_name, gene, gene_id, feature_id. "
439                f"Available columns: {list(primary_mod.feature_meta.columns)}"
440            )
441
442        match_mask = primary_mod.feature_meta[gene_col] == cis_gene
443        cis_feat_iloc = int(np.where(match_mask.values)[0][0])
444
445        print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: found '{cis_gene}' at feature iloc {cis_feat_iloc} "
446              f"in primary modality (of {n_total_features} features)")
447
448        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
449        # Step 2: extract cis gene counts from primary modality
450        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
451        if primary_mod.cells_axis == 1:
452            cis_counts = primary_mod.counts[[cis_feat_iloc], :]
453        else:
454            cis_counts = primary_mod.counts[:, [cis_feat_iloc]]
455
456        cis_feature_meta = primary_mod.feature_meta.iloc[[cis_feat_iloc]].copy()
457        cis_feature_meta.index = [0]
458        if 'gene' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
459            cis_feature_meta['gene'] = cis_gene
460        if 'gene_name' not in cis_feature_meta.columns:
461            cis_feature_meta['gene_name'] = cis_gene
462
463        self.modalities['cis'] = Modality(
464            name='cis',
465            counts=cis_counts,
466            feature_meta=cis_feature_meta,
467            cell_names=primary_mod.cell_names,
468            distribution='negbinom',
469            cells_axis=primary_mod.cells_axis,
470            min_count=self.min_count,
471        )
472
473        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
474        # Step 3: if fit_ntc already ran, extract cis posteriors from primary
475        #         BEFORE we remove the cis feature row (while indices still align)
476        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
477        ntc_ran = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None
478
479        if ntc_ran:
480            self._extract_cis_alpha_from_ntc_posteriors(cis_gene, cis_feat_iloc, n_total_features)
481
482        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
483        # Step 4: remove cis gene from primary modality
484        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
485        trans_idx = list(range(cis_feat_iloc)) + list(range(cis_feat_iloc + 1, n_total_features))
486
487        if primary_mod.cells_axis == 1:
488            trans_counts = primary_mod.counts[trans_idx, :]
489        else:
490            trans_counts = primary_mod.counts[:, trans_idx]
491
492        trans_feature_meta = primary_mod.feature_meta.iloc[trans_idx].copy()
493        trans_feature_meta.index = range(len(trans_idx))
494
495        trans_feature_names = (
496            [primary_mod.feature_names[i] for i in trans_idx]
497            if primary_mod.feature_names is not None else None
498        )
499
500        new_primary_mod = Modality(
501            name=self.primary_modality,
502            counts=trans_counts,
503            feature_meta=trans_feature_meta,
504            distribution=primary_mod.distribution,
505            cells_axis=primary_mod.cells_axis,
506            feature_names=trans_feature_names,
507            cell_names=primary_mod.cell_names,
508            min_count=primary_mod.min_count,
509        )
510
511        # Transfer already-trimmed fitting results to the new primary modality object
512        if ntc_ran:
513            new_primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = primary_mod.posterior_samples_ntc
514            new_primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
515            new_primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
516            if hasattr(primary_mod, 'loss_ntc'):
517                new_primary_mod.loss_ntc = primary_mod.loss_ntc
518
519        self.modalities[self.primary_modality] = new_primary_mod
520        self.cis_gene = cis_gene
521
522        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
523        # Step 5: subset cells to NTC + cis
524        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
525        valid_cells = set(self.meta[self.meta['target'].isin(['ntc', cis_gene])]['cell'].unique())
526        n_before = len(self.meta)
527        self.meta = self.meta[self.meta['cell'].isin(valid_cells)].copy()
528        n_after = len(self.meta)
529        if n_after < n_before:
530            print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene: cells {n_before} → {n_after} (kept NTC + {cis_gene} only)")
531
532        for mod_name in list(self.modalities.keys()):
533            mod = self.modalities[mod_name]
534            if mod.cell_names is not None:
535                cell_idx = [i for i, c in enumerate(mod.cell_names) if c in valid_cells]
536                if len(cell_idx) < len(mod.cell_names):
537                    new_mod = mod.get_cell_subset(cell_idx)
538                    # Forward fitting results to cell-subsetted copy
539                    new_mod.posterior_samples_ntc = mod.posterior_samples_ntc
540                    new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult    = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
541                    new_mod.alpha_y_prefit_add     = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
542                    if hasattr(mod, 'loss_ntc'):
543                        new_mod.loss_ntc = mod.loss_ntc
544                    self.modalities[mod_name] = new_mod
545
546        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
547        # Step 6: re-filter zero-count features after cell subsetting
548        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
549        self._refilter_zero_count_features(ntc_ran)
550
551        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
552        # Step 7: recompute guide_code for compact indices over retained cells
553        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
554        self.meta['guide_code'] = pd.Categorical(self.meta['guide_used']).codes
555
556        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
557        # Step 8: reinitialise sum_factors on the final cell set
558        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
559        self._init_sum_factors(self._sum_factor_col)
560
561        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
562        # Step 9: rebuild color scheme
563        # ----------------------------------------------------------------
564        self.color_scheme = ColorScheme.from_model(self)
565
566        print(f"[INFO] add_cis_gene('{cis_gene}') complete: {n_after} cells, "
567              f"{self.modalities[self.primary_modality].dims['n_features']} trans features, "
568              f"{'NTC posteriors transferred' if ntc_ran else 'fit_ntc() not yet run'}.")

Specify the cis gene after initialization and prepare the model for cis/trans fitting.

Intended for workflows where fit_ntc() (and optionally adjust_ntc_sum_factor()) should be run once before the cis gene is committed, avoiding a separate technical-fit run per gene.

The method:

  1. Finds and extracts the cis gene from the primary modality, creating the 'cis' modality.
  2. Subsets cells to NTC + cis-targeting cells only.
  3. Re-filters features that become zero-count after cell subsetting; if fit_ntc() has already been run, trims matching feature axes in the stored posteriors.
  4. If fit_ntc() has already been run, extracts the cis gene's overdispersion parameters from the primary modality posteriors into the 'cis' modality (equivalent to having set cis_gene at init time).
  5. Recomputes guide_code for compact indexing over the retained cells.
  6. Reinitialises sum_factors on the (now-final) cell set.

Parameters

cis_gene : str Name of the cis gene (must exist in the primary modality's feature_meta).

Raises

ValueError If cis_gene is already set, if called in high-MOI mode, if the gene is not found, or if the gene has zero counts across NTC + cis cells.

def plot_ntc_expression( self, figsize: tuple = (7, 4), n_bins: int = 80, threshold: float = -1.0): 
867    def plot_ntc_expression(
868        self,
869        figsize: tuple = (7, 4),
870        n_bins: int = 80,
871        threshold: float = -1.0,
872    ):
873        """
874        Histogram of per-gene log2 NTC expression with the cis gene marked.
875
876        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run first.  Useful for judging whether
877        the cis gene is sufficiently expressed in NTC cells before running
878        fit_cis().  fit_cis() raises a ValueError if the cis gene's log2 NTC
879        expression is below ``threshold`` (default -1); this plot shows exactly
880        where the gene falls relative to that cutoff.
881
882        Parameters
883        ----------
884        figsize : tuple, default (7, 4)
885        n_bins : int, default 80
886        threshold : float, default -1.0
887            The log2 expression cutoff used by fit_cis() to flag unexpressed
888            genes.  Drawn as a vertical dotted line for reference.
889
890        Returns
891        -------
892        matplotlib.figure.Figure
893        """
894        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
895
896        data = self._compute_ntc_log2_exprs_from_fit()
897        if data is None:
898            raise ValueError("Ensure fit_ntc() has been run before plotting.")
899
900        all_expr  = data['all_log2_expr']
901        cis_val   = data['cis_log2_expr']
902        n_genes   = len(all_expr)
903
904        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
905        ax.hist(all_expr, bins=n_bins, color='steelblue', alpha=0.6, edgecolor='none')
906        ax.axvline(cis_val, color='red', lw=2, ls='--',
907                   label=f'{self.cis_gene}  (log$_2$ = {cis_val:.2f})')
908        ax.axvline(threshold, color='grey', lw=1.5, ls=':',
909                   label=f'fit_cis threshold ({threshold})')
910        ax.set_xlabel('log$_2$(NTC mean expression) from technical fit', fontsize=10)
911        ax.set_ylabel('Number of genes', fontsize=10)
912        ax.set_title(
913            f'NTC expression — {self.cis_gene}  '
914            f'({"BELOW" if cis_val < threshold else "above"} threshold)\n'
915            f'{n_genes} genes, {data["n_ntc_cells"]} NTC cells',
916            fontsize=9
917        )
918        ax.legend(fontsize=9)
919        fig.tight_layout()
920        return fig

def plot_ntc_overdispersion(self, modality_name: str = None, ax=None, figsize: tuple = (6, 5)): 
 922    def plot_ntc_overdispersion(
 923        self,
 924        modality_name: str = None,
 925        ax=None,
 926        figsize: tuple = (6, 5),
 927    ):
 928        """
 929        Scatter plot of log2(mu_ntc) vs log2(o_y) from the technical fit.
 930
 931        Highlights the cis gene in red.  Useful for diagnosing whether the
 932        cis gene falls in an unusual region of the mu_ntc–o_y relationship.
 933
 934        Requires fit_ntc() to have been run first.
 935
 936        Parameters
 937        ----------
 938        modality_name : str, optional
 939            Modality to plot (default: primary modality).
 940        ax : matplotlib.axes.Axes, optional
 941            Axes to draw on.  Creates a new figure if None.
 942        figsize : tuple, default=(6, 5)
 943            Figure size (width, height) in inches.
 944
 945        Returns
 946        -------
 947        matplotlib.figure.Figure
 948        """
 949        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
 950
 951        if modality_name is None:
 952            modality_name = self.primary_modality
 953
 954        modality = self.get_modality(modality_name)
 955        ps = modality.posterior_samples_ntc
 956        if ps is None or 'mu_ntc' not in ps or 'o_y' not in ps:
 957            raise ValueError(
 958                f"No technical fit found for modality '{modality_name}'. "
 959                "Run fit_ntc() first."
 960            )
 961
 962        # Extract posterior means — tensors may be [S, T] or [S, C, T]
 963        mu_ntc_raw = ps['mu_ntc'].mean(dim=0).detach().numpy()
 964        o_y_raw    = ps['o_y'].mean(dim=0).detach().numpy()
 965
 966        # Flatten multi-group tensors to 1D (take first group = NTC reference)
 967        mu_ntc = mu_ntc_raw.reshape(-1) if mu_ntc_raw.ndim == 1 else mu_ntc_raw[0]
 968        o_y    = o_y_raw.reshape(-1)    if o_y_raw.ndim == 1    else o_y_raw[0]
 969
 970        log2_mu = np.log2(np.clip(mu_ntc, 1e-8, None))
 971        log2_oy = np.log2(np.clip(o_y,    1e-8, None))
 972
 973        new_fig = ax is None
 974        if new_fig:
 975            fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=figsize)
 976        else:
 977            fig = ax.get_figure()
 978
 979        ax.scatter(log2_mu, log2_oy, alpha=0.25, s=4, c='steelblue', rasterized=True,
 980                   label='trans genes')
 981
 982        # Highlight cis gene if available
 983        if 'cis' in self.modalities:
 984            cis_ps = self.modalities['cis'].posterior_samples_ntc
 985            if cis_ps is not None and 'mu_ntc' in cis_ps and 'o_x' in cis_ps:
 986                cis_mu = float(cis_ps['mu_ntc'].mean().item())
 987                cis_ox = float(cis_ps['o_x'].mean().item())
 988                ax.scatter(
 989                    np.log2(max(cis_mu, 1e-8)),
 990                    np.log2(max(cis_ox, 1e-8)),
 991                    s=120, c='red', zorder=10, marker='*',
 992                    label=f'{self.cis_gene}'
 993                )
 994
 995        ax.set_xlabel('log$_2$(mu_ntc)', fontsize=11)
 996        ax.set_ylabel('log$_2$(o_y)', fontsize=11)
 997        ax.set_title('Technical fit: NTC mean expression vs overdispersion', fontsize=11)
 998        ax.axhline(0, color='gray', lw=0.5, ls='--')
 999        ax.legend(fontsize=9, markerscale=1.5)
1000
1001        if new_fig:
1002            fig.tight_layout()
1003
1004        return fig

def add_modality( self, name: str, modality: bayesDREAM.Modality, overwrite: bool = False): 
1718    def add_modality(
1719        self,
1720        name: str,
1721        modality: Modality,
1722        overwrite: bool = False
1723    ):
1724        """
1725        Add a new modality.
1726
1727        Parameters
1728        ----------
1729        name : str
1730            Modality name
1731        modality : Modality
1732            Modality object
1733        overwrite : bool
1734            Whether to overwrite existing modality with same name
1735        """
1736        if name in self.modalities and not overwrite:
1737            raise ValueError(f"Modality '{name}' already exists. Use overwrite=True to replace it.")
1738
1739        # Negbinom modalities require their own sum_factors for normalisation.
1740        # Primary and cis share the same DataFrame (handled by _init_sum_factors),
1741        # but all other negbinom modalities must have sum_factors set explicitly
1742        # by the caller before fit_trans() is called on them.
1743        if (modality.distribution == 'negbinom'
1744                and modality.sum_factors is None
1745                and name not in (self.primary_modality, 'cis')):
1746            import warnings
1747            warnings.warn(
1748                f"Negbinom modality '{name}' has no sum_factors set. "
1749                f"You must assign modality.sum_factors (a cell-indexed DataFrame) "
1750                f"before calling fit_trans() on this modality.",
1751                UserWarning,
1752                stacklevel=2,
1753            )
1754
1755        self.modalities[name] = modality
1756        print(f"[INFO] Added modality '{name}': {modality}")

def list_modalities(self) -> pandas.core.frame.DataFrame: 
1764    def list_modalities(self) -> pd.DataFrame:
1765        """
1766        List all modalities with fitting status.
1767
1768        Returns
1769        -------
1770        pd.DataFrame
1771            Summary of modalities with columns:
1772            - name: Modality name
1773            - distribution: Distribution type
1774            - n_features: Number of features
1775            - n_cells: Number of cells
1776            - fit_ntc: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted, - if not configured
1777            - fit_cis: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted, - if not applicable
1778            - fit_trans: ✓ if fitted, ✗ if not fitted
1779
1780        Notes
1781        -----
1782        fit_ntc shows:
1783        - '-' if technical_group_code not set (no technical covariates configured)
1784        - '✗' if technical_group_code set but fit_ntc() not run
1785        - '✓' if fit_ntc() completed
1786        """
1787        if not self.modalities:
1788            return pd.DataFrame(columns=['name', 'distribution', 'n_features', 'n_cells',
1789                                        'fit_ntc', 'fit_cis', 'fit_trans'])
1790
1791        # Check if technical groups are configured
1792        has_technical_groups = 'technical_group_code' in self.meta.columns
1793
1794        rows = []
1795        for name, mod in self.modalities.items():
1796            # Check fitting status for technical fit
1797            # Only show as needed (✓/✗) if technical groups are configured
1798            if not has_technical_groups:
1799                has_technical = '-'  # Not configured/not needed
1800            else:
1801                # For 'cis' modality: check primary modality's technical fit status
1802                # (cis gene was included in primary modality's technical fit)
1803                if name == 'cis' and self.primary_modality in self.modalities:
1804                    primary_mod = self.modalities[self.primary_modality]
1805                    has_technical = '✓' if primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None else '✗'
1806                else:
1807                    has_technical = '✓' if mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None else '✗'
1808
1809            # fit_cis only applies to 'cis' modality
1810            if name == 'cis':
1811                # x_true is stored on the main model, not on the modality
1812                has_cis = '✓' if getattr(self, 'x_true', None) is not None else '✗'
1813            else:
1814                has_cis = '-'  # Not applicable
1815
1816            # fit_trans only applies to trans modalities, not to 'cis'
1817            if name == 'cis':
1818                has_trans = '-'  # Not applicable - cis is the predictor, not a trans response
1819            else:
1820                has_trans = '✓' if mod.posterior_samples_trans is not None else '✗'
1821
1822            rows.append({
1823                'name': name,
1824                'distribution': mod.distribution,
1825                'n_features': mod.dims['n_features'],
1826                'n_cells': mod.dims['n_cells'],
1827                'fit_ntc': has_technical,
1828                'fit_cis': has_cis,
1829                'fit_trans': has_trans
1830            })
1831        return pd.DataFrame(rows)

def set_technical_groups(self, covariates: list[str]): 
584    def set_technical_groups(self, covariates: list[str]):
585        """
586        Assign a technical-group code to every cell based on covariate combinations.
587
588        Must be called before ``fit_ntc()`` so the model knows how many technical
589        groups (C) exist.  The resulting ``technical_group_code`` column is an integer
590        index (0-based) used internally; index 0 is the reference group.
591
592        Cells in technical groups that have no NTC representation are automatically
593        dropped with a warning, because overdispersion estimation for those groups
594        requires at least some NTC cells.
595
596        Parameters
597        ----------
598        covariates : list of str
599            Column names in ``meta`` whose combinations define technical groups
600            (e.g., ``['cell_line']`` or ``['cell_line', 'lane']``).  Pass an empty
601            list ``[]`` to create a single technical group for the whole dataset (no
602            batch correction).
603        """
604        # Allow empty covariates list to create a single technical group
605        if not covariates:
606            print("[INFO] No covariates specified - creating single technical group (C=1)")
607            self.model.meta["technical_group_code"] = 0
608            return
609
610        missing_cols = [c for c in covariates if c not in self.model.meta.columns]
611        if missing_cols:
612            raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in meta: {missing_cols}")
613
614        self.model.meta["technical_group_code"] = self.model.meta.groupby(covariates).ngroup()
615        self.model._technical_group_covariates = list(covariates)
616        print(f"[INFO] Set technical_group_code with {self.model.meta['technical_group_code'].nunique()} groups based on {covariates}")
617    
618        # ---- SAFEGUARD: ensure every technical group is represented among NTCs ----
619        # Skip this check if require_ntc=False (e.g., when NTC cells are not needed)
620        require_ntc = getattr(self.model, 'require_ntc', True)
621        if require_ntc and "target" in self.model.meta.columns:
622            all_groups  = set(self.model.meta["technical_group_code"].unique().tolist())
623            ntc_groups  = set(self.model.meta.loc[self.model.meta["target"] == "ntc", "technical_group_code"].unique().tolist())
624            missing_ntc = sorted(all_groups - ntc_groups)
625            if missing_ntc:
626                n_drop = int(self.model.meta["technical_group_code"].isin(missing_ntc).sum())
627                warnings.warn(
628                    "[WARNING] Dropping cells from technical groups with no NTC representation. "
629                    f"Groups: {missing_ntc} | Cells dropped: {n_drop}",
630                    UserWarning
631                )
632                self.model.meta = self.model.meta.loc[~self.model.meta["technical_group_code"].isin(missing_ntc)].copy()
633                # Optional: re-announce counts after drop
634                print(f"[INFO] After dropping non-NTC groups, {self.model.meta['technical_group_code'].nunique()} technical group(s) remain.")

Assign a technical-group code to every cell based on covariate combinations.

Must be called before fit_ntc() so the model knows how many technical groups (C) exist. The resulting technical_group_code column is an integer index (0-based) used internally; index 0 is the reference group.

Cells in technical groups that have no NTC representation are automatically dropped with a warning, because overdispersion estimation for those groups requires at least some NTC cells.

Parameters

covariates : list of str Column names in meta whose combinations define technical groups (e.g., ['cell_line'] or ['cell_line', 'lane']). Pass an empty list [] to create a single technical group for the whole dataset (no batch correction).

def fit_ntc( self, sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor', lr: float = 0.001, niters: int = None, nsamples: int = 1000, alpha_ewma: float = 0.05, beta_o_beta: float = 3, beta_o_alpha: float = 9, epsilon: float = 1e-06, minibatch_size: int = None, distribution: str = None, denominator: numpy.ndarray = None, modality_name: str = None, use_all_cells: bool = False, force_iaf: bool = False, **kwargs): 
 640    def fit_ntc(
 641        self,
 642        sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor',
 643        lr: float = 1e-3,
 644        niters: int = None,
 645        nsamples: int = 1_000,
 646        alpha_ewma: float = 0.05,
 647        beta_o_beta: float = 3,    # recommended to keep based on cell2location
 648        beta_o_alpha: float = 9,   # recommended to keep based on cell2location
 649        epsilon: float = 1e-6,
 650        minibatch_size: int = None,
 651        distribution: str = None,
 652        denominator: np.ndarray = None,
 653        modality_name: str = None,
 654        use_all_cells: bool = False,
 655        force_iaf: bool = False,
 656        **kwargs
 657    ):
 658        """
 659        Estimate technical batch effects and per-gene overdispersion from NTC cells.
 660
 661        Fits a Bayesian negative-binomial model to NTC (non-targeting control) cells,
 662        estimating multiplicative cell-line/batch scale factors (``alpha_y_mult``) and
 663        additive logit-scale corrections (``alpha_y_add``) per technical group.
 664        Results are stored on the primary modality as point estimates and are used by
 665        ``fit_trans()`` to correct for batch effects.
 666
 667        Call ``set_technical_groups()`` before this method.
 668
 669        Parameters
 670        ----------
 671        sum_factor_col : str, default 'sum_factor'
 672            Column in ``meta`` (or the primary modality's ``sum_factors`` DataFrame)
 673            containing size factors for normalisation.
 674        lr : float, default 1e-3
 675            Adam optimiser learning rate for SVI.
 676        niters : int, optional
 677            Number of SVI iterations.  Default: 50,000 for most distributions;
 678            100,000 for multinomial (which has a larger parameter space).
 679        nsamples : int, default 1000
 680            Number of posterior samples drawn after SVI for point-estimate summaries.
 681        alpha_ewma : float, default 0.05
 682            Smoothing weight for the exponential moving average of the ELBO loss used
 683            in convergence checking.  Smaller values give a smoother (but slower-
 684            reacting) estimate.
 685        beta_o_beta : float, default 3
 686            Beta parameter of the Gamma prior on the overdispersion ``o_y``.
 687            Matches the cell2location prior; change with care.
 688        beta_o_alpha : float, default 9
 689            Alpha parameter of the Gamma prior on ``o_y``.
 690            Matches the cell2location prior; change with care.
 691        epsilon : float, default 1e-6
 692            Small constant added for numerical stability.
 693        minibatch_size : int, optional
 694            Number of features to use per Predictive minibatch when sampling posteriors.
 695            If ``None`` (default), auto-computed from available RAM via ``psutil``.
 696        distribution : str, optional
 697            Likelihood distribution.  If ``None`` (default), auto-detected from the
 698            modality (e.g., ``'negbinom'``, ``'multinomial'``, ``'binomial'``).
 699        denominator : np.ndarray, optional
 700            Denominator array for binomial distributions.  If ``None``, auto-detected
 701            from the modality.
 702        modality_name : str, optional
 703            Modality to fit.  If ``None`` (default), uses the primary modality.
 704        use_all_cells : bool, default False
 705            If ``False`` (default): fit using NTC cells only (standard approach).
 706            If ``True``: fit using all cells, regardless of target.
 707
 708            **When to use** ``use_all_cells=True``:
 709
 710            - High-MOI experiments where batch effects are independent of perturbation.
 711            - When a single technical fit covers all cis genes (saves compute).
 712
 713            **When NOT to use** ``use_all_cells=True``:
 714
 715            - Technical groups correlate with cis expression (e.g., different cell
 716              lines have different perturbation efficiencies).
 717            - Low-MOI experiments with a clear NTC vs. perturbed cell distinction.
 718        force_iaf : bool, default False
 719            If ``True``, force use of an IAF (Inverse Autoregressive Flow) guide for
 720            multinomial models regardless of the number of categories.  By default,
 721            IAF is only used when the number of categories exceeds a threshold.
 722
 723        Warnings
 724        --------
 725        Using ``use_all_cells=True`` when technical effects correlate with cis
 726        expression can lead to over-correction and spurious trans-effect calls.
 727        """
 728
 729        # ---------------------------
 730        # Resolve modality/distribution
 731        # ---------------------------
 732        if modality_name is None:
 733            modality_name = self.model.primary_modality
 734        modality = self.model.get_modality(modality_name)
 735
 736        if distribution is None:
 737            distribution = modality.distribution
 738
 739        # ---------------------------
 740        # Set conditional default for niters
 741        # ---------------------------
 742        niters_was_default = (niters is None)
 743        if niters is None:
 744            # Default: 50,000 unless multivariate (multinomial), then 100,000
 745            if distribution in ('multinomial'):
 746                niters = 100_000
 747                print(f"[INFO] Using default niters=100,000 for multivariate distribution '{distribution}'")
 748            else:
 749                niters = 50_000
 750                print(f"[INFO] Using default niters=50,000 for distribution '{distribution}'")
 751
 752        if denominator is None and modality.denominator is not None:
 753            denominator = modality.denominator
 754
 755        # CRITICAL: Convert denominator numpy.matrix to numpy.ndarray if needed
 756        if denominator is not None and isinstance(denominator, np.matrix):
 757            print(f"[INFO] Converting deprecated numpy.matrix denominator to numpy.ndarray")
 758            denominator = np.asarray(denominator)
 759
 760        # ========================================================================
 761        # CRITICAL VALIDATION: Cis extraction requires negative binomial distribution
 762        # ========================================================================
 763        if (
 764            modality_name == self.model.primary_modality
 765            and hasattr(self.model, 'counts')
 766            and self.model.cis_gene is not None
 767            and 'cis' in self.model.modalities
 768        ):
 769            if distribution != 'negbinom':
 770                raise ValueError(
 771                    f"Primary modality has distribution '{distribution}', but cis effect extraction "
 772                    f"requires 'negbinom' distribution. "
 773                    f"The cis gene/feature must represent count data following a negative binomial distribution. "
 774                    f"Cannot perform cis modeling with '{distribution}' distribution."
 775                )
 776
 777        # Always use the modality's filtered counts directly (densify if sparse)
 778        counts_to_fit = modality.counts
 779        if hasattr(counts_to_fit, 'toarray'):
 780            counts_to_fit = counts_to_fit.toarray()
 781        if modality.cell_names is not None:
 782            modality_cells = modality.cell_names
 783        else:
 784            modality_cells = self.model.meta['cell'].values[:counts_to_fit.shape[modality.cells_axis]]
 785
 786        # Track number of trans features; we may append the cis gene row below
 787        n_trans_features = modality.dims['n_features']
 788        cis_idx_in_counts = None  # set if cis gene is appended as last row
 789
 790        # For primary modality with a cis gene: append the cis gene row so we can
 791        # estimate alpha_x_prefit from the technical fit (NTC cells only).
 792        from scipy import sparse
 793        if (modality_name == self.model.primary_modality
 794                and self.model.cis_gene is not None
 795                and 'cis' in self.model.modalities):
 796            cis_mod = self.model.get_modality('cis')
 797            # cis modality has cells_axis=1, so counts is [1, N]
 798            cis_row = cis_mod.counts if cis_mod.cells_axis == 1 else cis_mod.counts.T
 799
 800            if sparse.issparse(counts_to_fit):
 801                cis_row_sp = (cis_row.tocsr() if sparse.issparse(cis_row)
 802                              else sparse.csr_matrix(np.asarray(cis_row).reshape(1, -1)))
 803                counts_to_fit = sparse.vstack([counts_to_fit, cis_row_sp], format='csr')
 804            else:
 805                cis_row_dense = np.asarray(cis_row).reshape(1, -1)
 806                counts_to_fit = np.vstack([np.asarray(counts_to_fit), cis_row_dense])
 807
 808            cis_idx_in_counts = n_trans_features  # cis gene is the last row
 809            print(f"[INFO] Appended cis gene '{self.model.cis_gene}' for alpha_x estimation")
 810
 811        # CRITICAL: Convert numpy.matrix to numpy.ndarray if needed
 812        # numpy.matrix is deprecated and has problematic indexing behavior with boolean arrays
 813        if isinstance(counts_to_fit, np.matrix):
 814            print(f"[INFO] Converting deprecated numpy.matrix to numpy.ndarray")
 815            counts_to_fit = np.asarray(counts_to_fit)
 816        elif not isinstance(counts_to_fit, (np.ndarray, type(None))) and hasattr(counts_to_fit, '__array__'):
 817            # Handle any other array-like objects that aren't standard numpy arrays
 818            counts_to_fit = np.asarray(counts_to_fit)
 819
 820        # CRITICAL: Convert COO sparse matrices to CSR for efficient row indexing
 821        # COO matrices don't support indexing operations needed throughout this function
 822        # CSR is optimal for row-based operations (subsetting, slicing, means)
 823        if sparse.issparse(counts_to_fit):
 824            if sparse.isspmatrix_coo(counts_to_fit):
 825                print(f"[INFO] Converting COO sparse matrix to CSR for efficient row indexing")
 826                counts_to_fit = counts_to_fit.tocsr()
 827
 828        print(f"[INFO] Fitting NTC model for modality '{modality_name}' (distribution: {distribution})")
 829    
 830        # ---------------------------
 831        # Validate requirements
 832        # ---------------------------
 833        from .distributions import requires_sum_factor, requires_denominator, is_3d_distribution
 834    
 835        if requires_sum_factor(distribution) and sum_factor_col is None:
 836            raise ValueError(f"Distribution '{distribution}' requires sum_factor_col parameter")
 837
 838        if requires_sum_factor(distribution) and modality.sum_factors is None:
 839            raise ValueError(
 840                f"Modality '{modality_name}' has distribution '{distribution}' but no sum_factors "
 841                f"DataFrame has been set. Assign a cell-indexed DataFrame to "
 842                f"modality.sum_factors before calling fit_ntc()."
 843            )
 844
 845        if requires_denominator(distribution) and denominator is None:
 846            raise ValueError(f"Distribution '{distribution}' requires denominator parameter")
 847    
 848        if "technical_group_code" not in self.model.meta.columns:
 849            warnings.warn(
 850                "technical_group_code not set — assuming single group (no technical covariate correction). "
 851                "Call set_technical_groups(['cell_line', ...]) before fit_ntc() if you have multiple batches or cell lines.",
 852                UserWarning,
 853            )
