1593
1594            # Copy log2_x_true (also needs subsetting)
1595            if hasattr(self, 'log2_x_true') and self.log2_x_true is not None:
1596                if isinstance(self.log2_x_true, torch.Tensor):
1597                    model_new.log2_x_true = self.log2_x_true[cell_indices_torch].clone()
1598
1599            # Copy posterior_samples_cis with cell-indexed tensors subsetted
1600            if hasattr(self, 'posterior_samples_cis') and self.posterior_samples_cis is not None:
1601                n_cells_orig = len(self.meta)
1602                subsetted_cis = {}
1603                for key, val in self.posterior_samples_cis.items():
1604                    if isinstance(val, torch.Tensor) and val.shape[-1] == n_cells_orig:
1605                        # This tensor has cell dimension - subset it
1606                        subsetted_cis[key] = val[..., cell_indices_torch].clone()
1607                    elif isinstance(val, torch.Tensor):
1608                        subsetted_cis[key] = val.clone()
1609                    else:
1610                        subsetted_cis[key] = val
1611                model_new.posterior_samples_cis = subsetted_cis
1612            if hasattr(self, 'loss_x') and self.loss_x is not None:
1613                model_new.loss_x = self.loss_x
1614            if hasattr(self, 'posterior_samples_trans') and self.posterior_samples_trans is not None:
1615                model_new.posterior_samples_trans = self.posterior_samples_trans
1616            if hasattr(self, 'losses_trans') and self.losses_trans is not None:
1617                model_new.losses_trans = self.losses_trans
1618
1619            # Copy traces if they exist
1620            if self.trace_cellline is not None:
1621                model_new.trace_cellline = self.trace_cellline
1622            if self.trace_x is not None:
1623                model_new.trace_x = self.trace_x
1624            if self.trace_y is not None:
1625                model_new.trace_y = self.trace_y
1626
1627            print("[INFO] Preserved fitted parameters in subset model")
1628
1629        # Unconditionally copy sum_factors to all modalities that have them.
1630        # _init_sum_factors already seeded primary/cis from meta columns, but
1631        # dynamically-added columns (sum_factor_adj, sum_factor_refit, …) live only
1632        # on the modality object and must be transferred here.
1633        # get_cell_subset() for non-primary modalities leaves sum_factors=None,
1634        # so this also fixes those.
1635        cells_to_keep_index = set(cells_to_keep)
1636        for mod_name, orig_mod in self.modalities.items():
1637            if orig_mod.sum_factors is None:
1638                continue
1639            if mod_name not in model_new.modalities:
1640                continue
1641            keep_idx = orig_mod.sum_factors.index.intersection(list(cells_to_keep_index))
1642            if len(keep_idx) == 0:
1643                continue
1644            model_new.modalities[mod_name].sum_factors = orig_mod.sum_factors.loc[keep_idx].copy()
1645        # cis always shares the same DataFrame object as primary
1646        if ('cis' in model_new.modalities
1647                and model_new.primary_modality in model_new.modalities):
1648            model_new.modalities['cis'].sum_factors = (
1649                model_new.modalities[model_new.primary_modality].sum_factors
1650            )
1651
1652        return model_new

Create a new model instance with a subset of cells.

Useful for testing without technical correction by subsetting to a single technical group (e.g., one cell line only).

Parameters

cell_mask : np.ndarray, pd.Series, or list, optional Boolean mask or list of cell names to keep. If None, must provide query. query : str, optional Pandas query string to filter cells (e.g., "cell_line == 'K562'"). Applied to self.meta. If None, must provide cell_mask. preserve_fits : bool If True (default), copy fitted parameters (alpha_x_prefit, alpha_y_prefit, x_true, etc.) to the new model. Set to False to start fresh with the subset.

Returns

bayesDREAM New model instance with subsetted cells

Examples

Subset by query

model_k562 = model.subset_cells(query="cell_line == 'K562'")

Subset by mask

mask = model.meta['cell_line'].str.contains('K562') model_k562 = model.subset_cells(cell_mask=mask)

Subset by cell list

cells = model.meta[model.meta['cell_line'] == 'K562']['cell'].tolist() model_k562 = model.subset_cells(cell_mask=cells)

def permute_x_true( self, covariates: list[str] = None, sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor_adj'): 
1280    def permute_x_true(
1281        self,
1282        covariates: list[str] = None,
1283        sum_factor_col: str = 'sum_factor_adj',
1284    ):
1285        """
1286        Resample ``x_true`` and cis counts among NTC cells to break residual
1287        cis correlation before trans fitting.
1288
1289        Operates only on NTC cells: within each covariate group, draws a
1290        bootstrap resample of the NTC indices (with replacement) and applies
1291        it simultaneously to ``self.x_true`` and the ``'cis'`` modality counts,
1292        keeping them in sync.
1293
1294        Call *after* ``fit_cis()`` and ``adjust_ntc_sum_factor()``, and
1295        *before* ``fit_trans()``.  Typically paired with ``permute_from_ntc``
1296        on the trans modality::
1297
1298            from bayesDREAM.simulation import permute_from_ntc
1299            permute_from_ntc(model.get_modality('gene'), model.meta,
1300                             covariates=['cell_line'])
1301            model.permute_x_true(covariates=['cell_line'])
1302
1303        Parameters
1304        ----------
1305        covariates : list of str, optional
1306            Columns in ``meta`` used to stratify permutation.  If ``None``,
1307            all cells are treated as one group.
1308        sum_factor_col : str, default ``'sum_factor_adj'``
1309            Column in the primary modality's ``sum_factors`` used to
1310            normalise cis counts before resampling.
1311        """
1312        cis_mod = self.get_modality('cis') if 'cis' in self.modalities else None
1313        if cis_mod is None or self.x_true is None:
1314            raise ValueError(
1315                "permute_x_true requires a fitted 'cis' modality and x_true. "
1316                "Run fit_cis() first."
1317            )
1318
1319        primary_mod = self.get_modality(self.primary_modality)
1320        if primary_mod.sum_factors is None or sum_factor_col not in primary_mod.sum_factors.columns:
1321            raise ValueError(
1322                f"No column '{sum_factor_col}' in primary modality sum_factors. "
1323                "Run adjust_ntc_sum_factor() first."
1324            )
1325
1326        cis_cell_to_col = {cell: i for i, cell in enumerate(cis_mod.cell_names)}
1327        cis_counts_work = cis_mod.counts.copy()
1328        cis_is_sparse = sparse.issparse(cis_counts_work)
1329        cis_row = 0  # cis modality has exactly 1 feature row
1330
1331        if isinstance(self.x_true, torch.Tensor):
1332            x_true_np = self.x_true.detach().cpu().numpy().copy()
1333        else:
1334            x_true_np = np.array(self.x_true)
1335
1336        groups = self.meta.groupby(covariates) if covariates else [(None, self.meta)]
1337        for _key, group in groups:
1338            ntc_cells = group.loc[group['target'] == 'ntc', 'cell'].values
1339            if len(ntc_cells) == 0:
1340                continue
1341
1342            ntc_col_idx = [cis_cell_to_col[c] for c in ntc_cells if c in cis_cell_to_col]
1343            if not ntc_col_idx:
1344                continue
1345
1346            sf_ntc = primary_mod.sum_factors.loc[ntc_cells, sum_factor_col].values
1347
1348            if cis_is_sparse:
1349                ntc_expr = np.asarray(
1350                    cis_counts_work[cis_row, ntc_col_idx].todense()
1351                ).flatten().astype(float)
1352            else:
1353                ntc_expr = np.asarray(cis_counts_work)[cis_row, ntc_col_idx].astype(float)
1354
1355            perm_idx = np.random.choice(len(ntc_cells), size=len(ntc_cells), replace=True)
1356            new_cis = np.round((ntc_expr / np.maximum(sf_ntc, 1e-12))[perm_idx] * sf_ntc)
1357
1358            if cis_is_sparse:
1359                cis_counts_work = cis_counts_work.tolil()
1360                for i, col in enumerate(ntc_col_idx):
1361                    cis_counts_work[cis_row, col] = new_cis[i]
1362                cis_counts_work = cis_counts_work.tocsr()
1363            else:
1364                cis_counts_work = np.asarray(cis_counts_work)
1365                cis_counts_work[cis_row, ntc_col_idx] = new_cis
1366
1367            meta_ntc_idx = self.meta.index[self.meta['cell'].isin(ntc_cells)].tolist()
1368            x_true_np[meta_ntc_idx] = x_true_np[meta_ntc_idx][perm_idx]
1369
1370        cis_mod.counts = cis_counts_work
1371        self.x_true = torch.tensor(x_true_np, dtype=self.x_true.dtype, device=self.x_true.device)

Resample x_true and cis counts among NTC cells to break residual cis correlation before trans fitting.

Operates only on NTC cells: within each covariate group, draws a bootstrap resample of the NTC indices (with replacement) and applies it simultaneously to self.x_true and the 'cis' modality counts, keeping them in sync.

Call after fit_cis() and adjust_ntc_sum_factor(), and before fit_trans(). Typically paired with permute_from_ntc on the trans modality::

from bayesDREAM.simulation import permute_from_ntc
permute_from_ntc(model.get_modality('gene'), model.meta,
                 covariates=['cell_line'])
model.permute_x_true(covariates=['cell_line'])

Parameters

covariates : list of str, optional Columns in meta used to stratify permutation. If None, all cells are treated as one group. sum_factor_col : str, default 'sum_factor_adj' Column in the primary modality's sum_factors used to normalise cis counts before resampling.

def save_ntc_fit( self, output_dir: str = None, modalities: list = None, verbose: bool = False, save_model_level: bool = None): 
 27    def save_ntc_fit(self, output_dir: str = None, modalities: list = None, verbose: bool = False,
 28                          save_model_level: bool = None):
 29        """
 30        Save fitted NTC parameters from fit_ntc().
 31
 32        Parameters
 33        ----------
 34        output_dir : str, optional
 35            Directory to save to. If None, uses self.model.output_dir.
 36        modalities : list of str, optional
 37            List of modality names to save. If None, saves all modalities.
 38            Example: ['gene', 'atac']
 39        verbose : bool
 40            If True, print detailed save information. Default False (summary only).
 41
 42        Returns
 43        -------
 44        dict
 45            Paths to saved files
 46
 47        Notes
 48        -----
 49        Saves per-modality:
 50        - alpha_y_prefit_{modality}.pt: Appropriate alpha_y for distribution (add or mult)
 51        - posterior_samples_ntc_{modality}.pt: Full posterior samples
 52
 53        Saves model-level (automatically when primary modality is included):
 54        - alpha_x_prefit.pt: Cis gene overdispersion (if set)
 55        - alpha_y_prefit.pt: Trans gene overdispersion (from primary modality)
 56        """
 57        if output_dir is None:
 58            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
 59
 60        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
 61
 62        saved_files = {}
 63        saved_summary = []
 64
 65        # Determine which modalities to save
 66        if modalities is None:
 67            modalities_to_save = list(self.model.modalities.keys())
 68        else:
 69            # Validate requested modalities
 70            invalid = set(modalities) - set(self.model.modalities.keys())
 71            if invalid:
 72                raise ValueError(f"Unknown modalities: {invalid}. Available: {list(self.model.modalities.keys())}")
 73            modalities_to_save = modalities
 74
 75        # Determine whether to save model-level parameters
 76        if save_model_level is None:
 77            should_save_model_level = self.model.primary_modality in modalities_to_save
 78        else:
 79            should_save_model_level = save_model_level
 80
 81        # Save model-level parameters (when primary modality is being saved)
 82        if should_save_model_level:
 83            if hasattr(self.model, 'alpha_x_prefit') and self.model.alpha_x_prefit is not None:
 84                path = os.path.join(output_dir, 'alpha_x_prefit.pt')
 85                torch.save(self.model.alpha_x_prefit, path)
 86                saved_files['alpha_x_prefit'] = path
 87                saved_summary.append('alpha_x')
 88                if verbose:
 89                    print(f"[SAVE] alpha_x_prefit → {path}")
 90
 91        # Save per-modality alpha_y_prefit and posterior_samples_ntc
 92        for mod_name in modalities_to_save:
 93            mod = self.model.modalities[mod_name]
 94            mod_saved = []
 95
 96            # Save distribution-appropriate alpha_y
 97            if hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit') and mod.alpha_y_prefit is not None:
 98                # Determine which alpha_y to save based on distribution
 99                if mod.distribution == 'negbinom':
100                    # Save multiplicative for negbinom
101                    if hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
102                        alpha_to_save = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
103                        alpha_type = 'mult'
104                    else:
105                        alpha_to_save = mod.alpha_y_prefit
106                        alpha_type = 'mult'
107                else:
108                    # Save additive for normal, binomial, multinomial
109                    if hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and mod.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
110                        alpha_to_save = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
111                        alpha_type = 'add'
112                    else:
113                        alpha_to_save = mod.alpha_y_prefit
114                        alpha_type = 'add'
115
116                path = os.path.join(output_dir, f'alpha_y_prefit_{mod_name}.pt')
117                torch.save(alpha_to_save, path)
118                saved_files[f'alpha_y_prefit_{mod_name}'] = path
119                mod_saved.append('alpha_y')
120                if verbose:
121                    print(f"[SAVE] {mod_name}.alpha_y_prefit ({alpha_type}) → {path}")
122
123            # Save modality-specific posterior_samples_ntc
124            if hasattr(mod, 'posterior_samples_ntc') and mod.posterior_samples_ntc is not None:
125                # Remove large observation arrays before saving
126                # Ensure alpha_y_add and alpha_y_mult are present for downstream loading
127                posterior_clean = {k: v for k, v in mod.posterior_samples_ntc.items()
128                                 if k not in ['y_obs_ntc', 'y_obs']}
129
130                # Verify critical keys are present for downstream loading
131                if mod.distribution != 'negbinom' and 'alpha_y_add' not in posterior_clean:
132                    if hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and mod.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
133                        posterior_clean['alpha_y_add'] = mod.alpha_y_prefit_add
134
135                if mod.distribution == 'negbinom' and 'alpha_y_mult' not in posterior_clean and 'alpha_y' not in posterior_clean:
136                    if hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
137                        posterior_clean['alpha_y_mult'] = mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult
138
139                # Add feature metadata (including full DataFrame for excluded features tracking)
140                # Use the modality's authoritative feature count (same reason as trans save)
141                n_features = mod.dims.get('n_features', None)
142                if n_features is None:
143                    _sample_tensor = next((v for v in posterior_clean.values()
144                                           if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) and v.ndim >= 2), None)
145                    n_features = _sample_tensor.shape[-1] if _sample_tensor is not None else None
146                posterior_with_meta = {
147                    'posterior_samples': posterior_clean,
148                    'modality_name': mod_name,
149                    'distribution': mod.distribution,
150                    'feature_names': mod.feature_names if hasattr(mod, 'feature_names') else None,
151                    'n_features': n_features,
152                    'feature_meta': mod.feature_meta.to_dict('records') if hasattr(mod, 'feature_meta') and mod.feature_meta is not None else None,
153                    'loss_ntc': mod.loss_ntc if hasattr(mod, 'loss_ntc') else None
154                }
155
156                path = os.path.join(output_dir, f'posterior_samples_ntc_{mod_name}.pt')
157                torch.save(posterior_with_meta, path)
158                saved_files[f'posterior_samples_ntc_{mod_name}'] = path
159                mod_saved.append(f'posterior({n_features} features)')
160                if verbose:
161                    print(f"[SAVE] {mod_name}.posterior_samples_ntc ({n_features} features) → {path}")
162
163            if mod_saved:
164                saved_summary.append(f"{mod_name}: {', '.join(mod_saved)}")
165
166        # Print summary
167        print(f"[SAVE] NTC fit to {output_dir}")
168        if saved_summary:
169            print(f"[SAVE] Saved: {'; '.join(saved_summary)}")
170
171        return saved_files

def load_ntc_fit( self, input_dir: str = None, modalities: list = None, verbose: bool = False, load_model_level: bool = None, mask_features: bool = False): 
308    def load_ntc_fit(self, input_dir: str = None,
309                          modalities: list = None, verbose: bool = False,
310                          load_model_level: bool = None,
311                          mask_features: bool = False):
312        """
313        Load fitted technical parameters.
314
315        Parameters
316        ----------
317        input_dir : str, optional
318            Directory to load from. If None, uses self.model.output_dir.
319        modalities : list of str, optional
320            List of modality names to load. If None, attempts to load all existing modalities.
321            Example: ['gene', 'atac']
322        verbose : bool
323            If True, print detailed loading information. Default False (summary only).
324
325        Returns
326        -------
327        dict
328            Loaded parameters (keys only, not full tensors)
329        """
330        if input_dir is None:
331            input_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
332
333        loaded = {}
334        loaded_summary = []  # Track what was loaded for summary
335
336        # Determine which modalities to load
337        if modalities is None:
338            modalities_to_load = list(self.model.modalities.keys())
339        else:
340            # Validate requested modalities
341            invalid = set(modalities) - set(self.model.modalities.keys())
342            if invalid:
343                raise ValueError(f"Unknown modalities: {invalid}. Available: {list(self.model.modalities.keys())}")
344            modalities_to_load = modalities
345
346        # Determine whether to load model-level parameters
347        if load_model_level is None:
348            should_load_model_level = self.model.primary_modality in modalities_to_load
349        else:
350            should_load_model_level = load_model_level
351
352        # Load model-level parameters (when primary modality is being loaded)
353        if should_load_model_level:
354            # Load alpha_x_prefit
355            alpha_x_path = os.path.join(input_dir, 'alpha_x_prefit.pt')
356            if os.path.exists(alpha_x_path):
357                alpha_x = _torch_load(alpha_x_path)
358                # Backward compat: if saved as 3D posterior, collapse to mean
359                if isinstance(alpha_x, torch.Tensor) and alpha_x.ndim >= 2 and alpha_x.shape[0] > 1:
360                    alpha_x = alpha_x.mean(dim=0)
361                self.model.alpha_x_prefit = alpha_x.flatten()
362                loaded['alpha_x_prefit'] = True
363                loaded_summary.append('alpha_x')
364                if verbose:
365                    print(f"[LOAD] alpha_x_prefit ← {alpha_x_path}")
366
367            # Load alpha_y_prefit (legacy model-level file → primary modality)
368            alpha_y_path = os.path.join(input_dir, 'alpha_y_prefit.pt')
369            if os.path.exists(alpha_y_path):
370                alpha_y = _torch_load(alpha_y_path)
371                # Backward compat: if saved as 3D posterior, collapse to mean
372                if isinstance(alpha_y, torch.Tensor) and alpha_y.ndim >= 3:
373                    alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(dim=0)
374                primary_mod = self.model.get_modality(self.model.primary_modality)
375                primary_mod.alpha_y_prefit = alpha_y  # Uses property to set distribution-specific attr
376                loaded['alpha_y_prefit'] = True
377                if verbose:
378                    print(f"[LOAD] alpha_y_prefit → {self.model.primary_modality} modality ← {alpha_y_path}")
379
380        # Load per-modality alpha_y_prefit and posterior_samples_ntc
381        for mod_name in modalities_to_load:
382            mod = self.model.modalities[mod_name]
383            mod_loaded = []
384
385            # Resolve current feature names for alignment
386            current_feature_names = (mod.feature_names
387                                     if mod.feature_names is not None
388                                     else (list(mod.feature_meta.index)
389                                           if mod.feature_meta is not None else None))
390
391            # ── posterior_samples_ntc (load first to get saved feature names) ──
392            saved_feature_names = None
393            n_features_saved = None
394
395            posterior_path = os.path.join(input_dir, f'posterior_samples_ntc_{mod_name}.pt')
396            if not os.path.exists(posterior_path):
397                # Backward compat: try old filename
398                legacy_path = os.path.join(input_dir, f'posterior_samples_technical_{mod_name}.pt')
399                if os.path.exists(legacy_path):
400                    posterior_path = legacy_path
401            if os.path.exists(posterior_path):
402                loaded_data = _torch_load(posterior_path)
403                n_features = None
404
405                if isinstance(loaded_data, dict) and 'posterior_samples' in loaded_data:
406                    posterior_raw = loaded_data['posterior_samples']
407                    n_features = loaded_data.get('n_features')
408                    saved_feature_names = loaded_data.get('feature_names')
409                    n_features_saved = n_features
410
411                    # Align posteriors to current modality's feature set
412                    if (current_feature_names is not None and saved_feature_names is not None
413                            and current_feature_names != saved_feature_names):
414                        posterior_raw, feat_mask = _align_posterior_features(
415                            posterior_raw, saved_feature_names, current_feature_names, n_features_saved)
416                        _report_alignment(f"{mod_name} NTC posterior",
417                                          saved_feature_names, current_feature_names, feat_mask)
418                        _check_nan_features(feat_mask, mod_name, mask_features)
419                        if feat_mask is not None:
420                            mod.fitted_feature_mask = feat_mask
421                            if mask_features and not feat_mask.all():
422                                # Fill NaN positions with baseline alpha_y — same treatment as
423                                # zero-NTC-count features in fit_ntc's _reconstruct_full_2d:
424                                # 1.0 for negbinom (multiplicative), 0.0 for all other distributions.
425                                for k in list(posterior_raw.keys()):
426                                    if isinstance(posterior_raw[k], torch.Tensor):
427                                        posterior_raw[k] = _fill_nan_with_baseline(
428                                            posterior_raw[k], feat_mask, mod.distribution)
429                                n_missing = int((~feat_mask).sum())
430                                print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}: {n_missing} missing feature(s) filled "
431                                      f"with baseline alpha_y (mask_features=True).")
432                    mod.posterior_samples_ntc = posterior_raw
433
434                    # Reconstruct feature_meta DataFrame if present
435                    if loaded_data.get('feature_meta') is not None:
436                        _ = pd.DataFrame(loaded_data['feature_meta'])  # available if needed
437
438                    loaded[f'posterior_samples_ntc_{mod_name}_metadata'] = {
439                        'modality_name': loaded_data.get('modality_name'),
440                        'distribution': loaded_data.get('distribution'),
441                        'n_features': n_features
442                    }
443
444                    if loaded_data.get('loss_ntc') is not None:
445                        mod.loss_ntc = loaded_data['loss_ntc']
446                        mod_loaded.append(f'loss({len(mod.loss_ntc)})')
447
448                    if verbose:
449                        print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.posterior_samples_ntc ({n_features} features) ← {posterior_path}")
450                else:
451                    # Old format without feature metadata — no alignment possible
452                    mod.posterior_samples_ntc = loaded_data
453                    if verbose:
454                        print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.posterior_samples_ntc (old format) ← {posterior_path}")
455
456                loaded[f'posterior_samples_ntc_{mod_name}'] = True
457                mod_loaded.append(f'posterior({n_features or "?"} features)')
458
459                # Extract and set specific alpha attributes from posterior_samples
460                if 'alpha_y_add' in mod.posterior_samples_ntc:
461                    if not hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') or mod.alpha_y_prefit_add is None:
462                        alpha_y_add = mod.posterior_samples_ntc['alpha_y_add']
463                        if isinstance(alpha_y_add, torch.Tensor):
464                            collapse_threshold = 4 if mod.distribution == 'multinomial' else 3
465                            if alpha_y_add.ndim >= collapse_threshold:
466                                alpha_y_add = alpha_y_add.mean(dim=0)
467                        mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = alpha_y_add
468                        if not hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit') or mod.alpha_y_prefit is None:
469                            if mod.distribution != 'negbinom':
470                                mod.alpha_y_prefit = alpha_y_add
471                        if verbose:
472                            print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.alpha_y_prefit_add ← extracted from posterior_samples_ntc")
473
474                if 'alpha_y_mult' in mod.posterior_samples_ntc or 'alpha_y' in mod.posterior_samples_ntc:
475                    alpha_y_mult_key = 'alpha_y_mult' if 'alpha_y_mult' in mod.posterior_samples_ntc else 'alpha_y'
476                    if not hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') or mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult is None:
477                        alpha_y_mult = mod.posterior_samples_ntc[alpha_y_mult_key]
478                        if isinstance(alpha_y_mult, torch.Tensor) and alpha_y_mult.ndim >= 3:
479                            alpha_y_mult = alpha_y_mult.mean(dim=0)
480                        mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = alpha_y_mult
481                        if not hasattr(mod, 'alpha_y_prefit') or mod.alpha_y_prefit is None:
482                            if mod.distribution == 'negbinom':
483                                mod.alpha_y_prefit = alpha_y_mult
484                        if verbose:
485                            print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.alpha_y_prefit_mult ← extracted from posterior_samples_ntc")
486
487            # ── alpha_y_prefit standalone file (align using names from posterior file) ──
488            mod_path = os.path.join(input_dir, f'alpha_y_prefit_{mod_name}.pt')
489            if os.path.exists(mod_path):
490                alpha_y_to_set = _torch_load(mod_path)
491                if isinstance(alpha_y_to_set, torch.Tensor):
492                    collapse_threshold = 4 if mod.distribution == 'multinomial' else 3
493                    if alpha_y_to_set.ndim >= collapse_threshold:
494                        alpha_y_to_set = alpha_y_to_set.mean(dim=0)
495
496                # Align if we have both saved and current feature names
497                if (current_feature_names is not None and saved_feature_names is not None
498                        and current_feature_names != saved_feature_names
499                        and n_features_saved is not None):
500                    dim = _detect_feature_dim(alpha_y_to_set, n_features_saved)
501                    if dim is not None:
502                        alpha_y_to_set, feat_mask = _align_tensor(
503                            alpha_y_to_set, saved_feature_names, current_feature_names, dim)
504                        _report_alignment(f"{mod_name} alpha_y_prefit",
505                                          saved_feature_names, current_feature_names, feat_mask)
506                        _check_nan_features(feat_mask, mod_name, mask_features)
507                        if feat_mask is not None:
508                            if not hasattr(mod, 'fitted_feature_mask'):
509                                mod.fitted_feature_mask = feat_mask
510                            if mask_features and not feat_mask.all():
511                                alpha_y_to_set = _fill_nan_with_baseline(
512                                    alpha_y_to_set, feat_mask, mod.distribution)
513
514                mod.alpha_y_prefit = alpha_y_to_set
515                if mod.distribution == 'negbinom':
516                    mod.alpha_y_prefit_mult = alpha_y_to_set
517                else:
518                    mod.alpha_y_prefit_add = alpha_y_to_set
519
520                loaded[f'alpha_y_prefit_{mod_name}'] = True
521                mod_loaded.append('alpha_y')
522                if verbose:
523                    print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.alpha_y_prefit ← {mod_path}")
524
525            if mod_loaded:
526                loaded_summary.append(f"{mod_name}: {', '.join(mod_loaded)}")
527
528        # Print summary
529        print(f"[LOAD] NTC fit from {input_dir}")
530        if loaded_summary:
531            print(f"[LOAD] Loaded: {'; '.join(loaded_summary)}")
532
533        # Warn if alpha_y_prefit was not loaded for modalities that need it
534        # Note: 'cis' modality doesn't need alpha_y_prefit (it uses alpha_x instead)
535        modalities_missing_alpha_y = []
536        for mod_name in modalities_to_load:
537            # Skip 'cis' modality - it's for cis gene fitting, not trans fitting
538            if mod_name == 'cis':
539                continue
540            mod = self.model.modalities[mod_name]
541            if mod.alpha_y_prefit is None:
542                modalities_missing_alpha_y.append(mod_name)
543
544        if modalities_missing_alpha_y:
545            import warnings
546            warnings.warn(
547                f"[WARNING] alpha_y_prefit was NOT loaded for modalities: {modalities_missing_alpha_y}. "
548                f"This will cause fit_trans() to fail for these modalities. "
549                f"Check that the following files exist in {input_dir}:\n"
550                f"  - alpha_y_prefit.pt (legacy format for primary modality)\n"
551                f"  - alpha_y_prefit_<modality>.pt (per-modality format)\n"
552                f"  - posterior_samples_ntc_<modality>.pt (contains alpha_y in posterior samples)\n"
553                f"If files are in a different directory, use load_ntc_fit(input_dir='path/to/saved/fit')",
554                UserWarning
555            )
556
557        return loaded

Load fitted technical parameters.

Parameters

If None, attempts to load all existing modalities. Example: ['gene', 'atac'] verbose : bool If True, print detailed loading information. Default False (summary only).

def load_cis_fit( self, input_dir: str = None, verbose: bool = False, subset_cells: bool = False): 
559    def load_cis_fit(self, input_dir: str = None, verbose: bool = False,
560                     subset_cells: bool = False):
561        """
562        Load fitted cis parameters.
563
564        Parameters
565        ----------
566        input_dir : str, optional
567            Directory to load from. If None, uses self.model.output_dir.
568        verbose : bool
569            If True, print detailed loading information. Default False (summary only).
570
571        Returns
572        -------
573        dict
574            Loaded parameters (keys only, not full tensors)
575        """
576        if input_dir is None:
577            input_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
578
579        loaded = {}
580        loaded_summary = []
581
582        # Current cell names for alignment
583        current_cell_names = (self.model.meta['cell'].tolist()
584                              if 'cell' in self.model.meta.columns else None)
585
586        # Load posterior samples first so we have saved_cell_names for aligning x_true files
587        saved_cell_names = None
588        cis_gene = None
589
590        posterior_path = os.path.join(input_dir, 'posterior_samples_cis.pt')
591        if os.path.exists(posterior_path):
592            loaded_data = _torch_load(posterior_path)
593
594            if isinstance(loaded_data, dict) and 'posterior_samples' in loaded_data:
595                posterior_raw = loaded_data['posterior_samples']
596                cis_gene = loaded_data.get('cis_gene')
597                saved_cell_names = loaded_data.get('cell_names')
598
599                # Align per-cell tensors in the posterior (x_true, log_x_true)
600                if (current_cell_names is not None and saved_cell_names is not None
601                        and current_cell_names != saved_cell_names):
602                    # Pre-compute cell mask to check for missing cells
603                    _saved_set = set(saved_cell_names)
604                    _cell_mask_preview = torch.tensor(
605                        [c in _saved_set for c in current_cell_names], dtype=torch.bool)
606
607                    # Error or subset before doing any NaN alignment
608                    _check_nan_cells(_cell_mask_preview, subset_cells)
609
610                    if subset_cells and not _cell_mask_preview.all():
611                        # Reduce model to only cells present in the saved fit
612                        keep_cells = [c for c in current_cell_names if c in _saved_set]
613                        _subset_model_cells_inplace(self.model, keep_cells)
614                        current_cell_names = keep_cells
615                        print(f"[LOAD] subset_cells=True: model reduced to "
616                              f"{len(keep_cells)} cells present in saved cis fit.")
617
618                    # Now align (if sets still differ, e.g. saved has cells not in current)
619                    if current_cell_names != saved_cell_names:
620                        n_cells_saved = len(saved_cell_names)
621                        per_cell_keys = [k for k, v in posterior_raw.items()
622                                         if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor)
623                                         and v.shape[-1] == n_cells_saved]
624                        cell_mask = None
625                        for k in per_cell_keys:
626                            posterior_raw[k], cell_mask = _align_tensor(
627                                posterior_raw[k], saved_cell_names, current_cell_names,
628                                dim=posterior_raw[k].ndim - 1)
629                        if cell_mask is not None:
630                            _report_alignment("cis posterior cells",
631                                              saved_cell_names, current_cell_names, cell_mask)
632                            self.model.fitted_cell_mask = cell_mask
633
634                self.model.posterior_samples_cis = posterior_raw
635
636                if loaded_data.get('feature_meta') is not None:
637                    _ = pd.DataFrame(loaded_data['feature_meta'])  # available if needed
638
639                loaded['posterior_samples_cis_metadata'] = {
640                    'cis_gene': cis_gene,
641                    'modality_name': loaded_data.get('modality_name'),
642                }
643
644                if loaded_data.get('loss_x') is not None:
645                    self.model.loss_x = loaded_data['loss_x']
646                    loaded_summary.append(f"loss_x({len(self.model.loss_x)})")
647
648                if verbose:
649                    print(f"[LOAD] posterior_samples_cis (cis_gene: {cis_gene}) ← {posterior_path}")
650            else:
651                # Old format without feature metadata — no alignment possible
652                self.model.posterior_samples_cis = loaded_data
653                if verbose:
654                    print(f"[LOAD] posterior_samples_cis (old format) ← {posterior_path}")
655
656            loaded['posterior_samples_cis'] = True
657            loaded_summary.append("posterior_cis" + (f" ({cis_gene})" if cis_gene else ""))
658
659        # Load x_true (standalone file — align by cell if names available)
660        # Note: if subset_cells=True was applied above, current_cell_names is already reduced
661        x_true_path = os.path.join(input_dir, 'x_true.pt')
662        if os.path.exists(x_true_path):
663            x_true = _torch_load(x_true_path)
664            if isinstance(x_true, torch.Tensor) and x_true.ndim >= 2:
665                x_true = x_true.mean(dim=0)
666            if (current_cell_names is not None and saved_cell_names is not None
667                    and current_cell_names != saved_cell_names
668                    and x_true.ndim == 1 and x_true.shape[0] == len(saved_cell_names)):
669                # Check only — subset was already handled above (or will raise)
670                _saved_set = set(saved_cell_names)
671                _mask = torch.tensor([c in _saved_set for c in current_cell_names], dtype=torch.bool)
672                _check_nan_cells(_mask, subset_cells)
673                x_true, cell_mask = _align_cell_tensor(x_true, saved_cell_names, current_cell_names)
674                _report_alignment("x_true cells", saved_cell_names, current_cell_names, cell_mask)
675                if cell_mask is not None and not hasattr(self.model, 'fitted_cell_mask'):
676                    self.model.fitted_cell_mask = cell_mask
677            self.model.x_true = x_true
678            loaded['x_true'] = True
679            loaded_summary.append('x_true')
680            if verbose:
681                print(f"[LOAD] x_true ← {x_true_path}")
682
683        # Load log2_x_true (standalone file — align by cell if names available)
684        log2_x_true_path = os.path.join(input_dir, 'log2_x_true.pt')
685        if os.path.exists(log2_x_true_path):
686            log2_x_true = _torch_load(log2_x_true_path)
687            if isinstance(log2_x_true, torch.Tensor) and log2_x_true.ndim >= 2:
688                log2_x_true = log2_x_true.mean(dim=0)
689            if (current_cell_names is not None and saved_cell_names is not None
690                    and current_cell_names != saved_cell_names
691                    and log2_x_true.ndim == 1 and log2_x_true.shape[0] == len(saved_cell_names)):
692                log2_x_true, _ = _align_cell_tensor(log2_x_true, saved_cell_names, current_cell_names)
693            self.model.log2_x_true = log2_x_true
694            loaded['log2_x_true'] = True
695            loaded_summary.append('log2_x_true')
696            if verbose:
697                print(f"[LOAD] log2_x_true ← {log2_x_true_path}")
698
699        # Extract log2_x_true from posterior_samples_cis if not already loaded
700        if not hasattr(self.model, 'log2_x_true') or self.model.log2_x_true is None:
701            if (hasattr(self.model, 'posterior_samples_cis')
702                    and self.model.posterior_samples_cis is not None
703                    and 'log_x_true' in self.model.posterior_samples_cis):
704                log_x_true = self.model.posterior_samples_cis['log_x_true']
705                if isinstance(log_x_true, torch.Tensor) and log_x_true.ndim >= 2:
706                    log_x_true = log_x_true.mean(dim=0)
707                self.model.log2_x_true = log_x_true
708                loaded['log2_x_true'] = True
709                if verbose:
710                    print(f"[LOAD] log2_x_true ← extracted from posterior_samples_cis")
711            elif hasattr(self.model, 'x_true') and self.model.x_true is not None:
712                self.model.log2_x_true = torch.log2(self.model.x_true.clamp(min=1e-12))
713                loaded['log2_x_true'] = True
714                if verbose:
715                    print(f"[LOAD] log2_x_true ← computed from x_true")
716
717        # Print summary
718        print(f"[LOAD] Cis fit from {input_dir}")
719        if loaded_summary:
720            print(f"[LOAD] Loaded: {', '.join(loaded_summary)}")
721
722        return loaded

Load fitted cis parameters.

Parameters

input_dir : str, optional Directory to load from. If None, uses self.model.output_dir. verbose : bool If True, print detailed loading information. Default False (summary only).

Returns

dict Loaded parameters (keys only, not full tensors)

def load_trans_fit( self, input_dir: str = None, modalities: list = None, verbose: bool = False, subset_features: bool = False): 
725    def load_trans_fit(self, input_dir: str = None, modalities: list = None, verbose: bool = False,
726                       subset_features: bool = False):
727        """
728        Load fitted trans parameters.
729
730        Parameters
731        ----------
732        input_dir : str, optional
733            Directory to load from. If None, uses self.model.output_dir.
734        modalities : list of str, optional
735            List of modality names to load. If None, attempts to load all existing modalities.
736            Example: ['gene', 'atac']
737        verbose : bool
738            If True, print detailed loading information. Default False (summary only).
739        subset_features : bool
740            If False (default), raise an error when the current modality contains features
741            that were not present in the saved trans fit (would introduce NaN posteriors).
742            If True, subset the modality in-place to only the features present in the saved
743            fit so that loading proceeds without NaNs.
744
745        Returns
746        -------
747        dict
748            Loaded parameters (keys only, not full tensors)
749        """
750        if input_dir is None:
751            input_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
752
753        loaded = {}
754        loaded_summary = []
755
756        # Determine which modalities to load
757        if modalities is None:
758            modalities_to_load = list(self.model.modalities.keys())
759        else:
760            # Validate requested modalities
761            invalid = set(modalities) - set(self.model.modalities.keys())
762            if invalid:
763                raise ValueError(f"Unknown modalities: {invalid}. Available: {list(self.model.modalities.keys())}")
764            modalities_to_load = modalities
765
766        # Automatically load model-level parameters if primary modality is included
767        should_load_model_level = self.model.primary_modality in modalities_to_load
768
769        def _load_trans_posterior(loaded_data, label, n_features_hint=None):
770            """
771            Parse a trans posterior file and align features to current modality.
772            Returns (posterior_dict, n_features, feat_mask, extra_meta).
773
774            When features in the current modality are missing from the saved fit
775            (would introduce NaN posteriors):
776              - subset_features=False: raises ValueError
777              - subset_features=True:  subsets the modality in-place to fitted features
778            """
779            if not (isinstance(loaded_data, dict) and 'posterior_samples' in loaded_data):
780                # Old format — no alignment possible
781                return loaded_data, None, None, {}
782
783            posterior_raw = loaded_data['posterior_samples']
784            n_features = loaded_data.get('n_features') or n_features_hint
785            saved_names = loaded_data.get('feature_names')
786            mod_name_saved = loaded_data.get('modality_name')
787            feat_mask = None
788
789            # Align to current modality features if possible
790            if mod_name_saved and mod_name_saved in self.model.modalities:
791                mod = self.model.modalities[mod_name_saved]
792                cur_names = (mod.feature_names
793                             if mod.feature_names is not None
794                             else (list(mod.feature_meta.index)
795                                   if mod.feature_meta is not None else None))
796                if (cur_names is not None and saved_names is not None
797                        and cur_names != saved_names and n_features is not None):
798                    posterior_raw, feat_mask = _align_posterior_features(
799                        posterior_raw, saved_names, cur_names, n_features)
800                    _report_alignment(f"{label} features", saved_names, cur_names, feat_mask)
801
802                    if feat_mask is not None:
803                        n_missing = int((~feat_mask).sum())
804                        if n_missing > 0:
805                            if not subset_features:
806                                raise ValueError(
807                                    f"[LOAD] {mod_name_saved}: {n_missing} feature(s) in the current "
808                                    f"modality were not present in the saved trans fit and would "
809                                    f"receive NaN posterior values.\n"
810                                    f"Options:\n"
811                                    f"  • load_trans_fit(..., subset_features=True)  — subset the "
812                                    f"modality to only features present in the saved fit.\n"
813                                    f"  • Rerun fit_trans() on the current feature set to produce "
814                                    f"a matching fit."
815                                )
816                            else:
817                                # Subset the modality in-place to fitted features only
818                                import numpy as _np
819                                mask_np = feat_mask.numpy()
820                                # Subset counts
821                                if mod.counts is not None:
822                                    if hasattr(mod.counts, 'toarray'):
823                                        arr = mod.counts.toarray()
824                                    else:
825                                        arr = mod.counts
826                                    if mod.cells_axis == 1:
827                                        mod.counts = arr[mask_np, :]
828                                    else:
829                                        mod.counts = arr[:, mask_np]
830                                # Subset denominator (binomial)
831                                if mod.denominator is not None:
832                                    denom = mod.denominator
833                                    if hasattr(denom, 'toarray'):
834                                        denom = denom.toarray()
835                                    if mod.cells_axis == 1:
836                                        mod.denominator = denom[mask_np, :]
837                                    else:
838                                        mod.denominator = denom[:, mask_np]
839                                # Subset feature_names
840                                if mod.feature_names is not None:
841                                    mod.feature_names = [mod.feature_names[i]
842                                                         for i, m in enumerate(mask_np) if m]
843                                # Subset feature_meta
844                                if mod.feature_meta is not None:
845                                    mod.feature_meta = mod.feature_meta.iloc[mask_np].reset_index(drop=True)
846                                # Also subset the (now-realigned) posterior NaN positions no longer exist
847                                # Re-extract without NaN fill: just index the posterior keys directly
848                                saved_idx = [i for i, n in enumerate(saved_names) if n in set(cur_names)]
849                                n_kept = int(mask_np.sum())
850                                print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name_saved}: subset_features=True — modality "
851                                      f"subsetted to {n_kept} features present in saved trans fit "
852                                      f"(dropped {n_missing}).")
853                                # Re-align posteriors with the subsetted modality (no NaNs now)
854                                new_cur_names = (mod.feature_names
855                                                 if mod.feature_names is not None
856                                                 else [cur_names[i] for i, m in enumerate(mask_np) if m])
857                                posterior_raw, feat_mask = _align_posterior_features(
858                                    loaded_data['posterior_samples'], saved_names, new_cur_names, n_features)
859                                # feat_mask should now be all True
860                        mod.fitted_feature_mask = feat_mask
861
862            extra = {
863                'modality_name': mod_name_saved,
864                'distribution': loaded_data.get('distribution'),
865                'n_features': n_features,
866                'cis_gene': loaded_data.get('cis_gene'),
867            }
868            return posterior_raw, n_features, feat_mask, extra
869
870        # Load model-level posterior samples (when primary modality is being loaded)
871        if should_load_model_level:
872            posterior_path = os.path.join(input_dir, f'posterior_samples_trans_{self.model.primary_modality}.pt')
873            if not os.path.exists(posterior_path):
874                posterior_path = os.path.join(input_dir, 'posterior_samples_trans.pt')
875
876            if os.path.exists(posterior_path):
877                loaded_data = _torch_load(posterior_path)
878                if isinstance(loaded_data, dict) and 'posterior_samples' in loaded_data:
879                    posterior_dict, n_features, _, extra = _load_trans_posterior(
880                        loaded_data, f"trans {self.model.primary_modality}")
881                    self.model.posterior_samples_trans = posterior_dict
882                    loaded['posterior_samples_trans'] = True
883                    loaded['posterior_samples_trans_metadata'] = extra
884                    if loaded_data.get('losses_trans') is not None:
885                        self.model.losses_trans = loaded_data['losses_trans']
886                    if loaded_data.get('trans_prior_params') is not None:
887                        self.model.trans_prior_params = loaded_data['trans_prior_params']
888                    if verbose:
889                        print(f"[LOAD] posterior_samples_trans (modality: {extra.get('modality_name')}, "
890                              f"{extra.get('n_features')} features) ← {posterior_path}")
891                else:
892                    self.model.posterior_samples_trans = loaded_data
893                    loaded['posterior_samples_trans'] = True
894                    if verbose:
895                        print(f"[LOAD] posterior_samples_trans (legacy format) ← {posterior_path}")
896
897        # Load per-modality posterior samples
898        for mod_name in modalities_to_load:
899            mod_path = os.path.join(input_dir, f'posterior_samples_trans_{mod_name}.pt')
900            if os.path.exists(mod_path):
901                loaded_data = _torch_load(mod_path)
902                mod_loaded = []
903                n_features = None
904
905                if isinstance(loaded_data, dict) and 'posterior_samples' in loaded_data:
906                    posterior_dict, n_features, _, extra = _load_trans_posterior(
907                        loaded_data, f"trans {mod_name}")
908                    self.model.modalities[mod_name].posterior_samples_trans = posterior_dict
909                    loaded[f'posterior_samples_trans_{mod_name}_metadata'] = extra
910
911                    if loaded_data.get('losses_trans') is not None:
912                        self.model.modalities[mod_name].losses_trans = loaded_data['losses_trans']
913                        mod_loaded.append(f"loss({len(self.model.modalities[mod_name].losses_trans)})")
914                    if loaded_data.get('trans_prior_params') is not None:
915                        self.model.modalities[mod_name].trans_prior_params = loaded_data['trans_prior_params']
916
917                    if verbose:
918                        print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.posterior_samples_trans "
919                              f"(distribution: {extra.get('distribution')}, {n_features} features) ← {mod_path}")
920                else:
921                    self.model.modalities[mod_name].posterior_samples_trans = loaded_data
922                    if verbose:
923                        print(f"[LOAD] {mod_name}.posterior_samples_trans (legacy format) ← {mod_path}")
924
925                loaded[f'posterior_samples_trans_{mod_name}'] = True
926                mod_loaded.append(f"posterior({n_features or '?'} features)")
927                loaded_summary.append(f"{mod_name}: {', '.join(mod_loaded)}")
928
929        # Print summary
930        print(f"[LOAD] Trans fit from {input_dir}")
931        if loaded_summary:
932            print(f"[LOAD] Loaded: {'; '.join(loaded_summary)}")
933
934        return loaded

Load fitted trans parameters.

Parameters

input_dir : str, optional Directory to load from. If None, uses self.model.output_dir. modalities : list of str, optional List of modality names to load. If None, attempts to load all existing modalities. Example: ['gene', 'atac'] verbose : bool If True, print detailed loading information. Default False (summary only). subset_features : bool If False (default), raise an error when the current modality contains features that were not present in the saved trans fit (would introduce NaN posteriors). If True, subset the modality in-place to only the features present in the saved fit so that loading proceeds without NaNs.

Returns

dict Loaded parameters (keys only, not full tensors)

def save_ntc_summary( self, output_dir: Optional[str] = None, modality_name: Optional[str] = None): 
1009    def save_ntc_summary(
1010        self,
1011        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1012        modality_name: Optional[str] = None
1013    ):
1014        """
1015        Save NTC fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.
1016
1017        Creates: ntc_feature_summary_{modality}.csv
1018
1019        Columns:
1020        - feature: Feature name
1021        - modality: Modality name
1022        - distribution: Distribution type
1023        - group_{i}_alpha_y_median: Median alpha_y for group i (point estimate from fit_ntc)
1024        - group_{i}_alpha_y_lower: 2.5% quantile for group i
1025        - group_{i}_alpha_y_upper: 97.5% quantile for group i
1026
1027        Parameters
1028        ----------
1029        output_dir : str, optional
1030            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1031        modality_name : str, optional
1032            Modality to export (default: primary modality)
1033        """
1034        if output_dir is None:
1035            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1036
1037        if modality_name is None:
1038            modality_name = self.model.primary_modality
1039
1040        # Get modality
1041        modality = self.model.get_modality(modality_name)
1042
1043        # Check if technical fit has been run for this modality
1044        if not hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit') or modality.alpha_y_prefit is None:
1045            raise ValueError(f"NTC fit not found for modality '{modality_name}'. Run fit_ntc() first.")
1046
1047        # Get alpha_y for this modality (prefer distribution-specific versions)
1048        if hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_mult') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult is not None:
1049            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit_mult  # [C, T] point estimate
1050        elif hasattr(modality, 'alpha_y_prefit_add') and modality.alpha_y_prefit_add is not None:
1051            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit_add  # [C, T] point estimate
1052        else:
1053            alpha_y = modality.alpha_y_prefit  # [C, T] point estimate
1054
1055        # Convert to numpy if tensor
1056        if isinstance(alpha_y, torch.Tensor):
1057            alpha_y = alpha_y.cpu().numpy()
1058
1059        # For multinomial, alpha_y is [C, T, K]; for all others, [C, T].
1060        # If an old-format tensor with a leading samples dim (S) was stored, collapse it.
1061        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial':
1062            if alpha_y.ndim == 4:  # [S, C, T, K] — collapse S
1063                alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(axis=0)
1064            # alpha_y is now [C, T, K]
1065        else:
1066            if alpha_y.ndim == 3:  # [S, C, T] — collapse S
1067                alpha_y = alpha_y.mean(axis=0)
1068            # alpha_y is now [C, T]
1069
1070        # Get feature names - prefer modality.feature_names (what users see)
1071        if modality.feature_names is not None:
1072            feature_names = modality.feature_names
1073        else:
1074            feature_names = modality.feature_meta.index.tolist()
1075        n_features = len(feature_names)
1076        n_groups = alpha_y.shape[0]  # [C, T] → C groups
1077
1078        alpha_median = alpha_y  # [C, T] — point estimate stored as median at fit time
1079        alpha_lower = alpha_y  # no uncertainty (point estimate)
1080        alpha_upper = alpha_y
1081
1082        # Extract mu_ntc and o_y medians from posterior_samples_ntc ([S, T] → [T])
1083        def _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, key):
1084            v = ps.get(key)
1085            if v is None:
1086                return None
1087            if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor):
1088                v = v.cpu().numpy()
1089            if v.ndim == 1:
1090                return v
1091            return np.median(v, axis=0).flatten()  # collapse samples + any extra dims → [T]
1092
1093        ps = getattr(modality, 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1094        mu_ntc_vals = _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, 'mu_ntc')
1095        o_y_vals    = _extract_scalar_posterior(ps, 'o_y')
1096
1097        # Build DataFrame
1098        cis_gene = getattr(self.model, 'cis_gene', None)
1099        is_primary = modality_name == self.model.primary_modality
1100        data = {'feature': feature_names}
1101        if is_primary and cis_gene is not None:
1102            data['is_cis_gene'] = [f == cis_gene for f in feature_names]
1103        data['modality'] = modality_name
1104        data['distribution'] = modality.distribution
1105
1106        # Add columns for each group.
1107        # For multinomial alpha_y is [C, T, K]: export one column per (group, category).
1108        # For all others alpha_y is [C, T]: one column per group.
1109        if modality.distribution == 'multinomial':
1110            K_alpha = alpha_median.shape[2]
1111            for g in range(n_groups):
1112                for k in range(K_alpha):
1113                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_median'] = alpha_median[g, :, k]
1114                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_lower'] = alpha_lower[g, :, k]
1115                    data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_cat{k}_upper'] = alpha_upper[g, :, k]
1116        else:
1117            for g in range(n_groups):
1118                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = alpha_median[g, :]
1119                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_lower'] = alpha_lower[g, :]
1120                data[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_upper'] = alpha_upper[g, :]
1121
1122        if mu_ntc_vals is not None:
1123            data['mu_ntc'] = mu_ntc_vals
1124        if o_y_vals is not None:
1125            data['o_y'] = o_y_vals
1126
1127        df = pd.DataFrame(data)
1128
1129        # Append cis gene row if this is the primary modality and alpha_x_prefit is available
1130        alpha_x = getattr(self.model, 'alpha_x_prefit', None)
1131        cis_appended = False
1132        if is_primary and cis_gene is not None and alpha_x is not None:
1133            alpha_x_np = alpha_x.cpu().numpy() if isinstance(alpha_x, torch.Tensor) else np.asarray(alpha_x)
1134            cis_ps = getattr(self.model.get_modality('cis'), 'posterior_samples_ntc', None) or {}
1135            cis_mu = _extract_scalar_posterior(cis_ps, 'mu_ntc')
1136            cis_oy = _extract_scalar_posterior(cis_ps, 'o_x')  # stored as o_x in cis modality
1137            cis_row = {
1138                'feature': cis_gene,
1139                'is_cis_gene': True,
1140                'modality': modality_name,
1141                'distribution': modality.distribution,
1142            }
1143            for g in range(n_groups):
1144                val = float(alpha_x_np[g]) if g < len(alpha_x_np) else float('nan')
1145                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_median'] = val
1146                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_lower'] = val
1147                cis_row[f'group_{g}_alpha_y_upper'] = val
1148            if mu_ntc_vals is not None:
1149                cis_row['mu_ntc'] = float(cis_mu[0]) if cis_mu is not None else float('nan')
1150            if o_y_vals is not None:
1151                cis_row['o_y'] = float(cis_oy[0]) if cis_oy is not None else float('nan')
1152            df = pd.concat([df, pd.DataFrame([cis_row])], ignore_index=True)
1153            cis_appended = True
1154
1155        # Save
1156        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1157        output_file = os.path.join(output_dir, f'ntc_feature_summary_{modality_name}.csv')
1158        df.to_csv(output_file, index=False)
1159
1160        print(f"[SAVE] Technical summary saved to {output_file}")
1161        print(f"       {len(df)} features × {n_groups} groups ({n_features} trans + cis gene)"
1162              if cis_appended
1163              else f"       {n_features} features × {n_groups} groups")
1164
1165        return df

Save NTC fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.

Creates: ntc_feature_summary_{modality}.csv

Columns:

  • feature: Feature name
  • modality: Modality name
  • distribution: Distribution type
  • group_{i}_alpha_y_median: Median alpha_y for group i (point estimate from fit_ntc)
  • group_{i}_alpha_y_lower: 2.5% quantile for group i
  • group_{i}_alpha_y_upper: 97.5% quantile for group i

Parameters

output_dir : str, optional Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label) modality_name : str, optional Modality to export (default: primary modality)

def save_cis_summary( self, output_dir: Optional[str] = None, include_cell_level: bool = True): 
1171    def save_cis_summary(
1172        self,
1173        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1174        include_cell_level: bool = True
1175    ):
1176        """
1177        Save cis fit parameters as guide-wise and cell-wise CSVs.
1178
1179        Creates:
1180        - cis_guide_summary.csv: Guide-level summary
1181        - cis_cell_summary.csv: Cell-level data (if include_cell_level=True)
1182
1183        Guide-level columns (single-guide mode):
1184        - guide: Guide name
1185        - target: Target gene
1186        - n_cells: Number of cells
1187        - x_true_mean: Mean x_true (averaged over cells in guide, then over posterior samples)
1188        - x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
1189        - x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
1190        - raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts
1191
1192        Guide-level columns (high MOI mode):
1193        - guide: Guide name
1194        - targets: Comma-separated target gene(s)
1195        - n_cells: Number of cells carrying this guide
1196        - x_eff_g_mean: Mean per-guide effective expression
1197        - x_eff_g_lower: 2.5% quantile
1198        - x_eff_g_upper: 97.5% quantile
1199        - sigma_eff_mean: Mean per-guide effect uncertainty
1200        - raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts for cells carrying this guide
1201
1202        Cell-level columns:
1203        - cell: Cell barcode
1204        - guide: Guide name (single-guide mode only)
1205        - target: Target classification (cis gene or 'ntc')
1206        - technical_group_code: Technical group (if available)
1207        - x_true_mean: Mean cell-level x_true
1208        - x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
1209        - x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
1210        - raw_counts: Raw counts for this cell
1211
1212        Parameters
1213        ----------
1214        output_dir : str, optional
1215            Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label)
1216        include_cell_level : bool
1217            Whether to save cell-level summary (default: True)
1218        """
1219        if output_dir is None:
1220            output_dir = os.path.join(self.model.output_dir, self.model.label)
1221
1222        # Check if cis fit has been run
1223        if not hasattr(self.model, 'x_true') or self.model.x_true is None:
1224            raise ValueError("Cis fit not found. Run fit_cis() first.")
1225
1226        is_high_moi = getattr(self.model, 'is_high_moi', False)
1227
1228        # Get x_true samples — shape is [n_samples, n_cells] (cell-level)
1229        if hasattr(self.model, 'posterior_samples_cis') and 'x_true' in self.model.posterior_samples_cis:
1230            x_true_cell_samples = self.model.posterior_samples_cis['x_true']
1231            if isinstance(x_true_cell_samples, torch.Tensor):
1232                x_true_cell_samples = x_true_cell_samples.cpu().numpy()
1233        else:
1234            # Use point estimate
1235            x_true_pt = self.model.x_true
1236            if isinstance(x_true_pt, torch.Tensor):
1237                x_true_pt = x_true_pt.cpu().numpy()
1238            x_true_cell_samples = x_true_pt[np.newaxis, :]  # [1, n_cells]
1239
1240        # Get raw counts from cis modality
1241        cis_mod = self.model.get_modality('cis')
1242        cis_counts = cis_mod.counts[0, :]  # [n_cells]
1243
1244        os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
1245
1246        # ── Guide-level summary ───────────────────────────────────────────────
1247        if is_high_moi:
1248            # In high MOI mode, guide-level parameters are x_eff_g and sigma_eff [G]
1249            cis_ps = self.model.posterior_samples_cis
1250
1251            x_eff_g_samples = cis_ps['x_eff_g']  # [n_samples, G]
1252            if isinstance(x_eff_g_samples, torch.Tensor):
1253                x_eff_g_samples = x_eff_g_samples.cpu().numpy()
1254
1255            sigma_eff_samples = cis_ps['sigma_eff']  # [n_samples, G]
1256            if isinstance(sigma_eff_samples, torch.Tensor):
1257                sigma_eff_samples = sigma_eff_samples.cpu().numpy()
1258
1259            guides = self.model.guide_meta['guide'].tolist()
1260            G = len(guides)
1261
1262            # Cells per guide from guide_assignment (N x G binary matrix)
1263            guide_assignment = self.model.guide_assignment  # numpy [N, G]
1264            n_cells_per_guide = guide_assignment.sum(axis=0).astype(int)  # [G]
1265
1266            # Average raw counts for cells carrying each guide
1267            raw_counts_mean = []
1268            for gi in range(G):
1269                cell_mask = guide_assignment[:, gi].astype(bool)
1270                if cell_mask.any():
1271                    raw_counts_mean.append(float(cis_counts[cell_mask].mean()))
1272                else:
1273                    raw_counts_mean.append(float('nan'))
1274
1275            # Targets: comma-separated list from guide_targets_dict
1276            gtd = getattr(self.model, 'guide_targets_dict', {})
1277            targets_col = [
1278                ','.join(gtd.get(g, ['unknown']))
1279                for g in guides
1280            ]
1281
1282            guide_df = pd.DataFrame({
1283                'guide': guides,
1284                'targets': targets_col,
1285                'n_cells': n_cells_per_guide,
1286                'x_eff_g_mean': x_eff_g_samples.mean(axis=0),
1287                'x_eff_g_lower': np.quantile(x_eff_g_samples, 0.025, axis=0),
1288                'x_eff_g_upper': np.quantile(x_eff_g_samples, 0.975, axis=0),
1289                'sigma_eff_mean': sigma_eff_samples.mean(axis=0),
1290                'raw_counts_mean': raw_counts_mean,
1291            })
1292
1293            guide_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_guide_summary.csv')
1294            guide_df.to_csv(guide_file, index=False)
1295            print(f"[SAVE] Cis guide summary saved to {guide_file}")
1296            print(f"       {G} guides (high MOI)")
1297
1298        else:
1299            # Get guide-level metadata
1300            guide_meta = self.model.meta.groupby('guide').agg({
1301                'target': 'first',
1302                'cell': 'count'
1303            }).rename(columns={'cell': 'n_cells'})
1304
1305            guides = guide_meta.index.tolist()
1306
1307            # Aggregate x_true from cell-level to guide-level (mean over cells per guide)
1308            # Use positional indices (iloc) because meta.index may be cell-name strings
1309            guide_to_cell_indices = {
1310                g: np.where(self.model.meta['guide'].values == g)[0].tolist()
1311                for g in guides
1312            }
1313
1314            # Build [n_samples, n_guides] by averaging cells within each guide
1315            n_samples = x_true_cell_samples.shape[0]
1316            n_guides = len(guides)
1317            x_true_guide_samples = np.zeros((n_samples, n_guides))
1318            for gi, g in enumerate(guides):
1319                cell_idx = guide_to_cell_indices[g]
1320                x_true_guide_samples[:, gi] = x_true_cell_samples[:, cell_idx].mean(axis=1)
1321
1322            # Compute mean and CI per guide
1323            x_true_mean = x_true_guide_samples.mean(axis=0)
1324            x_true_lower = np.quantile(x_true_guide_samples, 0.025, axis=0)
1325            x_true_upper = np.quantile(x_true_guide_samples, 0.975, axis=0)
1326
1327            # Compute average raw counts per guide
1328            guide_to_cells = self.model.meta.groupby('guide')['cell'].apply(list).to_dict()
1329            raw_counts_mean = []
1330            for guide in guides:
1331                guide_cells = guide_to_cells.get(guide, [])
1332                guide_cell_indices = [i for i, cell in enumerate(self.model.meta['cell']) if cell in guide_cells]
1333                if len(guide_cell_indices) > 0:
1334                    raw_counts_mean.append(cis_counts[guide_cell_indices].mean())
1335                else:
1336                    raw_counts_mean.append(np.nan)
1337
1338            guide_df = pd.DataFrame({
1339                'guide': guides,
1340                'target': guide_meta['target'].values,
1341                'n_cells': guide_meta['n_cells'].values,
1342                'x_true_mean': x_true_mean,
1343                'x_true_lower': x_true_lower,
1344                'x_true_upper': x_true_upper,
1345                'raw_counts_mean': raw_counts_mean
1346            })
1347
1348            guide_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_guide_summary.csv')
1349            guide_df.to_csv(guide_file, index=False)
1350            print(f"[SAVE] Cis guide summary saved to {guide_file}")
1351            print(f"       {len(guides)} guides")
1352
1353        # ── Cell-level summary ────────────────────────────────────────────────
1354        if include_cell_level:
1355            cell_data = {
1356                'cell': self.model.meta['cell'].values,
1357                'target': self.model.meta['target'].values,
1358            }
1359
1360            # In single-guide mode, include per-cell guide assignment
1361            if not is_high_moi:
1362                cell_data['guide'] = self.model.meta['guide'].values
1363
1364            # Add technical_group_code if available
1365            if 'technical_group_code' in self.model.meta.columns:
1366                cell_data['technical_group_code'] = self.model.meta['technical_group_code'].values
1367
1368            # Use cell-level x_true directly from posterior samples
1369            cell_data['x_true_mean'] = x_true_cell_samples.mean(axis=0)
1370            cell_data['x_true_lower'] = np.quantile(x_true_cell_samples, 0.025, axis=0)
1371            cell_data['x_true_upper'] = np.quantile(x_true_cell_samples, 0.975, axis=0)
1372            cell_data['raw_counts'] = cis_counts
1373
1374            cell_df = pd.DataFrame(cell_data)
1375
1376            cell_file = os.path.join(output_dir, 'cis_cell_summary.csv')
1377            cell_df.to_csv(cell_file, index=False)
1378            print(f"[SAVE] Cis cell summary saved to {cell_file}")
1379            print(f"       {len(cell_df)} cells")
1380
1381            return guide_df, cell_df
1382
1383        return guide_df

Save cis fit parameters as guide-wise and cell-wise CSVs.

Creates:

  • cis_guide_summary.csv: Guide-level summary
  • cis_cell_summary.csv: Cell-level data (if include_cell_level=True)

Guide-level columns (single-guide mode):

  • guide: Guide name
  • target: Target gene
  • n_cells: Number of cells
  • x_true_mean: Mean x_true (averaged over cells in guide, then over posterior samples)
  • x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
  • x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
  • raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts

Guide-level columns (high MOI mode):

  • guide: Guide name
  • targets: Comma-separated target gene(s)
  • n_cells: Number of cells carrying this guide
  • x_eff_g_mean: Mean per-guide effective expression
  • x_eff_g_lower: 2.5% quantile
  • x_eff_g_upper: 97.5% quantile
  • sigma_eff_mean: Mean per-guide effect uncertainty
  • raw_counts_mean: Average raw counts for cells carrying this guide

Cell-level columns:

  • cell: Cell barcode
  • guide: Guide name (single-guide mode only)
  • target: Target classification (cis gene or 'ntc')
  • technical_group_code: Technical group (if available)
  • x_true_mean: Mean cell-level x_true
  • x_true_lower: 2.5% quantile
  • x_true_upper: 97.5% quantile
  • raw_counts: Raw counts for this cell

Parameters

output_dir : str, optional Output directory (default: model.output_dir/model.label) include_cell_level : bool Whether to save cell-level summary (default: True)

def save_trans_summary( self, output_dir: Optional[str] = None, modality_name: Optional[str] = None, compute_inflection: bool = True, compute_derivative_roots: bool = True, compute_log2fc_params: bool = True, compute_lfc_ci: bool = True, x_ntc: Optional[float] = None, y_ntc=None, verbose: bool = True, max_features: Optional[int] = None): 
1415    def save_trans_summary(
1416        self,
1417        output_dir: Optional[str] = None,
1418        modality_name: Optional[str] = None,
1419        compute_inflection: bool = True,
1420        compute_derivative_roots: bool = True,
1421        compute_log2fc_params: bool = True,
1422        compute_lfc_ci: bool = True,
1423        x_ntc: Optional[float] = None,
1424        y_ntc=None,
1425        verbose: bool = True,
1426        max_features: Optional[int] = None,
1427    ):
1428        """
1429        Save trans fit parameters as feature-wise CSV.
1430
1431        Creates: trans_feature_summary_{modality}.csv
1432
1433        Columns (depend on function_type and distribution):
1434        - feature: Feature name
1435        - modality: Modality name
1436        - distribution: Distribution type
1437        - function_type: Function type (additive_hill, single_hill, polynomial)
1438        - x_obs_min, x_obs_max: Observed x range (min/max of guide-level x_true)
1439
1440        For negbinom/normal/studentt distributions:
1441        - observed_log2fc: log2(y_max / y_min) over observed x range from fitted function
1442        - full_log2fc_median/lower/upper: log2(y_max / y_min) over theoretical x range (0 to ∞)
1443
1444        For binomial distributions (e.g., splicing_sj):
1445        - observed_delta_p: y_max - y_min over observed x range (probability difference)
1446        - full_delta_p_median/lower/upper: y_max - y_min over theoretical x range
1447
1448        FDR columns (all function types):
1449        - fdr_alpha: Bayesian q-value for component A (positive Hill, or the single Hill
1450                     component in single_hill).  The minimum expected FDR among all called
1451                     sets that include this feature's component A.  Analogous to a
1452                     Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value: calling all features with
1453                     fdr_alpha <= q controls the expected false discovery rate at q.
1454                     For additive_hill, computed over the *pooled* family of 2*n_features
1455                     tests (alpha + beta), which accounts for the increased multiple-testing
1456                     burden relative to single_hill.
1457        - fdr_beta:  Bayesian q-value for component B (negative Hill).  NaN for
1458                     single_hill and polynomial.  Computed in the same pooled family as
1459                     fdr_alpha for additive_hill.
1460
1461        For additive_hill (all parameters needed to recreate: y = A + alpha*Vmax_a*Hill(x;K_a,n_a) + beta*Vmax_b*Hill(x;K_b,n_b)):
1462        - A_median, A_lower, A_upper: Baseline (intercept)
1463        - Vmax_a_median, Vmax_a_lower, Vmax_a_upper: Component A magnitude
1464        - K_a_median, K_a_lower, K_a_upper: Component A half-max (EC50)
1465        - EC50_a_median, EC50_a_lower, EC50_a_upper: Same as K_a (alias)
1466        - n_a_median, n_a_lower, n_a_upper: Component A Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
1467        - alpha_median, alpha_lower, alpha_upper: Component A weight
1468        - Vmax_b_median, Vmax_b_lower, Vmax_b_upper: Component B magnitude
1469        - K_b_median, K_b_lower, K_b_upper: Component B half-max (EC50)
1470        - EC50_b_median, EC50_b_lower, EC50_b_upper: Same as K_b (alias)
1471        - n_b_median, n_b_lower, n_b_upper: Component B Hill coefficient (cooperativity)
1472        - beta_median, beta_lower, beta_upper: Component B weight
1473        - pi_y_median, pi_y_lower, pi_y_upper: Sparsity weight (optional)
